title: Mizoram Temple Recipes
tagline: 61 sattvic recipes for institutional cooking, written for ISKCON Bangalore

recipes.name: Thingpui
recipes.sub: Black tea with ginger, no milk
recipes.sub_l: Sawhthing nen thingpui, hnute tel lo

method.en: Mizoram drinks its tea black. There is no dairy tradition in these hills and a milk tea is a plains habit, worth knowing before a menu is decided.
method.l: Mizoram-ah thingpui hi hnute tel lova in a ni. He tlangah hnute hman dan a awm lo.

method.en: Bruise the ginger with the back of a knife rather than grating it. Grated ginger clouds the tea and has to be strained twice.
method.l: Sawhthing chu chhiat lovin chem hnungin dengin. Chhiat chuan thingpui a rual bo a, vawi hnih chher a ngai.

method.en: Boil the ginger in the water for ten minutes before the tea goes anywhere near it.
method.l: Thingpui hnah dah hmain sawhthing chu tui-ah minute 10 chhung tibuk rawh.

method.en: Take the vessel off the fire, then add the tea leaves and steep four minutes. Tea boiled with the leaves in turns bitter and no sugar covers it.
method.l: Bel chu mei atangin la chhuak la, thingpui hnah dah la, minute 4 dah rawh. Hnah nen tibuk chuan a kha ang.

method.en: Strain at once. Leaves left in the pot go on brewing and the last cup is nothing like the first.
method.l: Chhun chhuah nghal rawh. Hnah dah chhiat chuan a chhun zel a, a tawp cup chu a hmasa nen a inang lo.

method.en: Keep it in an insulated urn rather than over a flame, and sweeten at the counter — many here drink it without sugar.
method.l: Mei chunga dah lovin flask-ah dah la, chini chu sem hmunah dah rawh.

recipes.why: Black, not milky, and off the fire before the leaves go in. Both rules are about not making it bitter.
recipes.why_l: Hnute tel lo, tin hnah dah hmain mei tibang. Hei hi a kha loh nan a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start twenty-five minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Sem hma minute 25 in buatsaih tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 30 L leh chher na. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year, and drunk at every hour of the day.
season.l: Kum tin, ni tin darkar tin in.

recipes.name: Passion Fruit Juice
recipes.sub: Passion fruit with sugar and salt
recipes.sub_l: Passion rah, chini leh chi nen

method.en: Passion fruit grows half-wild across Mizoram and in season it costs almost nothing. This drink is worth making only in those five months.
method.l: Passion rah hi Mizoram tlangah a chhuak thin a, a hun laiin a man a tlem hle. He thla nga chhung chauhah siam tur a ni.

method.en: Halve the fruit and scoop the pulp with the seeds into a bowl. Do not press it through a sieve yet.
method.l: Rah chu tikhata that la, a chi nen a hnim chu bel-ah dah rawh.

method.en: Rub the pulp gently against the sieve with the fingers to release the juice, then discard the seeds.
method.l: Kutzung hmangin chher na-ah nuai rawh, chuan a chi chu paih rawh.

method.en: Do not crush the seeds. A crushed passion fruit seed is bitter and one pressing too hard spoils the whole drum.
method.l: A chi chu tinep suh. Passion chi nep chu a kha a, vawi khat nasa taka nghet chuan drum pumpui a tichhia.

method.en: Dissolve the sugar in warm water first and cool it completely before the pulp goes in. Sugar stirred into cold juice settles at the bottom.
method.l: Chini chu tui lum-ah tihral hmasa la, a dai hnuah a hnim chu dah rawh.

method.en: Add lemon and salt at the counter, not in the kitchen. Passion fruit is already sour and the balance shifts as it stands.
method.l: Serthlum leh chi chu sem hmunah dah rawh, chaw suk inah dah suh.

recipes.why: A fruit that costs nothing for five months of the year. Do not crush the seeds and there is nothing else to it.
recipes.why_l: Thla nga chhung man tlawm tak rah. A chi tinep loh chauh a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Make the syrup an hour ahead and hold it cold.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Darkar khat hmain siam la, dai takin dah rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L drum, a sieve and a bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: Drum 30 L, chher na leh bel. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: June to October, when the vines are fruiting across the hills.
season.l: June atanga October thleng, tlangah hrui rah a chhuah lai.

recipes.name: Ginger Lemon Cooler
recipes.sub: Ginger, lemon and black salt
recipes.sub_l: Sawhthing, serthlum leh chi dum

method.en: Roll each lemon hard under the palm before cutting. A rolled lemon gives about a third more juice than one cut cold from the crate.
method.l: At hmain serthlum chu kutphah hnuaiah nasa takin thlir rawh. Thlir tawh chuan a tui a tam zawk.

method.en: Squeeze by hand rather than in a machine, and stop before the pith is crushed. Machine-pressed lemon turns bitter within the hour.
method.l: Machine ni lovin kutin hnawh rawh. Machine-a hnawh chuan darkar khat chhungin a kha ang.

method.en: Bruise the ginger and boil it in a few litres of water for fifteen minutes, then cool it completely.
method.l: Sawhthing chu deng la, tui litre tlemte-ah minute 15 tibuk la, tidai rawh.

method.en: Dissolve the sugar in warm water first. Sugar stirred into cold water never fully dissolves and settles at the bottom of the drum.
method.l: Chini chu tui lum-ah tihral hmasa rawh. Tui dai-ah chuan a hral thlap lo.

method.en: Add both salts. Taste it cold — chilled drinks need more salt than seems right, because cold dulls salt.
method.l: Chi hnihte dah la, a dai lai chuan tem teh. Thil dai chuan chi tam zawk a ngai.

method.en: Add the lemon juice last of all, at the counter, and never hold the finished drink more than two hours.
method.l: Serthlum tui chu a tawpah, sem hmunah dah rawh. Darkar hnih aia rei dah suh.

recipes.why: Costs a fraction of anything else here and the ginger decoction can be made a day ahead.
recipes.why_l: A man a tlawm hle a, sawhthing tui chu ni khat hmain siam theih a ni.

start.en: Make the ginger decoction an hour ahead and cool it.
start.l: Sawhthing tui chu darkar khat hmain siam la, tidai rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L drum and a juicer. One cook.
vessel.l: Drum 30 L leh serthlum hnawh na. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: April to September, and doubled in the hot months.
season.l: April atanga September thleng, a lum lai chuan a let hnih.

recipes.name: Sawhthing Thingpui
recipes.sub: Black tea boiled with a great deal of bruised ginger
recipes.sub_l: Sawhthing tam tak nen thingpui dum a chhum

method.en: Bruise the ginger with a stone and do not grate it. A grated sawhthing clouds twenty-five litres and the urn has to be strained twice.
method.l: Sawhthing chu lung hmangin dengin, thlur suh. Sawhthing thlur chu litre 25 a tihthim a, chuvangin belah tui chu vawi hnih sil a ngai.

method.en: Boil the water and the ginger together fifteen minutes before the tea leaf goes in. Ginger added with the leaf gives colour and no heat.
method.l: Thingpui hnah luh hmain tui leh sawhthing chu minute 15 chhung khawmin chhum ang che. Hnah nen a luh tur sawhthing chuan rawng a pe a, thautthawh chu a pe lo.

method.en: Four minutes on the leaf and no longer. A Mizo thingpui boiled ten minutes is bitter and four hundred grams of leaf is wasted.
method.l: Hnah chungah minute li chauh, chu aia rei lo. Mizo thingpui minute sawm chhung chhum chu a khah a, hnah gram 400 chu a boral.

method.en: Jaggery and not sugar. In Aizawl the Bara Bazar kurtai is forty rupees a kilo against sixty for sugar, and it carries the ginger better.
method.l: Kurtai, sugar ni lo. Aizawl Bara Bazar-ah kurtai chu kilo khat tangka sawmli a ni a, sugar chu sawmruk; tin, sawhthing chu a phur thei zawk.

recipes.why: Three rupees seventy a head, and the ginger is most of it. It is the tea a Mizo kitchen makes on a fur morning when the hall is cold and wet.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka thum leh sawmsarih, tin sawhthing chu a tam ber a ni. Hei hi fur zing lai, in chu a vawt a a hnawng lai a Mizo chawthlengin a siam thingpui a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmthum.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a straining cloth. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel leh sil nan puan. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and every morning in fur.
season.l: Kum tin, tin fur lai zing tin.

recipes.name: Hnute Thingpui
recipes.sub: Black tea boiled with milk and a bruised cardamom
recipes.sub_l: Hnute leh elaichi deng nen thingpui a chhum

method.en: Boil the water and the leaf first and the milk after. Milk from the start with five hundred grams of leaf gives a vessel the colour of a wall.
method.l: Tui leh hnah chu hmasain chhum la, hnutetui chu a hnuah. Tir aṭanga hnutetui leh hnah gram 500 chuan bel rawng chu bang rawng ang a siam.

method.en: Bruise the cardamom and do not powder it. A powdered elaichi gives everything in the first minute and the last glasses have nothing.
method.l: Elaichi chu dengin, vut ah siam suh. Elaichi vut chuan minute hmasa berah engkim a pe a, glass hnuhnung berahte chuan engmah a awm tawh lo.

method.en: Four minutes on the boil after the milk and no longer. A tea boiled ten minutes is bitter and nine litres of milk is wasted in it.
method.l: Hnutetui a luh hnuah minute li chhum chauh, chu aia rei lo. Minute sawm chhung chhum thingpui chu a khah a, hnutetui litre kua chu a chhungah a boral.

method.en: Strain it into the counter urn and not into glasses. Tea standing on the leaf goes bitter in twenty minutes however good it was.
method.l: Glass-ah ni lovin sem nan bel-ah sil la. Hnah chunga awm thingpui chu minute sawmhnihah a khah a, a tha zawng pawh ni se.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees eighty a head. It is the tea a Mizo kitchen is judged by; a Chapchar Kut morning without it is remembered for the wrong reason.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh sawmriat. Hei hi Mizo chawthlengte thiamna teh nan thingpui a ni; Chapchar Kut zing lai hei tel lo chu chhan tha lo avangin an hre reng.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmli.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, a strainer and a counter urn. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel, sil nan leh sem nan bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and at Chapchar Kut and Pawl Kut above all.
season.l: Kum tin, tin Chapchar Kut leh Pawl Kut-ah a bik takin.

recipes.name: Balhla Hnute
recipes.sub: Ripe banana crushed cold into milk with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Balhla hmin kurtai nen hnutetui-ah a deng

method.en: Crush the balhla by hand and never in a blender. A blended banana holds air and twenty-two litres froths over the rim of the urn.
method.l: Balhla chu kut hmangin dengin, blender-ah tih suh. Blender-a tih balhla chuan thaw a keng a, litre 22 chu bel kam atangin a luang chhuak.

method.en: Boil the milk and let it go completely cold before the banana. Warm milk on a ripe balhla turns the whole urn sour in an hour.
method.l: Hnutetui chu chhum la, balhla luh hmain a vawt famkim tur a ni. Balhla hmin chunga hnutetui lum chuan darkar khat chhungin bel pumpui a tithur.

method.en: Melt the jaggery in the four litres of water and strain it. Field kurtai carries sand and grit in a drink is what is remembered of it.
method.l: Kurtai chu tui litre li-ah tifual la, sil rawh. Lo lam kurtai chuan sepaipui a keng a, in tur chhunga sepaipui chu hre reng tur a ni.

method.en: Mix it at the counter and not in the kitchen. A balhla hnute standing an hour separates and no stirring brings it back.
method.l: Chawthlengah ni lovin sem hnaih vela chhawm rawh. Darkar khat awm balhla hnute chu a inṭhen a, tih chhawm hian a rawn hruai kir thei lo.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees eighty a head. In Kolasib the balhla is on every cart at twenty rupees a kilo and eight kilos does a hundred glasses.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh sawmriat. Kolasib-ah balhla chu kilo khat tangka sawmhnih-in gari tinah a awm a, kilo riat chuan glass za a siam.

start.en: The milk boils and cools two hours ahead. Crush the banana at the counter.
start.l: Hnutetui chu darkar hnih hmaah chhum a, a vawt tur a ni. Balhla chu sem hnaih vela dengin.

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a cooling tray and a 30 L urn. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chhum nan bel, vawtna tray leh litre 30 bel. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: All year, and cheapest in fur.
season.l: Kum tin, tin fur lai a man tlawm ber.

recipes.name: Tengtere Tui
recipes.sub: Tamarind soaked cold, strained and sweetened with black salt
recipes.sub_l: Tengtere tui vawtah dah, sil a, mluh dum nen a tithlum

method.en: Soak the tengtere in cold water two hours and work it with the hand. Boiled tamarind turns the colour of a wet road and the urn is brown.
method.l: Tengtere chu tui vawtah darkar hnih dah la, kut hmangin sui rawh. Tengtere chhum chuan kawng hnawng rawng a nei a, bel chu a dum.

method.en: Strain it through two cloths and press the pulp. One cloth leaves a fibre that sits on the tongue and every glass comes back.
method.l: Puan pahnih hmangin sil la, a hnim chu nam rawh. Puan pakhat chuan hnim a nghak a, chu chu leiah a awm a, glass tin a rawn kir.

method.en: Black salt and not white. A tengtere tui without it is flat and half the hall leaves the glass standing.
method.l: Mluh dum, mluh var ni lo. Chu tel lo tengtere tui chu a tlem a, in chhung a chanve chuan glass chu an nghak mai.

method.en: Serve it cold. Warm, a tengtere tui tastes of the pot and in thal the hall is at thirty degrees and nobody will take a warm glass.
method.l: Vawtin sem rawh. A lum chuan tengtere tui chu bel tui angin a tui a, thal lai in chu degree sawmthum a ni a, tuman glass lum an duh lo.

recipes.why: Four rupees ninety a head, no fire under it at all. Two kilos of tengtere gives a hundred glasses and a Lunglei tree drops more than the kitchen can use.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka li leh sawmkua, a hnuaiah mei rei lo. Tengtere kilo hnih chuan glass za a pe a, Lunglei thingkung pakhat chuan chawthleng hman zawng aiin a tam zawk a thlak.

start.en: Tamarind soaks two hours in cold water. Nothing cooks.
start.l: Tengtere chu tui vawtah darkar hnih a awm. Engmah chhum a ngai lo.

vessel.en: A soaking tub, two straining cloths and a 30 L urn. One cook.
vessel.l: Dahna bel, sil nan puan pahnih leh litre 30 bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Thal to fur, and on any day above thirty degrees.
season.l: Thal aṭanga fur thleng, tin degree sawmthum chunga ni apiangah.

recipes.name: Buh Tui
recipes.sub: The water off boiled rice, salted and drunk warm
recipes.sub_l: Buh chhum tui, mluh thlak a, lum lai in tur

method.en: Wash the rice twice only and keep the second water. The starch that a third wash takes away is the whole drink.
method.l: Buh chu vawi hnih chauh sil la, sil hnihna tui chu dah rawh. Vawi thumna sil-a a paih theih hnim chu in tur pumpui a ni.

method.en: Boil three kilos of rice in twenty-eight litres and drain the water off at twelve minutes. The rice goes to the next vessel and only the water is drunk.
method.l: Buh kilo thum chu litre 28-ah chhum la, minute sawmhnih ah tui chu sen chhuak rawh. Buh chu bel dangah a kal a, tui chauh in tur a ni.

method.en: Bruise the ginger and drop it in whole, then take it out. Grated sawhthing clouds the drink and a buh tui should be looked through.
method.l: Sawhthing chu dengin, a pumin thlak la, chu chu hnuah la chhuak rawh. Sawhthing thlur chuan in tur chu a tihthim a, buh tui chu a chhungthlir theih tur a ni.

method.en: Serve it warm within the hour. A buh tui gone cold sets to a jelly and twenty-five litres of it cannot be given away.
method.l: Darkar khat chhungin lumin sem rawh. Buh tui a vawt chuan a khal a, litre 25 chu pek chhuah theih a ni tawh lo.

recipes.why: One rupee twenty a head, the cheapest thing in this book. The rice is not lost — it goes into the next vessel — so all this drink costs is the ginger and the salt.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka pakhat leh sawmhnih, he lehkhabu-ah man tlawm ber. Buh chu a boral lo — bel dangah a kal — chuvangin he in tur man chu sawhthing leh mluh chauh a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. It comes off the rice vessel at noon.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Chawhnu buh bel aṭangin a chhuak.

vessel.en: The rice vessel, a draining basket and a 30 L urn. No extra cook.
vessel.l: Buh bel, tui senna bawm leh litre 30 bel. Chawmi belhchhah a ngai lo.

season.en: All year, and every day in thlasik.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thlasik lai ni tin.

recipes.name: Sanpiau
recipes.sub: Rice porridge with coriander and pepper
recipes.sub_l: Buh-bal, hnahchiar leh hmarcha nen

method.en: Sanpiau is the one Mizo dish a visitor is likely to have met, and it is sold at every roadside stall in Aizawl. It is rice porridge and almost nothing else.
method.l: Sanpiau hi mikhual pawhin an hriat ngei thin a ni a, Aizawl kawtthler dawr tinah an hralh.

method.en: Cook the rice with plenty of water until the grains have burst completely. This is a porridge and it should pour, not hold its shape.
method.l: Buh chu tui tam takin a chhia hlen hlen thlengin thlawp rawh. Hei hi bal a ni a, a luang tur a ni.

method.en: Roast the rice flour separately on a dry pan until it smells nutty and turns pale gold.
method.l: Buh chhang chu bel ro-ah a rim a chhuah hlen thlengin kang rawh.

method.en: Sprinkle the roasted flour over each bowl at the counter, not into the pot. Stirred into the vessel it thickens the whole batch within ten minutes and the last bowls are paste.
method.l: Buh chhang vut chu bel-ah dah lovin, sem hmunah bel tin chungah theh rawh. Bel-a dah chuan minute 10-ah a khauh vek ang.

method.en: Season with a great deal of crushed black pepper. Sanpiau is peppered rather than chillied and that is what distinguishes it.
method.l: Hmarcha dum tam tak dah rawh. Sanpiau hi hmarcha sen ni lovin hmarcha dum a ni.

method.en: Finish each bowl with chopped coriander, a squeeze of lemon and salt at the counter.
method.l: Bel tinah hnahchiar, serthlum leh chi chu sem hmunah dah rawh.

recipes.why: Six kilos of rice feeds a hundred. The flour goes on at the counter or the whole batch sets.
recipes.why_l: Buh kg 6 chuan mi 100 a chawm. Buh chhang chu sem hmunah dah tur a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Sem hma minute 50 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel. One cook who stays with it.
vessel.l: Bel rit 40 L. Chaw suk pakhat, a bulah awm reng tur.

season.en: All year. What Aizawl eats standing at a roadside stall.
season.l: Kum tin. Aizawl-ah kawtthler dawrah an ei thin.

recipes.name: Chhangban
recipes.sub: Steamed rice cake
recipes.sub_l: Buh chhang chhum

method.en: Soak both rices together five hours and grind to a smooth batter, thick enough to drop slowly from a ladle.
method.l: Buh pahnih chu darkar 5 dah la, a tui a nal hlen thlengin hnawih rawh.

method.en: The kilo of sticky rice in eight is what holds the cake together. All plain rice gives a cake that crumbles as it is lifted.
method.l: Buh nal kg khat hi a phum khawmtu a ni. Buh nal tel lo chuan a chhe zui ang.

method.en: Leave the batter overnight in a warm corner. It sours slightly and that slight sour is the whole character of the cake.
method.l: A tui chu zan khat hmun lum-ah dah rawh. A thur tlemte a ni ang a, chu chu a tur ber a ni.

method.en: Do not let it go past a night. Over-soured batter gives a cake that smells sharp and nobody eats a second one.
method.l: Zan khat aia rei dah suh. A thur lutuk chuan tu mahin a pahnihna an ei tawh lo vang.

method.en: Stir in the roasted sesame and salt, pour into greased flat trays, and steam twenty minutes.
method.l: Chhawhchhi kang leh chi dah la, tray hnawih-ah theh la, minute 20 chhum rawh.

method.en: Let the cake cool ten minutes in the tray before cutting. Cut hot it tears along every line.
method.l: At hmain tray-ah minute 10 chhung tidai rawh. A lum lai a at chuan a keh vek ang.

recipes.why: One overnight ferment and twenty minutes of steam. No oil at all, which is true of most of this book.
recipes.why_l: Zan khat thur a, minute 20 chhum. Hriak reng reng a tel lo.

start.en: Grind the soaked rice the night before and let the batter stand.
start.l: Buh dah chu zan khan hnawih la, a tui chu dah rawh.

vessel.en: Three steamers with flat trays. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Chhum na 3 leh tray. Chaw suk 3.

season.en: All year.
season.l: Kum tin.

recipes.name: Rice Flour Pitha
recipes.sub: Plain steamed rice flour rolls
recipes.sub_l: Buh chhang chhum, thil dah lo

method.en: Pour boiling water onto the rice flour, not the flour into the water, and stir hard with a wooden spoon.
method.l: Tui tibuk chu buh chhang chungah theh rawh, chhang chu tui-ah theh suh.

method.en: Boiling water, not warm. Rice flour has no gluten and it is the heat that binds it — a lukewarm dough will not come together at all.
method.l: Tui lum ni lovin tui tibuk. Buh chhang-ah gluten a awm lo a, a lum chauhin a phum khawm thei.

method.en: Knead as soon as it can be handled, while still genuinely hot. A cooled dough crumbles and cannot be rescued.
method.l: Kut hmanga hman theih hun tak takah, a lum lai chuan sut rawh. A dai chuan a chhe a, siam tha leh theih a ni tawh lo.

method.en: Roll into short thick fingers between oiled palms and keep them covered as they are made.
method.l: Kutphah hriak nen kutthlung ang maiin siam la, siam zel chuan puanin khuh rawh.

method.en: Steam twenty minutes on a cloth-lined tray rather than directly on the metal.
method.l: Thir chungah dah lovin puan phah chungah minute 20 chhum rawh.

method.en: Serve warm. These go hard within half an hour and are made to the line rather than in advance.
method.l: A lum lai sem rawh. Darkar chanve chhungin a khauh ta a, sem lai tak atan siam tur a ni.

recipes.why: Boiling water and hot hands. Mizoram eats rice, and this is what happens when rice has to become a breakfast.
recipes.why_l: Tui tibuk leh kut lum. Mizoram-ah buh an ei a, buh chu zingchaw a nihna dan chu hei a ni.

start.en: The dough must be made with boiling water and used hot.
start.l: A chhang chu tui tibuk hmangin siam tur a ni, a lum lai hman tur.

vessel.en: Three steamers and cloth. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Chhum na 3 leh puan. Chaw suk 3.

season.en: All year.
season.l: Kum tin.

recipes.name: Boiled Tubers with Chilli
recipes.sub: Sweet potato, taro and yam, boiled
recipes.sub_l: Bahra, dawl leh alu chhum

method.en: This is the plainest thing in the book and it is what a Mizo household eats before daylight. Nothing is fried and nothing is spiced.
method.l: Hei hi lehkhabu-a thil awl ber a ni a, Mizo chhungkuain khaw var hmain an ei thin. Hriak a tel lo, hmangte pawh a tel lo.

method.en: Boil each tuber separately. Sweet potato, taro and yam cook at quite different rates and together the sweet potato is mush before the yam is done.
method.l: Bahra tin chu hran hranin thlawp rawh. An min hun a inang lo.

method.en: Handle raw taro with oiled hands or cloth. The raw sap makes the palms itch badly and it does not wash off easily.
method.l: Dawl hel chu kut hriak emaw puan hmangin chelh rawh. A hnim chuan kut a titha lo hle.

method.en: Boil the taro with the skin on and peel it after. Peeled raw it goes slimy in the water.
method.l: Dawl chu a hnah nen thlawp la, a hnuah hlip rawh. Hel a hlip chuan tui-ah a nal ang.

method.en: Roast the sesame, cool it, and pound it with the salt and a very small quantity of dried chilli into a dry dip.
method.l: Chhawhchhi kang la, tidai la, chi leh hmarcha ro tlemte nen sukin chartawk ro siam rawh.

method.en: Serve the tubers whole and hot with the chilli salt beside them. Nothing is mashed and nothing is dressed.
method.l: Bahra chu a pum leh a lum lain sem la, a chhehvelah chartawk dah rawh.

recipes.why: No oil, no vessel to scrub, and it is what these hills actually eat at dawn.
recipes.why_l: Hriak a tel lo, bel sil a ngai lo, tin he tlanga khaw var hmaa an ei tak chu a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Sem hma minute 50 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: Two 40 L vessels. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 40 L pahnih. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: October to March, when the tubers come out of the ground.
season.l: October atanga March thleng, leia bahra chhuah lai.

recipes.name: Vaimim Chhum
recipes.sub: Sweetcorn steamed on the cob and turned with sesame and salt
recipes.sub_l: Vaimim a hlingin chhum, chhawhchhi leh mluh nen a chhawm

method.en: Steam it on the cob and strip it after. Kernels cut off first lose their milk into the water and twenty kilos comes out dry.
method.l: A hling nen chhum la, a hnuah phel chhuak rawh. A hmasaa phel chhuah mim chuan a hnutetui chu tui-ah a hlum a, kilo sawmhnih chu a ro thla.

method.en: Twelve minutes in the steamer and no more. A vaimim steamed twenty minutes is a starch and the sweetness is in the water.
method.l: Chhum belah minute sawmhnih chauh, chu aia rei lo. Minute sawmhnih chhung chhum vaimim chu a khal a, a thlumna chu tui-ah a awm.

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi until the seeds jump and crush it coarse. A powder disappears into twenty kilos and nothing is tasted.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu a chi a chhuah thlengin kang la, sang zawkin dengin. Vut chuan kilo sawmhnih zingah a bo a, engmah tui a awm lo.

method.en: Raw mustard oil turned through at the counter. Heated oil on hot vaimim cooks the kernel again and the tray goes leathery.
method.l: Sem hnaih velah antam hriak thing chu chhawm luh rawh. Vaimim lum chunga hriak lum chuan mim chu a chhum leh a, tray chu a khau.

recipes.why: Seven rupees forty a head. In fur the Mamit vaimim is fifteen rupees a kilo and this is the breakfast a kitchen can put out with one vessel and one cook.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sarih leh sawmli. Fur lai-ah Mamit vaimim chu kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, hei hi bel khat leh chawmi pakhat hmangin chawthlengin a siam theih zingchaw a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, most of it stripping the cobs.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, a tam zawk chu hling phel chhuah a ni.

vessel.en: A large steamer and two wide trays. Two cooks for the stripping.
vessel.l: Chhum bel lian leh tray zau pahnih. Phel chhuah tur chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Fur to favang, while the vaimim is in the fields.
season.l: Fur aṭanga favang thleng, vaimim lo-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Sooji Upma
recipes.sub: Semolina roasted dry and turned with the winter vegetables
recipes.sub_l: Sooji a ro-in kang a, thlasik thlai nen a chhawm

method.en: Roast the sooji dry until it smells of it and no further. Under-roasted, six kilos goes to a single lump the moment the water is in.
method.l: Sooji chu a rim a chhuah thlengin ro-in kang la, chu aia rei lo. Kang tawk lo chuan tui a luh vek veleh kilo ruk chu bal khat a lo ni.

method.en: Two and a half measures of water to one of sooji. Three gives a porridge and two gives a sand and neither can be corrected on the fire.
method.l: Sooji pakhat-ah tui teh nihna hnih leh chanve. Thum chuan bawl a siam a, hnih chuan sepaipui a siam a, mei chungah a pahnihin siamthat theih a ni lo.

method.en: Add the water boiling and never cold. Cold water on hot sooji seizes and the vessel is lumps that no ladle will break.
method.l: Tui chhum lai chu thlak la, vawt chu thlak ngai lo. Sooji lum chunga tui vawt chuan a khal a, bel chu bal a lo ni a, chawpna engmahin a tichhe thei lo.

method.en: Off the fire, lid on, five minutes. A sooji that has not stood is raw in the middle and twenty-six kilos cannot be recooked.
method.l: Mei aṭangin la chhuak, khuh la, minute nga. Awm reh lo sooji chu a laiah a thing a, kilo sawmhnih leh ruk chu chhum leh theih a ni lo.

recipes.why: Ten rupees eighty a head and it is on the counter in forty minutes. On a morning when the chhangban pans are not free, this is what the kitchen sends out.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmriat, tin minute sawmli chhungin sem hnaih velah a awm. Chhangban bel te an zalen loh zing lai chuan hei hi chawthlengin a thawn chhuak a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and five of them under the lid.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, chung zinga minute nga chu khuh a.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai with a lid. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 30 kadai zau. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: All year, and every second morning in thlasik.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thlasik lai zing hnih danah.

recipes.name: Balhla Pitha
recipes.sub: Ripe banana mashed into rice flour and steamed in a leaf
recipes.sub_l: Balhla hmin buh chhang-ah deng a, hnah chhungah a chhum

method.en: Mash the balhla by hand and keep some lumps. A blended banana gives a batter with nothing to find and four hundred pitha taste the same as a plain one.
method.l: Balhla chu kut hmangin dengin, a bal tlem chu dah rawh. Blender-a tih balhla chuan hmuh tur engmah nei lo chhang a siam a, pitha 400 chu pitha ngaihngai ang bawkin a tui.

method.en: Warm the banana leaf over the flame a moment before it is folded. A cold leaf cracks along the vein and the batter is in the water.
method.l: Balhla hnah chu a fawlh hmain mei chungah hun tlemte lum rawh. Hnah vawt chu a hri zawnin a kek a, chhang chu tui-ah a hlum.

method.en: The riper the balhla the less kurtai. A green banana in a pitha is bitter and no amount of jaggery covers it.
method.l: Balhla a hmin zawk chuan kurtai a tlem zawk a ngai. Pitha chhunga balhla hring chu a khah a, kurtai engzat pawh chuan a thup thei lo.

method.en: Twenty minutes in the steamer and take one out to test it. A pitha that sticks to the leaf has four minutes more to go.
method.l: Chhum belah minute sawmhnih dah la, teh nan pakhat la chhuak rawh. Hnah-a bet pitha chu minute li a tul nghal.

recipes.why: Nine rupees fifty a head. The banana leaves come off the tree behind the kitchen and in Kolasib the balhla is twenty rupees a kilo.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka kua leh sawmnga. Balhla hnah chu chawthleng hnung lam thingkung aṭangin a lo chhuak a, Kolasib-ah balhla chu kilo khat tangka sawmhnih a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes for four hundred, most of it folding.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Za li tan minute sawmkua, a tam zawk chu fawlh a ni.

vessel.en: Two large steamers and a folding table. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Chhum bel lian pahnih leh fawlhna dawhkan. Chawmi pathum.

season.en: All year, and at Mim Kut above all.
season.l: Kum tin, tin Mim Kut-ah a bik takin.

recipes.name: Sabu Sanpiau
recipes.sub: Millet cooked to a porridge and finished with chhang water
recipes.sub_l: Sabu chu bawl anga chhum a, chhang tui nen a tihrem

method.en: A litre and a half of chhang water in thirty litres and no more. Chhang is what makes a sanpiau slip on the tongue and too much of it tastes of soap.
method.l: Litre 30-ah chhang tui litre khat leh chanve chauh, chu aia tam lo. Chhang chuan sanpiau chu leiah a tiherhrawl a, a tam lutuk chuan sabuar angin a tui.

method.en: Roast the sabu dry five minutes before it is washed. It is what keeps five kilos from going to a single paste and it costs nothing.
method.l: Sabu chu sil hmain minute nga ro-in kang rawh. Chu chuan kilo nga chu bal khat lo nih atangin a humhim a, engmah a senso lo.

method.en: Stir the bottom every four minutes. Millet sinks and thirty litres burns under it with no smell reaching the cook.
method.l: Minute li danin a hnuai chu chhawm rawh. Sabu chu a thla a, litre 30 chu a hnuaiah a kang a, chawmi hnenah a rim a thleng lo.

method.en: Black pepper and coriander at the counter. A sanpiau that has stood twenty minutes with the pepper stirred in tastes of nothing but pepper.
method.l: Hmarcha dum leh dhania chu sem hnaih velah. Hmarcha dum chhawm luha minute sawmhnih awm sanpiau chu hmarcha dum lo chu engmah tui a nei lo.

recipes.why: Eight rupees thirty a head. Sabu grows on a Champhai jhum where rice will not, and five kilos of it feeds a hundred at breakfast.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka riat leh sawmthum. Buh a chuah loh Champhai lo-ah sabu chu a chuang a, kilo nga chuan zingchaw-ah mi za a chawm.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes on a low fire.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Mei tlem chungah minute sawmnga.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Litre 40 bel rit. Chawmi pakhat, a kalsan lo tur.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, after the jhum is cut.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, lo an at hnuah.

recipes.name: Hmarcha Rawt
recipes.sub: Pounded chilli with salt
recipes.sub_l: Hmarcha suk, chi nen

method.en: Hmarcha rawt means pounded chilli and that is the entire dish. It is on the table at every Mizo meal and nothing here is cooked in oil.
method.l: Hmarcha rawt tih chu hmarcha suk tihna a ni a, chu chu a zawng zawng a ni. Chaw tinah dawhkan chungah a awm.

method.en: Roast the chillies, tomato and ginger whole over an open flame until the skins blister and blacken in patches.
method.l: Hmarcha, tomato leh sawhthing chu a pumin mei chungah a hnah a dum hlen thlengin kang rawh.

method.en: Roasting is what makes this a Mizo chutney rather than a ground one. Nothing here goes in raw.
method.l: Mei-a kan hi Mizo chartawk nihna a ni. Hel reng reng a tel lo.

method.en: Rub the blackened skins off but do not wash them. Washing takes the smoke off and the smoke is the point.
method.l: A hnah dum chu nawi chhuak la, sil suh. A sil chuan meikhu a bo ang a, meikhu chu a pawimawh ber a ni.

method.en: Pound in a mortar rather than grinding. A machine emulsifies it and it turns thin; pounded it stays rough, which is how it is eaten.
method.l: Machine-a hnawih lovin sum-ah suk rawh. Machine chuan a tui a, suk chuan a per reng.

method.en: Use the bird's eye chilli sparingly and taste before adding more. Two hundred grams in this quantity is already sharp.
method.l: Hmarcha te chu tlem te dah la, tem hmasa rawh. Gram 200 pawh a ur tawh a ni.

recipes.why: On the table at every meal. Roasted rather than ground, and it takes fifteen minutes.
recipes.why_l: Chaw tinah a awm. Hnawih ni lovin mei-a kan, minute 15 chauh a la.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Make it the same day. Start thirty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Chumi ni-ah siam rawh.

vessel.en: An open flame and a mortar. One cook.
vessel.l: Mei leh sum. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year. On every Mizo plate at every meal.
season.l: Kum tin. Mizo thleng tinah, chaw tinah a awm.

recipes.name: Bekang Chartawk
recipes.sub: Fermented soybean pounded with chilli
recipes.sub_l: Bekang, hmarcha nen suk

method.en: Bekang is fermented soybean and it is the vegetarian answer to sa-um, the fermented pork fat that seasons most Mizo cooking.
method.l: Bekang hi bepui thur a ni a, sa-um aiawh a ni.

method.en: Buy it fresh and in small quantity. Bekang keeps about three weeks and an old batch smells of ammonia rather than of soybean.
method.l: Thar leh tlem te lei rawh. Bekang chu chhun thum vel a awm thei a, a hlui chuan a rim a chhia.

method.en: Roast the tomato, ginger and chillies over an open flame and rub the skins off without washing.
method.l: Tomato, sawhthing leh hmarcha chu mei chungah kang la, sil lovin a hnah nawi chhuak rawh.

method.en: Pound the roasted vegetables first and add the bekang last, working it in by hand rather than in the mortar.
method.l: Mei-a kan te chu suk hmasa la, bekang chu a tawpah kutin chal rawh.

method.en: Pounded hard, bekang turns to a smooth paste and loses the whole beans that give it its texture.
method.l: Nasa taka suk chuan bekang chu a nal vek a, a bepui pum a bo ang.

method.en: Serve at room temperature and make it the same day.
method.l: A lum lo lum lo-ah sem la, chumi ni-ah siam rawh.

recipes.why: The dish that shows how this book works: an indigenous ferment doing the job of pork fat, and nothing missing.
recipes.why_l: Lehkhabu hian a hnathawh dan a târ lang: bekang hian sa-um hna a thawh a, engmah a tlachham lo.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Make it the same day. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Chumi ni-ah siam rawh.

vessel.en: A mortar and a 6 L bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: Sum leh bel 6 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year — bekang keeps three weeks.
season.l: Kum tin — bekang chu chhun thum a awm thei.

recipes.name: Tomato Chartawk
recipes.sub: Fire-roasted tomato with ginger
recipes.sub_l: Tomato mei-a kan, sawhthing nen

method.en: This is the mild chutney, made for people who cannot take a hmarcha rawt. Every Mizo table needs one of each.
method.l: Hei hi a ur lo zawk a ni a, hmarcha rawt ei thei lo tan a ni. Dawhkan tinah pahnih an ngai.

method.en: Roast the tomatoes whole directly on the coals or an open flame until the skin blackens and splits.
method.l: Tomato chu a pumin meialh emaw mei chungah a hnah a dum a keh hlen thlengin kang rawh.

method.en: Do not use a pan. A pan gives a cooked tomato; the flame gives a smoked one, and that smoke is the whole difference.
method.l: Bel hmang suh. Bel chuan tomato thlawp mai a ni; mei chuan meikhu a pe.

method.en: Rub the blackened skin off with the fingers and do not wash it. Washing takes the smoke straight off.
method.l: A hnah dum chu kutzungin nawi chhuak la, sil suh.

method.en: Roast the ginger and chilli the same way, and toast the sesame separately on a dry pan.
method.l: Sawhthing leh hmarcha pawh chutiang bawkin kang la, chhawhchhi chu bel ro-ah hran hranin kang rawh.

method.en: Pound coarsely, stir in the coriander by hand, and serve at room temperature.
method.l: Per takin suk la, hnahchiar chu kutin chal la, a lum lo lum lo-ah sem rawh.

recipes.why: The chutney for anyone who cannot manage the bird's eye chilli, and the smoke does the work instead of the heat.
recipes.why_l: Hmarcha te ei thei lo tan chartawk a ni a, a ur ai chuan meikhu hian hna a thawk.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Keeps three days. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Ni thum a awm thei.

vessel.en: An open flame and a mortar. One cook.
vessel.l: Mei leh sum. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year, cheapest November to February.
season.l: Kum tin, November atanga February a man a tlawm ber.

recipes.name: Chhawhchhi Chartawk
recipes.sub: Sesame roasted and ground with a great deal of ginger
recipes.sub_l: Chhawhchhi kang, sawhthing tam tak nen a deng

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi until the seeds jump and take it off at once. Sesame past that point is bitter and a kilo and a half cannot be salvaged.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu a chi a chhuah thlengin kang la, chumi veleh la chhuak rawh. Chu aia kang chhawhchhi chu a khah a, kilo khat leh chanve chu chhandam theih a ni lo.

method.en: Seven hundred grams of sawhthing and it is not a mistake. In a kitchen with no onion the ginger is the whole base of this chartawk.
method.l: Sawhthing gram 700, tin hei hi diklohna a ni lo. Purun awm lo chawthleng-ah sawhthing chu he chartawk bul pumpui a ni.

method.en: Grind it warm and it gives up its own oil. That oil is the binding and no mustard oil is needed anywhere in it.
method.l: A lum lai deng la, a hriak chu amah ngeiin a chhuah ang. Chu hriak chuan a tikhawmin, a chhungah antam hriak khawi hmunah mah a tul lo.

method.en: Keep it thick enough to stand on a spoon. A thin chhawhchhi chartawk runs off the buh and the plate is a grey wash.
method.l: Chawpna chunga ding theih khawpin sang zawkin dah rawh. Chhawhchhi chartawk sek chuan buh atangin a luang thla a, thlengbel chu a vardum mai.

recipes.why: Five rupees ten a head. Chhawhchhi grows on a Mizo jhum and this is the chartawk that goes beside a plain buhfai on a thlasik day.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka nga leh sawm. Chhawhchhi chu Mizo lo-ah a chuang a, hei hi thlasik ni-a buhfai ngaihngai bula kal chartawk a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty minutes, and it is ground warm.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmthum, tin a lum lai a deng.

vessel.en: A dry pan and a grinding stone. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel ro leh sumtual lung. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and after the favang harvest above all.
season.l: Kum tin, tin favang buh seng hnuah a bik takin.

recipes.name: Antam Chartawk
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves wilted and ground with sesame and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Antam hnah a duai, chhawhchhi leh hmarcha nen a deng

method.en: Wilt the leaves in a dry pan two minutes and no more. Boiled, four kilos of antam gives a chartawk the colour of a wet road.
method.l: Hnah te chu bel ro-ah minute hnih duai la, chu aia rei lo. Chhum chuan antam kilo li chuan kawng hnawng rawng chartawk a siam.

method.en: Squeeze the wilted leaf dry before grinding. The water that comes out is bitter and a chartawk made with it goes back to the kitchen.
method.l: Deng hmain hnah duai chu ro-in chhir rawh. A chhuak tui chu a khah a, chu nen siam chartawk chu chawthlengah a rawn kir.

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi separately. Ground raw with the leaf it tastes of nothing and five hundred grams is wasted.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu hran hranin kang rawh. Hnah nen a thing lai deng chuan engmah tui a nei lo a, gram 500 chu a boral.

method.en: Lemon at the counter and not in the grinding. Lemon in a green chartawk turns it grey within the hour.
method.l: Serthlum chu deng lai ni lovin sem hnaih velah. Chartawk hring chhunga serthlum chuan darkar khat chhungin a tivardum.

recipes.why: Three rupees fifty a head, the cheapest chartawk on this shelf. In thlasik the antam is fifteen rupees a kilo at Bara Bazar and four kilos does a hundred plates.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka thum leh sawmnga, he thlaite-a chartawk man tlawm ber. Thlasik lai-ah antam chu Bara Bazar-ah kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, kilo li chuan thlengbel za a tling.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty minutes, and it is made on the day.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmthum, tin chu ni-ah siam a ni.

vessel.en: A dry pan, a squeezing cloth and a grinding stone. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel ro, chhirna puan leh sumtual lung. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, while the antam is in the market.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, antam bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Maian Chartawk
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo squeezed dry and crushed with roasted chilli
recipes.sub_l: Maian chhir ro a, hmarcha kang nen a deng

method.en: Squeeze the maian dry and throw the liquor. The liquor is the whole smell and in a chartawk that is eaten a spoon at a time it is far too much.
method.l: Maian chu ro-in chhir la, a tui chu paih rawh. A tui chu rim pumpui a ni a, chawpna khatin ei chartawk-ah chuan a tam lutuk.

method.en: Roast the chilli on the flame and crush it in the hand. A powder gives heat only; the pieces are what a Mizo plate looks for beside the buh.
method.l: Hmarcha chu mei chungah kang la, kut hmangin dengin. Vut chuan thautthawh chauh a pe; Mizo thlengbelin buh bula a zawn chu a tluang tluangte a ni.

method.en: No oil anywhere in it. The maian carries its own and a spoon of oil turns two and a half kilos into a paste.
method.l: A chhungah khawi hmunah mah hriak a awm lo. Maian chuan amah a hriak a nei a, hriak chawpna khat chuan kilo hnih leh chanve chu bal a siam.

method.en: Make it the morning it is served. A maian chartawk standing a day ferments again in the jar and the lid comes off by itself.
method.l: Sem ni zing ngeiah siam rawh. Ni khat awm maian chartawk chu bel chhungah a thur leh a, a khuhna chu amah ngeiin a chhuak.

recipes.why: Four rupees a head. Two and a half kilos of maian out of a jar put down in fur gives a hundred plates the one thing a Mizo will name first.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka li. Fur lai-a dah bel aṭanga maian kilo hnih leh chanve chuan thlengbel za-ah Mizoin a hmasa bera a sawi chu a pe.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Twenty minutes on the morning it is served.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Sem ni zingah minute sawmhnih.

vessel.en: A squeezing cloth, an open flame and a grinding stone. One cook.
vessel.l: Chhirna puan, mei hawng leh sumtual lung. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, out of the jar put down in fur.
season.l: Kum tin, fur lai-a dah bel aṭangin.

recipes.name: Sawhthing Chartawk
recipes.sub: Ginger scraped, crushed raw with lemon and no oil
recipes.sub_l: Sawhthing hlip, serthlum nen a thing lai a deng, hriak tel lo

method.en: Scrape the skin with a spoon and never peel it with a knife. The layer just under the skin is where the whole smell sits.
method.l: A hnawng chu chawpna hmangin hlip la, chhema hlip ngai lo. A hnawng hnuai vela awm chu rim pumpui awmna a ni.

method.en: Crush it and do not grind it fine. A fine sawhthing chartawk is a paste that cannot be picked up on a finger.
method.l: Dengin, sang zawkin deng suh. Sawhthing chartawk sang chu bal a ni a, kutzung hmangin la theih a ni lo.

method.en: No oil and no heat at any point. The lemon is the whole preservative and it works only if the jar is dry.
method.l: Khawi hun mahah hriak leh lum a awm lo. Serthlum chu vawn nan pumpui a ni a, bel a ro chauh chuan a hna a thawk.

method.en: Two kilos and no more at a time. A sawhthing chartawk is at its best for four days and after that it is a hot water.
method.l: Vawi khatah kilo hnih chauh, chu aia tam lo. Sawhthing chartawk chu ni li a tha ber a, chu hnuah chuan tui thautthawh a ni mai.

recipes.why: Four rupees thirty a head, and it is the one thing on a heavy Mizo plate that will settle a stomach after a zawngtah bai.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka li leh sawmthum, tin zawngtah bai hnua pum tidam thei Mizo thlengbel rit chunga thil pakhat chu hei a ni.

start.en: Nothing cooks. Twenty minutes at the stone.
start.l: Engmah chhum a ngai lo. Lung hnenah minute sawmhnih.

vessel.en: A grinding stone and a dry jar. One cook.
vessel.l: Sumtual lung leh bel ro. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and made twice a week.
season.l: Kum tin, tin chawlhkar khatah vawi hnih siam a ni.

recipes.name: Zawngtah Chartawk
recipes.sub: Tree bean shelled, roasted whole and crushed with chilli
recipes.sub_l: Zawngtah phel, a pumin kang a, hmarcha nen a deng

method.en: Roast the zawngtah in the pod on an open flame and shell it after. Shelled first, the bean dries out and three kilos tastes of nothing.
method.l: Zawngtah chu a kawr nen mei hawng chungah kang la, a hnuah phel rawh. Hmasain phel chuan be chu a ro thla a, kilo thum chu engmah tui a nei lo.

method.en: Keep the beans whole and crush them coarse. A zawngtah ground fine smells twice as strong and half the hall will not take it.
method.l: Be te chu a pumin dah la, sang zawkin dengin. Zawngtah deng sang chuan a rim a nghet zual a, in chhung a chanve chuan an la duh lo ang.

method.en: Make it in a corner of the yard and not in the kitchen. Three kilos of roasting zawngtah is smelt across the compound and it stays in the walls.
method.l: Chawthlengah ni lovin huan kilkhawrah siam rawh. Zawngtah kilo thum kang chu huan pumpuiah a rim a, bang-ah a awm reng.

method.en: A spoon on the plate and no more. This is the strongest thing on this shelf and a ladle of it takes the meal away from everything else.
method.l: Thlengbelah chawpna khat chauh, chu aia tam lo. He thlaite-a thil nghet ber chu hei a ni a, a chawpna lianin chaw dang zawng zawng chu a hmang bo.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head. Zawngtah is on the Lawngtlai trees for six weeks in thal and of everything on this shelf it is the one a Mizo away from home asks for first.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka kua. Thal lai-ah Lawngtlai thingkungah zawngtah chu chawlhkar ruk a awm a, he thlaite-a thil zawng zawng zingah in aṭanga hla Mizoin a hmasa bera a dil chu hei a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, most of it roasting and shelling.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, a tam zawk chu kang leh phel a ni.

vessel.en: An open flame in the yard and a grinding stone. One cook.
vessel.l: Huan-a mei hawng leh sumtual lung. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Thal to fur, while the zawngtah is on the tree.
season.l: Thal aṭanga fur thleng, zawngtah thingkungah a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Bepui Bai
recipes.sub: Large hill beans boiled with chhang
recipes.sub_l: Bepui, chhang nen thlawp

method.en: Soak the beans eight hours and throw the soaking water away.
method.l: Bepui chu darkar 8 dah la, a tui chu paih rawh.

method.en: Add a little chhang to the cooking water. The alkali softens the skin and cuts the cooking time by about a third — this is the whole reason chhang exists.
method.l: Thlawpna tui-ah chhang tlemte dah rawh. Chhang hian a hnah a tinawi a, a min hun pathum zela pakhat a tihtlem.

method.en: Do not add more than the recipe says. Too much chhang gives a soapy taste and a slippery texture that cannot be corrected.
method.l: Ziak aia tam dah suh. Chhang tam lutuk chuan a chhe a, siam tha leh theih a ni tawh lo.

method.en: Cook until a bean crushes to nothing between finger and thumb. Merely soft is not cooked.
method.l: Bepui chu kutzung karah a chhia hlen thlengin thlawp rawh. A nawi mai chu a min tihna a ni lo.

method.en: Crumble the bekang in and cook a further fifteen minutes. It goes in early rather than at the end, unlike in a chartawk.
method.l: Bekang chu chal la, minute 15 chhung thlawp belh rawh.

method.en: Keep it thin. A bai is a broth eaten with rice, not a thick dal, and thickening it is the commonest mistake a plains cook makes here.
method.l: A tui takin dah rawh. Bai chu buh nen ei tur tui a ni a, dal khauh a ni lo.

recipes.why: Chhang is the whole technique. It softens the bean, keeps the colour and cuts the fuel, and nothing else does all three.
recipes.why_l: Chhang hi a hna ber a ni. Bepui a tinawi a, a rong a humhalh a, thing pawh a tihtlem.

start.en: Soak the beans eight hours. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: Bepui chu darkar 8 dah rawh. Sem hma darkar 2:30 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L pressure vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Pressure bel 30 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year. The bean a Mizo kitchen always has.
season.l: Kum tin. Mizo chaw suk in-ah a awm reng.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Bai
recipes.sub: Split moong cooked thin with ginger
recipes.sub_l: Mung, sawhthing nen thlawp

method.en: Wash the moong dal in three changes of water. Moong throws more starch than any other dal and unwashed it foams over the vessel.
method.l: Mung chu tui vawi thum thlakin sil rawh. Mung hi a hnim a tam ber a, sil lo chuan bel a liam ang.

method.en: Cook with the turmeric until it falls apart completely.
method.l: Aieng nen a chhia hlen thlengin thlawp rawh.

method.en: Do not add chhang to a moong dal. Split pulses need no alkali and it makes them slippery.
method.l: Mung-ah chuan chhang dah suh. Be chhia-ah chuan a ngai lo.

method.en: Season with black pepper rather than chilli. This is the dish given to someone who is unwell and chilli defeats the purpose.
method.l: Hmarcha ai chuan hmarcha dum dah rawh. Hei hi mi dam lo tan a ni.

method.en: Keep it thin, as a bai should be. It is poured over rice rather than eaten beside it.
method.l: Bai anga a tui takin dah rawh. Buh chungah leih tur a ni.

method.en: Stir the ginger in off the fire and finish with coriander.
method.l: Sawhthing chu mei atanga la chhuah hnuah chal la, hnahchiar dah rawh.

recipes.why: The dish to have ready when someone cannot eat what everyone else is eating. Nothing in it is heavy.
recipes.why_l: Mi thenkhat chuan mi dang ei an ei theih loh hunah a tha. Rit a tel lo.

start.en: No soaking needed. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Dah a ngai lo. Sem hma minute 50 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 30 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year. The dal for a sick tray.
season.l: Kum tin. Mi dam lo tan chaw a ni.

recipes.name: Rice Bean Bai
recipes.sub: Small hill beans with bekang
recipes.sub_l: Behliang, bekang nen

method.en: Rice bean is the small hill pulse grown on the jhum slopes alongside the rice, and it stores dry for a year.
method.l: Behliang hi lo-a buh nen thlan tel a ni a, a ro chuan kum khat a awm thei.

method.en: Soak six hours and throw the soaking water away.
method.l: Darkar 6 dah la, a tui chu paih rawh.

method.en: Add the chhang to the cooking water rather than the soaking water. Alkali in the soak breaks the skin down too far and the beans collapse.
method.l: Chhang chu thlawpna tui-ah dah rawh, dahna tui-ah dah suh.

method.en: Cook until completely soft. These take longer than they look — allow forty minutes in a pressure vessel.
method.l: A nawi hlen thlengin thlawp rawh. Pressure bel-ah minute 40 a la.

method.en: Crumble the bekang in for the last fifteen minutes and let it break down into the broth.
method.l: A tawp minute 15-ah bekang chal la, a tui-ah a chhia phal rawh.

method.en: Keep it thin and finish with coriander off the fire.
method.l: A tui takin dah la, mei atanga la chhuah hnuah hnahchiar dah rawh.

recipes.why: Stores dry for a year, costs less than bepui, and it is what a hill kitchen falls back on in March.
recipes.why_l: Kum khat a awm thei a, bepui aiin a man a tlawm.

start.en: Soak six hours. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: Darkar 6 dah rawh. Sem hma darkar 2 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L pressure vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Pressure bel 30 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year — the bean stores dry for a year.
season.l: Kum tin — a ro chuan kum khat a awm thei.

recipes.name: Masoor Bai
recipes.sub: Whole masoor cooked till the skins split, with chhang water
recipes.sub_l: Masoor pum chhum, a hnawng a kek thlengin, chhang tui nen

method.en: Soak the masoor two hours. The whole lentil carries a skin and an unsoaked one is still a bead when the vessel comes off the fire.
method.l: Masoor chu darkar hnih tui-ah dah rawh. Masoor pum chuan hnawng a nei a, tui-a dah loh chu bel mei aṭanga la chhuah lai pawhin be ang bawkin a awm.

method.en: Half a litre of chhang water in twenty litres and no more. Chhang opens the skin; too much of it and the whole vessel tastes of soap.
method.l: Litre 20-ah chhang tui litre chanve chauh, chu aia tam lo. Chhang chuan hnawng chu a tihawng; a tam lutuk chuan bel pumpui chu sabuar angin a tui.

method.en: Salt only after the skins split. Salted early, masoor holds its skin and an hour more on the fire will not open it.
method.l: A hnawng a kek hnu chauhvin mluh thlak rawh. Hmain mluh thlak chuan masoor chuan a hnawng chu a vawn a, mei chungah darkar khat belhchhah pawhin a tihawng thei lo.

method.en: Tomato in the last ten minutes only. Cooked from the start it goes to a paste and the bai is a soup with no lentil to be seen.
method.l: Tomato chu minute sawm hnuhnung berah chauh. Tir aṭanga chhum chuan bal a lo ni a, bai chu masoor hmuh loh tui a lo ni.

recipes.why: Eight rupees sixty a head, and masoor is the cheapest whole pulse at Bara Bazar eight months of the year. It cooks in half the time a bepui takes.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka riat leh sawmruk, tin kum chhunga thla riat chu Bara Bazar-ah masoor chu be pum man tlawm ber a ni. Bepui hun a hmuh chanve chhungin a chhum.

start.en: Masoor soaks two hours. Three hours before the bell in all.
start.l: Masoor chu darkar hnih tui-ah a awm. Dar a ri hmain darkar thum a tul.

vessel.en: A 25 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 25 bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and every second day in thlasik.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thlasik lai ni hnih danah.

recipes.name: Chana Dal Bai
recipes.sub: Chana dal soaked long and cooked to hold its shape
recipes.sub_l: Chana dal rei tak tui-ah dah, a lam vawn theih tura chhum

method.en: Soak it four hours and not two. Chana is the hardest dal in this store room and a short soak means an hour more on the fire.
method.l: Darkar li tui-ah dah la, hnih ni lo. He thil dahna-ah chana chu dal nghet ber a ni a, tui-a dah tawi chuan mei chungah darkar khat belhchhah a awlsam.

method.en: This is the one bai in the book where a whole grain of dal is a good sign. Keep it loose and let the chana be seen.
method.l: He lehkhabu-ah dal chi pum a awm a tha bai pakhat chu hei a ni. Sekin dah la, chana chu hmuh theih ang che.

method.en: Skim the froth off in the first ten minutes. Chana froth left in the vessel gives twenty litres a taste of soap.
method.l: Minute sawm hmasa berah a phuk chu la chhuak rawh. Bel chhunga nghak chana phuk chuan litre 20 chu sabuar tui a pe.

method.en: Ghee generously at the end. Chana dal is dry in the mouth and without the ghee a devotee stops halfway down the plate.
method.l: A tawpah ghee chu tam takin thlak rawh. Chana dal chu kaah a ro a, ghee tel lo chuan mi chuan thlengbel chanveah a ngamawi.

recipes.why: Ten rupees twenty a head and it holds a devotee longer than any other bai here. On the morning of a long walk this is what the kitchen sends out.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmhnih, tin hetah bai dang zawng zawng aiin mi chu a vawn rei zawk. Kal rei zing lai chuan hei hi chawthlengin a thawn chhuak a ni.

start.en: Chana dal soaks four hours. Five hours before the bell in all.
start.l: Chana dal chu darkar li tui-ah a awm. Dar a ri hmain darkar nga a tul.

vessel.en: A 25 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nghet nei litre 25 bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and before any long walking day.
season.l: Kum tin, tin kal rei tur ni hmaah.

recipes.name: Arhar Bai
recipes.sub: Toor dal cooked thin with tomato and a leaf of coriander
recipes.sub_l: Arhar dal tomato nen sekin a chhum, dhania hnah nen

method.en: Roast the arhar dry five minutes before it is washed. It is what keeps three kilos from going to a single paste and it costs nothing.
method.l: Arhar chu sil hmain minute nga ro-in kang rawh. Chu chuan kilo thum chu bal khat lo nih atangin a humhim a, engmah a senso lo.

method.en: Nothing soaks. Arhar goes soft in forty minutes from dry and a soaked one falls apart before the tomato is in.
method.l: Engmah tui-ah dah a ngai lo. Arhar chu ro atangin minute sawmliah a nem a, tui-a dah chu tomato luh hmain a chhe hlum.

method.en: Keep it thin enough to drink. A thick arhar bai on a Mizo plate is eaten with the fingers and nobody finishes it.
method.l: In theih khawpin sekin dah rawh. Mizo thlengbel chunga arhar bai sang chu kutzung hmangin ei a ni a, tuman a zo lo.

method.en: The tempering goes over it at the counter. Poured in the kitchen, the smell is gone by the time the vessel crosses the yard.
method.l: A tihremna chu sem hnaih velah a chungah thlak a ni. Chawthlengah thlak chuan bel chu huan a kan hun ah a rim a bo tawh.

recipes.why: Nine rupees forty a head and it is on the counter in fifty minutes. It is the bai for the day a kitchen is short of both time and cooks.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka kua leh sawmli, tin minute sawmnga chhungin sem hnaih velah a awm. Chawthlengin hun leh chawmi a tlachham ni-a bai chu hei a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmnga.

vessel.en: A 25 L vessel and a tempering pan. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 25 bel leh tihremna bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and twice a week in thlasik.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thlasik lai chawlhkar khatah vawi hnih.

recipes.name: Be Var Bai
recipes.sub: White beans cooked long with chhang water until they break
recipes.sub_l: Be var chu chhang tui nen rei tak chhum, a kek thlengin

method.en: Soak them twelve hours and cook them in the soaking water. Fresh water gives a pale vessel however long it boils.
method.l: Darkar sawmpakhat leh pahnih tui-ah dah la, a dahna tui-ah ngei chhum rawh. Tui thar chuan a chhum rei pawhin bel eng lo a siam.

method.en: Leave the vessel uncovered while the chhang works. Under a lid it froths over and half of twenty-two litres is on the floor.
method.l: Chhang a thawh chhung chuan bel chu khuh lovin dah rawh. Khuh chuan a phuk a luang chhuak a, litre 22 a chanve chu hnuaiah a awm.

method.en: Cook it until a quarter of the beans break by themselves. That quarter is what thickens twenty-two litres with no flour in it.
method.l: Be a li chhinga pakhat amah ngeia a kek thlengin chhum rawh. Chu li chhinga pakhat chuan chhang tel lovin litre 22 chu a tisang.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a be var hardens and no amount of chhang brings it back.
method.l: Be a nem hnu chauhvin mluh thlak rawh. Hmain mluh thlak chuan be var chu a khauh a, chhang engzat pawhin a rawn hruai kir thei lo.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees ninety a head. Three and a half kilos of be var gives a hundred people the protein of a meal and the vessel keeps overnight without a fridge.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh sawmkua. Be var kilo thum leh chanve chuan mi za-a tan chaw thanna a pe a, bel chu fridge tel lovin zan khat a awm thei.

start.en: Beans soak twelve hours. Start the evening before.
start.l: Be te chu darkar sawmpakhat leh pahnih tui-ah a awm. A ni hmaa tlaiah tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, uncovered while the chhang works. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel, chhang a thawh chhung khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, out of the granary.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, buh dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Be Dum Bai
recipes.sub: Black gram cooked three hours and finished with ghee
recipes.sub_l: Be dum darkar thum chhum, ghee nen a tihrem

method.en: Soak it twelve hours and cook it in the soaking water. That dark water is half the colour of the finished bai.
method.l: Darkar sawmpakhat leh pahnih tui-ah dah la, a dahna tui-ah ngei chhum rawh. Chu tui dum chu bai zo tak rawng a chanve a ni.

method.en: Three hours on a low fire and no shortcut. A be dum boiled hard for one hour is a bead with a broken skin and nothing else.
method.l: Mei tlem chungah darkar thum, kawng tawi a awm lo. Darkar khat chhung nasa taka chhum be dum chu hnawng kek nei be a ni mai.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a be dum hardens and two hours more will not save it.
method.l: Be a nem hnu chauhvin mluh thlak rawh. Hmain mluh thlak chuan be dum chu a khauh a, darkar hnih belhchhah pawhin a chhandam thei lo.

method.en: The ghee goes in off the fire and is not stirred through. It should sit on the surface where the hall can see it.
method.l: Ghee chu mei aṭanga la chhuah hnuah a luh a, chhawm luh a ni lo. In chhungin a hmuh theih nan a chunga a awm tur a ni.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees fifty a head. Three and a half kilos of be dum holds a hall through a thlasik afternoon better than five of any other pulse.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpathum leh sawmnga. Be dum kilo thum leh chanve chuan thlasik chawhnu chu be dang kilo nga aiin in chu a vawn tha zawk.

start.en: Beans soak twelve hours and cook three. Start the evening before.
start.l: Be te chu darkar sawmpakhat leh pahnih tui-ah a awm a, darkar thum a chhum. A ni hmaa tlaiah tan rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 30 bel rit. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Thlasik above all, and all year besides.
season.l: Thlasik a bik takin, tin kum tin bawk.

recipes.name: Bai-bal
recipes.sub: Rice and greens cooked to a thick porridge
recipes.sub_l: Buh leh thlai hring bal

method.en: Bai-bal is a bai cooked down with rice until it thickens to a porridge, and it is what a household makes when the count is uncertain.
method.l: Bai-bal chu bai leh buh thlawp khawm a ni a, mi zat hriat loh hunah an siam thin.

method.en: Add the taro and pumpkin first and cook them twenty minutes before the rice goes in. Both break down and thicken the pot.
method.l: Dawl leh mai chu hmasain dah la, buh dah hmain minute 20 thlawp rawh. Pahnihin bel a tikhauh.

method.en: Cook the rice until the grains have burst completely. A bai-bal with separate grains has not been cooked long enough.
method.l: Buh chu a chhia hlen hlen thlengin thlawp rawh.

method.en: Add the chhang with the greens, not at the start. Alkali added early to rice makes it slippery and it will not thicken.
method.l: Chhang chu thlai hring nen dah rawh, a tirah dah suh.

method.en: Add the greens only in the last eight minutes so they stay green.
method.l: Thlai hring chu a tawp minute 8-ah chauh dah rawh, chutichuan a hring reng ang.

method.en: Keep hot water aside. Bai-bal thickens hard as it stands and a doubled count is met by loosening it rather than cooking more.
method.l: Tui lum dah bel rawh. Bai-bal chu a khauh zel a, tui lum nen tiuain rawh.

recipes.why: One pot, one fire, no oil worth counting, and it stretches with hot water. The cheapest full meal in this book.
recipes.why_l: Bel khat, mei khat, hriak a tlem hle, tui lum nen a tam thei.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Sem hma minute 70 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy 50 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bel rit 50 L. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: All year. The one-pot meal.
season.l: Kum tin. Bel khat chaw a ni.

recipes.name: Chhum Han
recipes.sub: Plainly boiled mixed vegetables
recipes.sub_l: Thlai chhum, thil dah lo

method.en: There are four ingredients on this page and one of them is water. Chhum han is boiled vegetables and nothing else, eaten with a chutney.
method.l: He phekah thil pali chauh a awm a, pakhat chu tui a ni. Chhum han chu thlai chhum mai a ni.

method.en: Cook each vegetable separately and combine at the end. Together, the beans are grey before the pumpkin is soft.
method.l: Thlai tin chu hran hranin thlawp la, a tawpah tichhun rawh.

method.en: Add a little chhang to the water for the tough greens only. It keeps them green and softens the stems, and the softer vegetables do not need it.
method.l: Thlai khauh tan chauh chhang tlemte dah rawh. A hring a humhalh a, a kung a tinawi.

method.en: Do not overcook. Chhum han is meant to have bite; a soft one is indistinguishable from a bai without its broth.
method.l: Rei lutuk thlawp suh. Chhum han chu a khauh tlem a ngai.

method.en: Salt it very lightly or not at all. It is eaten with hmarcha rawt or bekang chartawk, both of which are salted.
method.l: Chi tlem te dah emaw dah lo emaw rawh. Chartawk nen ei tur a ni a, chuah chi a tel tawh.

method.en: Serve warm rather than hot, and never dressed.
method.l: A lum lo lum lo-ah sem la, engmah chungah dah suh.

recipes.why: Four ingredients and no oil at all. It is here because Mizoram genuinely eats it, not to fill a page.
recipes.why_l: Thil pali chauh, hriak a tel lo. Mizoram-in an ei tak avangin a awm a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start thirty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Sem hma minute 30 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a steamer basket. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 40 L leh chhum na. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year with whatever came in.
season.l: Kum tin, thil awm apiang nen.

recipes.name: Buhfai leh Antam
recipes.sub: Rice boiled with mustard greens
recipes.sub_l: Buh leh antam thlawp

method.en: Antam is the Mizo mustard green and it is at its best after the first cold. Wash in three changes of water.
method.l: Antam hi Mizo antam a ni a, khaw vawt hmasa hnuah a tha ber. Tui vawi thum thlakin sil rawh.

method.en: Strip the tough lower stems and keep them separate from the leaf. The stems go in ten minutes earlier.
method.l: A kung khauh chu a hnah nen hran rawh. A kung chu minute 10 hmain a lut ang.

method.en: Add the chhang with the stems. Alkali is what makes an antam stem edible rather than stringy, and this is the dish it exists for.
method.l: Chhang chu a kung nen dah rawh. Chhang hian antam kung a tinawi.

method.en: Add the leaves only in the last eight minutes. Cooked from the start they go grey-brown and the whole pot looks tired.
method.l: A hnah chu a tawp minute 8-ah chauh dah rawh.

method.en: Salt it late. Greens salted early collapse and release all their water, and the pot goes grey.
method.l: Chi chu hnu takah dah rawh. Chi hmasa dah chuan a chhia a, a tui a chhuak vek ang.

method.en: Serve it wet, with its liquid. That broth is poured over the rice and is the best part of the dish.
method.l: A tui nen sem rawh. Chu tui chu buh chungah leih tur a ni a, a tha ber a ni.

recipes.why: Costs almost nothing, uses the stems most kitchens throw, and it is what these hills genuinely eat.
recipes.why_l: A man a tlawm hle a, a kung mi tam takin an paih chu a hmang.

start.en: Wash the greens three times. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Thlai chu vawi thum sil rawh. Sem hma minute 50 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy 50 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel rit 50 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: November to March, when the antam is in.
season.l: November atanga March thleng, antam awm lai.

recipes.name: Mai Bai
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked down thin with chhang water and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Mai chu chhang tui leh hmarcha nen sekin a chhum

method.en: Keep the skin on if it is a jhum mai. The skin is what stops fourteen kilos collapsing into a single orange mass.
method.l: Lo lam mai a nih chuan a hnawng chu dah rawh. Kilo 14 chu bal sen khat lo nih atangin a humhim chu a hnawng a ni.

method.en: Half a litre of chhang water and no more. Chhang holds the green of the coriander and softens the skin; too much of it tastes of soap.
method.l: Chhang tui litre chanve chauh, chu aia tam lo. Chhang chuan dhania hringna chu a vawn a, hnawng chu a tinem; a tam lutuk chuan sabuar angin a tui.

method.en: No sugar and no kurtai. A favang mai is sweet on its own and sweetened further it is a thlum in the wrong vessel.
method.l: Sugar leh kurtai a awm lo. Favang mai chu amah ngeiin a thlum a, tithlum belh chuan bel dik lo chhunga thil thlum a lo ni.

method.en: Let it fall apart on its own and do not mash it. Mai mashed with a ladle goes watery within twenty minutes of standing.
method.l: Amah ngeia a chhe ang che, deng suh. Chawpna hmanga deng mai chu awm minute sawmhnih chhungin a tui thla.

recipes.why: Four rupees ninety a head, the cheapest wet dish in this book. In favang a Mamit jhum gives more mai than the kitchen can use and fourteen kilos costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka li leh sawmkua, he lehkhabu-a chaw tui man tlawm ber. Favang lai-ah Mamit lo chuan chawthleng hman zawng aiin mai a tam zawk a pe a, kilo 14 chu phurhna man chauh a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmli.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 35 bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, lo aṭangin, chumi hnuah thil dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Iskut Bai
recipes.sub: Chayote cooked thin with its leaf and a little sesame
recipes.sub_l: Iskut chu a hnah nen sekin a chhum, chhawhchhi tlem nen

method.en: The leaf goes in and it is not a garnish. Three kilos of iskut hnah is half the taste of this vessel and a kitchen that throws it is throwing the dish.
method.l: A hnah chu a luh a, chawhnawmna a ni lo. Iskut hnah kilo thum chu he bel tui a chanve a ni a, chu paih chawthleng chuan chaw ngei chu a paih a ni.

method.en: The iskut goes in first and the leaf in the last four minutes. Cooked together the leaf is the colour of a wet road and the vessel looks boiled twice.
method.l: Iskut chu hmasain a lut a, a hnah chu minute li hnuhnung berah. Khawmin chhum chuan hnah chu kawng hnawng rawng a ni a, bel chu vawi hnih chhum ang a lo ni.

method.en: Peel it only if the skin is rough. A young iskut skin is thinner than a mai and peeling twelve kilos of it wastes an hour and a kilo.
method.l: A hnawng a chhia chauh chuan hlip rawh. Iskut naupang hnawng chu mai aiin a sek zawk a, kilo 12 hlip chuan darkar khat leh kilo khat a bo.

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi and crush it in at the end. It is what thickens twenty-six litres with no flour anywhere in it.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu kang la, a tawpah dengin thlak rawh. Chhang tel lovin litre 26 chu tisang chu a ni.

recipes.why: Five rupees sixty a head. An iskut vine on a Serchhip fence gives fruit and leaf for eight months and nobody plants it twice.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka nga leh sawmruk. Serchhip huan kulh chunga iskut hrui chuan thla riat chhung rah leh hnah a pe a, tuman vawi hnih a chin lo.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, and the leaf is chopped while the iskut cooks.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmnga, tin iskut a chhum lai a hnah chu at a ni.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 35 bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Fur to thlasik, off the fence behind the kitchen.
season.l: Fur aṭanga thlasik thleng, chawthleng hnung lam kulh aṭangin.

recipes.name: Antam Bai
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves cooked thin with chhang water and nothing else
recipes.sub_l: Antam hnah chu chhang tui nen sekin a chhum, thil dang tel lo

method.en: No oil at any point and none is wanted. A Mizo bai is leaf and water and chhang, and a spoon of oil turns twenty-four litres into something else.
method.l: Khawi hun mahah hriak a awm lo, a tul hek lo. Mizo bai chu hnah, tui leh chhang a ni a, hriak chawpna khat chuan litre 24 chu thil dang a siam.

method.en: Six hundred millilitres of chhang water in twenty-four litres. It holds the green and it is why a Mizo bai is not the colour of a spinach.
method.l: Litre 24-ah chhang tui millilitre 600. Chuan a hringna chu a vawn a, chuvangin Mizo bai chu spinach rawng a ni lo.

method.en: Cut the stalk in and do not throw it. The stalk is a third of the weight and it goes in eight minutes before the leaf.
method.l: A kung chu at luh la, paih suh. A kung chu a rit a thum chhinga pakhat a ni a, a hnah hmain minute riat a lut.

method.en: Eight minutes on the leaf and no more. Antam cooked twenty minutes is grey and twenty-four litres of it comes back to the kitchen.
method.l: A hnah chungah minute riat chauh, chu aia rei lo. Minute sawmhnih chhung chhum antam chu a vardum a, litre 24 chu chawthlengah a rawn kir.

recipes.why: Three rupees ninety a head, no oil and no dal. In thlasik the antam is fifteen rupees a kilo at Bara Bazar and this is the vessel a Mizo house eats four days a week.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka thum leh sawmkua, hriak leh dal tel lo. Thlasik lai-ah antam chu Bara Bazar-ah kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, hei hi Mizo in-in chawlhkar khatah ni li an ei bel a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Twenty-five minutes, and the stalk goes in first.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmhnih leh nga, tin a kung chu hmasain a lut.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel, khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, while the antam is in the market.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, antam bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Bahra Bai
recipes.sub: Tubers boiled in their skins and broken into a thin broth
recipes.sub_l: Bahra chu a hnawng nen chhum a, tui sekah a kek

method.en: Boil them in the skin and peel them after. Peeled first, fourteen kilos drinks the water and the broth is thin and grey.
method.l: A hnawng nen chhum la, a hnuah hlip rawh. Hmasain hlip chuan kilo 14 chuan tui chu a in a, tui chu a sek a a vardum.

method.en: Break them by hand and do not cut them. A knife-cut bahra holds its edges and the broth never thickens on its own.
method.l: Kut hmangin kek la, chhema at suh. Chhema at bahra chuan a kam chu a vawn a, tui chu amah ngeiin a sang thei lo.

method.en: Sort the tubers before they go in the pot. One bitter bahra in fourteen kilos is found by four devotees and remembered by all of them.
method.l: Bel-a a luh hmain bahra te chu thliar rawh. Kilo 14 zinga bahra khah pakhat chu mi li-in an hmu a, an zain an hre reng.

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi and crush it in at the end. It is what thickens twenty-six litres with no flour anywhere in it.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu kang la, a tawpah dengin thlak rawh. Chhang tel lovin litre 26 chu tisang chu a ni.

recipes.why: Six rupees fifty a head. The bahra is dug on a Lawngtlai slope where nothing else will grow and fourteen kilos costs the digging.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka ruk leh sawmnga. Thil dang a chuah loh Lawngtlai tlang lamah bahra chu laih a ni a, kilo 14 chu laihna man chauh a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, most of it boiling and peeling.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmkua, a tam zawk chu chhum leh hlip a ni.

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a 35 L vessel. Two cooks for the peeling.
vessel.l: Chhum nan bel leh litre 35 bel. Hlip tur chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, out of the ground behind the kitchen.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, chawthleng hnung lam lei aṭangin.

recipes.name: Be Var Chhum
recipes.sub: White beans boiled dry and turned with chilli and sesame
recipes.sub_l: Be var ro-in chhum, hmarcha leh chhawhchhi nen a chhawm

method.en: Soak them twelve hours and boil them until they are soft but whole. This is a chhum and not a bai; a broken bean has no place in the tray.
method.l: Darkar sawmpakhat leh pahnih tui-ah dah la, a nem a a pum reng thlengin chhum rawh. Hei hi chhum a ni a, bai a ni lo; be kek chuan tray-ah hmun a nei lo.

method.en: Drain them completely and keep the water for a bai. Four kilos of be var leaves three litres of dark water and that water is a vessel of its own.
method.l: Tui chu famkimin sen chhuak la, bai atan dah rawh. Be var kilo li chuan tui dum litre thum a nghak a, chu tui chu amah bel a lo ni.

method.en: Roast the chilli on the flame and crush it in the hand. A powder gives heat only; the pieces are what a Mizo tray is looked at for.
method.l: Hmarcha chu mei chungah kang la, kut hmangin dengin. Vut chuan thautthawh chauh a pe; Mizo tray-a thlir chu a tluang tluangte a ni.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a be var hardens and no amount of chhang brings it back.
method.l: Be a nem hnu chauhvin mluh thlak rawh. Hmain mluh thlak chuan be var chu a khauh a, chhang engzat pawhin a rawn hruai kir thei lo.

recipes.why: Nine rupees twenty a head, and the three litres of bean water that come off it is a second vessel for nothing. Four kilos of be var feeds a hundred.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka kua leh sawmhnih, tin a chhuak be tui litre thum chu man tel lo bel dang a ni. Be var kilo li chuan mi za a chawm.

start.en: Beans soak twelve hours. Start the evening before.
start.l: Be te chu darkar sawmpakhat leh pahnih tui-ah a awm. A ni hmaa tlaiah tan rawh.

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a draining basket and a wide tray. One cook.
vessel.l: Chhum nan bel, tui senna bawm leh tray zau. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, out of the granary.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, buh dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Kuttu ki Puri
recipes.sub: Buckwheat puri for fasting days
recipes.sub_l: Ekadashi ni atan kuttu puri

method.en: This observance came with the temple rather than from the hills, and every ingredient on this page is brought in from outside Mizoram.
method.l: He hun hi tlang atanga lo chhuak ni lovin biak in atanga lo kal a ni a, a thil hman zawng zawng hi Mizoram pawn atanga lo kal a ni.

method.en: Buckwheat has no gluten, so the dough has nothing holding it together. Boiled mashed potato does that job — roughly one part potato to two of flour.
method.l: Kuttu-ah gluten a awm lo. Alu thlawp hian a phum khawm a ni.

method.en: Use cold boiled potato, grated rather than mashed, so no lumps go into the dough.
method.l: Alu dai chu chhiat la, tinep suh, chutichuan a bulh a awm lo vang.

method.en: Knead with as little water as possible, greasing the palms with ghee. The dough must be firm.
method.l: Tui tlem te hmangin sut la, kutphah-ah ghee hnawih rawh. A chhang chu a nghet tur a ni.

method.en: Do not let it stand. Kuttu dough turns slack within twenty minutes, so roll and fry as you go.
method.l: Dah reng suh. Kuttu chhang chu minute 20-ah a nuai ta a, chhat zel la, chhum zel rawh.
