method.en: Fry in medium-hot ghee. Kuttu browns faster than wheat and needs a lower flame than an ordinary puri.
method.l: Ghee lum lai deuhah chhum rawh. Kuttu chu a dum thruk a.

recipes.why: The dough is the whole difficulty, and everything here is bought in rather than grown.
recipes.why_l: A chhang hi a harsatna ber a ni a, thil zawng zawng hi lei a ni.

start.en: Boil and cool the potatoes first. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Alu chu thlawp la, tidai hmasa rawh.

vessel.en: Two deep kadhais and a rolling board. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Bel thuk 2 leh chhat na. Chaw suk 3.

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: Ekadashi leh Navratri chauh.

recipes.name: Samak ke Chawal
recipes.sub: Barnyard millet cooked like rice
recipes.sub_l: Buh anga thlawp samak

method.en: Rinse the samak and drain it well, then let it stand twenty minutes. Wet grain in hot ghee steams and turns the vessel sticky.
method.l: Samak chu sil la, tui chhuah la, minute 20 dah rawh.

method.en: Use two parts water to one of grain, not three. Samak swells more and takes less water than it looks.
method.l: Buh pakhat-ah tui pahnih dah rawh, pathum ni lo.

method.en: Temper the cumin in ghee, add the ginger and chilli, then the drained samak and fry two minutes.
method.l: Ghee-ah jeera dah la, sawhthing leh hmarcha dah la, samak dah la minute 2 chhum rawh.

method.en: Add water and rock salt, bring to a boil, cover, and cook twelve minutes on the lowest flame.
method.l: Tui leh chi rawn dah la, tibuk la, khuh la, mei tlem berah minute 12 thlawp rawh.

method.en: Rest ten minutes with the lid on before opening. Stirred hot, samak becomes paste faster than any rice.
method.l: Hawn hmain minute 10 khuhin dah rawh.

method.en: Fork through the crushed peanut, coriander and lemon just before serving.
method.l: Sem hma tak takah badam, hnahchiar leh serthlum chal rawh.

recipes.why: Twelve minutes and it feeds a fasting hall. The only trap is treating it like rice and drowning it.
recipes.why_l: Minute 12-ah mi tam tak a chawm. Buh anga tui tam dah chu a thil sual ber a ni.

start.en: Rinse and drain twenty minutes before cooking.
start.l: Thlawp hma minute 20 in sil la, tui chhuah rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel rit 30 L, khuhna nen. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: Ekadashi leh Navratri chauh.

recipes.name: Vrat ke Aloo
recipes.sub: Potato with cumin and rock salt
recipes.sub_l: Alu, jeera leh chi rawn nen

method.en: Boil the potatoes the day before and chill them. Cold potato breaks into clean pieces; warm potato mashes at a touch.
method.l: Alu chu a ni khat hmain thlawp la, tidai rawh. Alu dai chu a chhia thra a.

method.en: Break them by hand rather than cutting — torn faces hold the tempering.
method.l: At lovin kutin then rawh — a then hmun chuan hmangte a chelh.

method.en: Temper a generous quantity of cumin in ghee. On a fasting day there is no asafoetida, so cumin carries the dish alone.
method.l: Ghee-ah jeera tam tak dah rawh. Ekadashi ni-ah hing a awm lo.

method.en: Add the ginger and green chilli, then the chopped tomato, and cook until it collapses.
method.l: Sawhthing leh hmarcha dah la, tomato dah la, a chhia hlen thlengin thlawp rawh.

method.en: Add the potato with rock salt and crushed pepper and turn with a flat ladle rather than stirring.
method.l: Alu, chi rawn leh hmarcha dum dah la, kaihkawh lovin letling rawh.

method.en: Add a little hot water if it looks dry and finish with coriander and lemon off the fire.
method.l: A ro deuh chuan tui lum tlemte dah la, mei atanga la chhuah hnuah hnahchiar leh serthlum dah rawh.

recipes.why: Rock salt only, no asafoetida, and cumin doing all the work.
recipes.why_l: Chi rawn chauh, hing a awm lo, jeera hian hna zawng zawng a thawk.

start.en: Boil the potatoes the evening before.
start.l: Alu chu a tlai lamah thlawp rawh.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel zau 30 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: Ekadashi leh Navratri chauh.

recipes.name: Singhare ka Halwa
recipes.sub: Water chestnut flour halwa
recipes.sub_l: Singhara chhang halwa

method.en: Roast the singhara flour in ghee on a low flame for a full thirty minutes. It is heavier than semolina and takes longer to lose its raw smell.
method.l: Singhara chhang chu ghee-ah mei tlem berah minute 30 kang rawh.

method.en: It is ready when it turns pinkish-brown and smells sweet. Under-roasted it tastes chalky and sits heavy.
method.l: A sen deuh a, a rim a thlum hun chuan a puitling tawh a ni.

method.en: Stir constantly. Singhara flour is fine and catches on the bottom faster than semolina.
method.l: Kaihkawh reng rawh. Singhara chhang chu a nal a, bel bulah a kai thruk.

method.en: Boil the water and sugar separately and keep the syrup at a rolling boil.
method.l: Tui leh chini chu hran hranin tibuk la, a tibuk lai dah rawh.

method.en: Pour the boiling syrup into the roasted flour and stand back. Syrup that is not boiling lumps the halwa instantly.
method.l: Tui thlum tibuk chu chhang kang chungah leih la, hnung lam pan rawh.

method.en: Stir until the ghee separates, then fold in cardamom and nuts and cover five minutes off the fire.
method.l: Ghee a inthen hlen thlengin kaihkawh la, elaichi leh badam dah la, mei atanga la chhuah hnuah minute 5 khuh rawh.

recipes.why: The fasting sweet that does not feel like a compromise, provided the flour is properly roasted.
recipes.why_l: A chhang tha taka kan a nih chuan Ekadashi ni thlum tha tak a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Sem hma minute 60 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Bel zau 40 L. Chaw suk pakhat, a bulah awm reng tur.

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: Ekadashi leh Navratri chauh.

recipes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
recipes.sub: Sago soaked to the grain and turned with groundnut and potato
recipes.sub_l: Sabudana chu a chi ang lawkin dah, badam leh alu nen a chhawm

method.en: Wash the sago three times and soak it in water that only just covers it. Sago under two inches of water is a paste by morning.
method.l: Sabudana chu vawi thum sil la, a khuh vak vak tui-ah dah rawh. Tui inch hnih hnuaia awm sabudana chu zing thleng chuan bal a lo ni.

method.en: Six hours is enough here and not the overnight the plains use. A longer soak makes it wetter and a wet sabudana will not separate.
method.l: Hetah darkar ruk a tawk a, phaizawl mite zan khat dahna chu a ni lo. Rei zawk dah chuan a hnawng zual a, sabudana hnawng chu a inṭhen thei lo.

method.en: Roast the badam, skin it and crush it coarse. Whole groundnut rolls off the spoon and the crushed part stops the sago sticking.
method.l: Badam chu kang la, a hnawng phel la, sang zawkin dengin. Badam pum chuan chawpna aṭangin a hlir thla a, a deng zawng chuan sabudana chu bet lo turin a vawn.

method.en: Rock salt only and taste it at the pan. On a fast day the difference matters to the devotee even where it does not to the cook.
method.l: Mluh lung chauh, tin bel hnenah teh rawh. Chaw ei loh ni-ah chuan chawmi tan a pawimawh loh pawhin mi tan chuan a danglamna chu a pawimawh.

recipes.why: Twenty-one rupees fifty a head. It is the Ekadashi dish an Aizawl kitchen can make with nothing that grew on a jhum, which matters in thlasik.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmhnih leh pakhat leh sawmnga. Hei hi lo-a chuang engmah tel lovin Aizawl chawthlengin a siam theih Ekadashi chaw a ni a, thlasik lai-ah chu chu a pawimawh.

start.en: Sago soaks six hours in barely enough water. Start before dawn for a noon meal.
start.l: Sabudana chu tui tawk vak vakah darkar ruk a awm. Chawhnu chaw atan chuan khaw eng hmain tan rawh.

vessel.en: A wide 25 L kadai and a soaking tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Litre 25 kadai zau leh dahna tray. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: All year, on every Ekadashi.
season.l: Kum tin, Ekadashi tinah.

recipes.name: Makhana Kheer
recipes.sub: Fox nuts roasted in ghee and cooked down in milk
recipes.sub_l: Makhana chu ghee-ah kang a, hnutetui-ah a chhum

method.en: Roast the makhana in ghee until it snaps between the fingers. Unroasted it turns to sponge in the milk and there is nothing to chew.
method.l: Makhana chu kutzung kara a kek thlengin ghee-ah kang rawh. Kang loh chuan hnutetui-ah sponge a lo ni a, chhia tur engmah a awm lo.

method.en: Break half of it coarse and leave half whole. The broken half thickens the vessel and the whole half is what is eaten.
method.l: A chanve chu sang zawkin kek la, a chanve chu a pumin dah rawh. A chanve kek chuan bel chu a tisang a, a chanve pum chu ei tur a ni.

method.en: Reduce the milk by a fifth before the makhana goes in. Makhana in cold milk drinks it up and the vessel never thickens on its own.
method.l: Makhana a luh hmain hnutetui chu a nga chhinga pakhat tiawm rawh. Hnutetui vawt chhunga makhana chuan chu chu a in vek a, bel chu amah ngeiin a sang ngai lo.

method.en: Sugar in the last ten minutes only. Added early it stops the makhana softening and it stays rubbery through the vessel.
method.l: Sugar chu minute sawm hnuhnung berah chauh. Hmain thlak chuan makhana nem chu a tibang a, bel pumpuiah rabar angin a awm reng.

recipes.why: Thirty-six rupees fifty a head. Makhana is dear but a kilo and a half does twenty litres, and on a Nirjala Ekadashi it is the only sweet the hall can be given.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmthum leh pariat leh sawmnga. Makhana chu a to a, mahse kilo khat leh chanve chuan litre 20 a siam a; Nirjala Ekadashi-ah chuan in chhung pek theih thil thlum chauh a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmkua.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel rit. Chawmi pakhat, a kalsan lo tur.

season.en: All year, and on Nirjala Ekadashi above all.
season.l: Kum tin, tin Nirjala Ekadashi-ah a bik takin.

recipes.name: Vrat ki Kadhi
recipes.sub: Curd thickened with water chestnut flour instead of gram
recipes.sub_l: Besan aiin singhara chhang hmanga tisang hnute

method.en: Singhara flour in place of the besan, and it behaves differently. It thickens twice as fast and half as much is needed.
method.l: Besan hmun ah singhara chhang, tin a awm dan chu a danglam. A tisang a rang zawk a, a chanve chauh a tul.

method.en: Whisk the flour into cold curd and get every lump out before any heat. A lump that reaches hot kadhi never breaks up again.
method.l: Chhang chu hnute vawt-ah chhawm luh la, lum a thleng hmain a bal zawng zawng chu la chhuak rawh. Kadhi lum thleng bal chu a kek leh ngai lo.

method.en: Stir in one direction until it comes to the boil, then leave it. A kadhi splits in the first four minutes or not at all.
method.l: A chhum thlengin lam khatah chhawm la, chumi hnuah chhawm tawh suh. Kadhi chu minute li hmasa berah a inṭhen a, a nih loh chuan a inṭhen ngai lo.

method.en: Rock salt after the boil and not before. Salted curd on the way up splits eight kilos before the vessel is warm.
method.l: A chhum hnuah mluh lung thlak la, a hmain thlak suh. A lum kal lai hnute mluh thlak sa chuan bel a lum hmain kilo riat chu a tiinṭhen.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees forty a head, and it is the only wet dish an Aizawl kitchen can put out on Ekadashi. A plate of sabudana and puri needs one.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh ruk leh sawmli, tin Ekadashi-ah Aizawl chawthlengin a sem chhuah theih chaw tui chauh a ni. Sabudana leh puri thlengbel chuan pakhat a ngai.

start.en: The curd should be a day old and sour. Set it the morning before. Fifty minutes on the day.
start.l: Hnute chu ni khat awm leh thur tur a ni. A ni hmaa zingah khal rawh. A ni ah minute sawmnga.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a tempering pan. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel leh tihremna bel. Chawmi pakhat, a kalsan lo tur.

season.en: All year, on every Ekadashi.
season.l: Kum tin, Ekadashi tinah.

recipes.name: Sabudana Kheer
recipes.sub: Sago pearls cooked slow in milk with cardamom
recipes.sub_l: Sabudana chi chu hnutetui-ah muangchangin a chhum, elaichi nen

method.en: A kilo and a half in eighteen litres and no more. Sago swells to five times its weight and two kilos is a vessel that cannot be poured.
method.l: Litre 18-ah kilo khat leh chanve chauh, chu aia tam lo. Sabudana chu a rit aia vawi nga a puak a, kilo hnih chuan bel chu sem chhuah theih loh a lo ni.

method.en: Wash it three times and add it dry to the boiling milk. Soaked sago in milk goes to a single lump that no ladle will break.
method.l: Vawi thum sil la, hnutetui chhum lai-ah ro-in thlak rawh. Tui-a dah sabudana chu hnutetui-ah bal khat a lo ni a, chawpna engmahin a tichhe thei lo.

method.en: Stir the bottom every three minutes. Sago sinks and eighteen litres of milk burns under it with no smell reaching the cook.
method.l: Minute thum danin a hnuai chu chhawm rawh. Sabudana chu a thla a, hnutetui litre 18 chu a hnuaiah a kang a, chawmi hnenah a rim a thleng lo.

method.en: Sugar in the last ten minutes. Added early, the pearl stays hard at the centre and the whole vessel is gritty.
method.l: Sugar chu minute sawm hnuhnung berah. Hmain thlak chuan a chi chu a laiah a khauh a, bel pumpui chu sepaipui angin a awm.

recipes.why: Twenty-six rupees eighty a head. It is the one Ekadashi sweet an Aizawl kitchen can put out for a full hall, and a kilo and a half of sago does it.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmhnih leh ruk leh sawmriat. Hei hi in khat zawng zawng atan Aizawl chawthlengin a sem chhuah theih Ekadashi thil thlum pakhat a ni a, sabudana kilo khat leh chanve chuan a tling.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmkua.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel rit. Chawmi pakhat, a kalsan lo tur.

season.en: All year, on every Ekadashi.
season.l: Kum tin, Ekadashi tinah.

recipes.name: Rawtuai Bora
recipes.sub: Fresh bamboo shoot fritters in rice flour
recipes.sub_l: Rawtuai, buh chhang nen chhum

method.en: Fresh bamboo shoot must be boiled twice in fresh water, twenty minutes each time, and the water thrown away both times.
method.l: Rawtuai chu tui thar-ah vawi hnih, minute 20 zel thlawp la, a tui chu vawi hnihin paih rawh.

method.en: This is not optional. Raw bamboo shoot contains a compound that is genuinely toxic, and it is the boiling and discarding that removes it.
method.l: Hei hi thlan theih a ni lo. Rawtuai hel-ah hian thil chhia a awm a, thlawp a, a tui paih chauhin a paih thei.

method.en: Peel down to the pale tender core and slice thin. Anything that resists the knife is too old for the kadhai.
method.l: A chhung nawi thleng hlip la, a pang takin at rawh. Chem hnena a nghet chu a upa lutuk tihna a ni.

method.en: Use rice flour with a quarter part besan. Rice flour is what keeps this crisp; all besan gives a soft plains pakora.
method.l: Buh chhang leh besan zaliak khat dah rawh. Buh chhang hian a tikhauh a.

method.en: Beat air into the batter by hand for three minutes and keep it thick enough to coat without dripping.
method.l: A tui chu kutin minute 3 sawi rawh, a tla lo a a chelh theih khawpin khauh rawh.

method.en: Fry at a steady medium heat and drain on mesh, never in a heap.
method.l: Mei lai lai-ah chhum la, hlengah dah rawh, khawmkhawm suh.

recipes.why: Boil it twice or do not cook it at all. After that it is the cheapest snack in these hills for four months.
recipes.why_l: Vawi hnih thlawp rawh, a nih loh chuan siam suh. Chumi hnuah chuan thla li chhung a man a tlawm ber a ni.

start.en: Boil the fresh shoot twice, an hour ahead.
start.l: Rawtuai chu vawi hnih thlawp rawh, darkar khat hmain.

vessel.en: Three deep kadhais. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Bel thuk 3. Chaw suk 3.

season.en: June to September, while the fresh shoots are coming up.
season.l: June atanga September thleng, rawtuai chhuah lai.

recipes.name: Banana Fritters
recipes.sub: Ripe banana in rice flour batter
recipes.sub_l: Balhla min, buh chhang nen

method.en: Use bananas that are properly ripe, with black flecks on the skin. An underripe banana gives a fritter that is starchy rather than sweet.
method.l: Balhla min tak, a hnah dum tawh hmang rawh. A min lo chuan a thlum lo vang.

method.en: Mash the bananas by hand rather than grinding them. A ground banana turns to liquid and the batter will not hold.
method.l: Balhla chu machine-a hnawih lovin kutin nep rawh.

method.en: Use rice flour rather than wheat. Rice flour is what makes this crisp; wheat gives a soft, cakey fritter.
method.l: Buh chhang hmang rawh, gehu chhang ni lo. Buh chhang hian a tikhauh a.

method.en: Rest the batter twenty minutes and check it again — rice flour absorbs slowly and it will have tightened.
method.l: A tui chu minute 20 dah la, en leh rawh — buh chhang hian tui a in thruk lo a, a khauh tawh ang.

method.en: Fry on a low to medium flame. Banana browns very fast because of its sugar, and a hot kadhai gives a fritter black outside and raw within.
method.l: Mei tlem-ah chhum rawh. Balhla a thlum avangin a dum thruk hle a.

method.en: Drain on mesh and scatter toasted sesame over while still warm.
method.l: Hlengah dah la, a lum lain chhawhchhi kang theh rawh.

recipes.why: Ripe bananas and a low flame. Both are about the sugar browning before the middle cooks.
recipes.why_l: Balhla min leh mei tlem. Pahnih hian a chhung a min hmaa a dum loh nan a ni.

start.en: Rest the batter twenty minutes. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: A tui chu minute 20 dah rawh.

vessel.en: Three deep kadhais. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Bel thuk 3. Chaw suk 3.

season.en: All year. Bananas are cheap here in every month.
season.l: Kum tin. Balhla hi thla tinah a man a tlawm.

recipes.name: Rice Crisps
recipes.sub: Thin fried rice crackers
recipes.sub_l: Buh chhang papor

method.en: Cook the rice flour with boiling water into a stiff dough, beating it hard. It must be cooked through at this stage — a raw dough gives a crisp that stays chalky.
method.l: Buh chhang chu tui tibuk hmangin chhang nghet siam la, nasa takin sawi rawh.

method.en: Roll or press it very thin between sheets and steam ten minutes.
method.l: A pang takin phek hnih kar-ah nemnghet la, minute 10 chhum rawh.

method.en: Dry the steamed sheets in full sun for two days until they snap cleanly. In a damp week they will not dry, and a half-dry crisp will not puff.
method.l: Chhum tawh chu ni hnih chhung ni-ah tikang la, a keh fai thleng rawh.

method.en: This is why they are made in the dry season. Mizoram has a long monsoon and there is no point attempting these in July.
method.l: Chuvangin thla ro-ah siam a ni. Mizoram-ah ruah a sur rei a, July-ah siam a ngai lo.

method.en: Store the dried sheets in a tin with a lid. They keep months undried and are fried as needed.
method.l: A kang tawh chu bawm-ah dah rawh. Thla tam a awm thei a, mamawh dan ang zelin chhum rawh.

method.en: Fry in hot oil for a few seconds only — they puff at once. Drain and cool completely before tinning.
method.l: Hriak lum-ah second tlemte chauh chhum rawh. Bawm-a dah hmain tidai fel rawh.

recipes.why: Dried sheets keep for months and fry in seconds. The one thing here that can be prepared far in advance.
recipes.why_l: A phek kang chu thla tam a awm thei a, second tlemte-ah a chhum theih.

start.en: Steam and dry the sheets two days ahead. Frying takes an hour.
start.l: A phek chu ni hnih hmain chhum la, tikang rawh.

vessel.en: A steamer, drying trays and two kadhais. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chhum na, tikanna tray leh bel 2. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: Made in the dry months, November to March.
season.l: Thla ro, November atanga March thleng siam.

recipes.name: Antam Bora
recipes.sub: Whole mustard leaves dipped in a thin besan batter and fried
recipes.sub_l: Antam hnah pum chu besan chhang sek-ah tum a, a chhum-chhia

method.en: Take whole leaves with the stalk left on. The stalk is the handle for dipping and it comes off in the mouth without anyone noticing.
method.l: A kung nen hnah pum chu la rawh. A kung chu tum nan kut chinna a ni a, tuman hriat lovin kaah a chhuak.

method.en: Dry every leaf on a cloth before dipping. A wet leaf slides out of the batter in the oil and fries as a bare leaf.
method.l: Tum hmain hnah tin chu puan chungah ro-in dah rawh. Hnah hnawng chuan hriak chhungah chhang aṭangin a hlir chhuak a, hnah ngaihngai angin a chhum.

method.en: A handful of buh chhang in the batter is what makes the coat crisp. Besan alone gives a soft skin that goes limp in ten minutes.
method.l: Chhang chhunga buh chhang kut khat chuan a chung chu a tikrai. Besan chauh chuan hnawng nem a pe a, minute sawmah a duai.

method.en: Fry in lots of forty and strain the oil between them. Bits that fall off the first lot burn and colour every bora after them.
method.l: Sawmli vawi khatin chhum la, a kar tinah hriak chu sil rawh. A hmasa ber aṭanga a tlak tlangte chu a kang a, a hnua bora zawng zawng chu a tirawng.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees ninety a head. Antam is the cheapest green at Bara Bazar from favang to thal and four kilos of it becomes eight hundred bora.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh pahnih leh sawmkua. Favang aṭanga thal thleng Bara Bazar-ah antam chu thlai hring man tlawm ber a ni a, kilo li chuan bora za riat a lo ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. The batter rests fifteen minutes. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Chhang chu minute sawmpanga a awm. A zawng zawngin minute sawmkua.

vessel.en: A deep kadai and a strainer. Two cooks — one dips, one fries.
vessel.l: Kadai thuk leh silna. Chawmi pahnih — pakhatin a tum a, pakhatin a chhum.

season.en: Favang to thal, while the antam is in the market.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, antam bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Mai Bora
recipes.sub: Pumpkin grated, squeezed dry and fried in a thick batter
recipes.sub_l: Mai thlur, ro-in chhir a, chhang sang-ah a chhum

method.en: Grate, salt and leave twenty minutes, then squeeze with both hands. Five kilos gives up a litre and it has to come out or the batter will not hold.
method.l: Thlur la, mluh thlak la, minute sawmhnih dah la, chumi hnuah kut pahnih hmangin chhir rawh. Kilo nga chuan litre khat a pe a, chu chu a chhuak tur a ni; a nih loh chuan chhang chuan a vawn thei lo.

method.en: No water at all in the batter. The mai gives up enough after the squeezing and any added is a bora that will not hold together.
method.l: Chhang chhungah tui a awm lo. Chhir hnuah mai chuan a tawk a pe a, belhchhah chuan a inzawm thei lo bora a lo ni.

method.en: Drop them in with the fingers and not a spoon. A mai bora should be ragged; a neat ball of it fries raw in the middle.
method.l: Chawpna ni lovin kutzung hmangin thlak rawh. Mai bora chu a inrem lo tur a ni; a bal fel takin chuan a laiah a thing a chhum.

method.en: Fry on a medium flame right through. Pumpkin needs longer than a mustard leaf and a hot kadai browns the outside while the inside is still raw.
method.l: A tawp thlengin mei tlangpui chungah chhum rawh. Mai chuan antam hnah aiin hun rei zawk a ngai a, kadai lum chuan a chhungah a la thing lai a pawn lam chu a tidum.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees ninety a head, and in favang the mai is the cheapest thing on a Mamit cart. This is the tray a kitchen can put out at no notice.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh pakhat leh sawmkua, tin favang lai-ah Mamit gari-ah mai chu man tlawm ber a ni. Hei hi hriattirna tel lovin chawthlengin a sem chhuah theih tray a ni.

start.en: Grate and salt twenty minutes ahead for the squeezing. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: Chhir tur atan minute sawmhnih hmaah thlur la mluh thlak rawh. A zawng zawngin minute sawmkua.

vessel.en: A grater, a colander and a deep kadai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Thlurna, tui senna leh kadai thuk. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, lo aṭangin, chumi hnuah thil dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Alu Bora
recipes.sub: Potato rounds in a thin besan batter, fried to order
recipes.sub_l: Alu tluang chu besan chhang sek-ah, dil ang bawkin a chhum

method.en: Slice the alu thin and hold the rounds in cold water until the kadai is hot. Cut potato left dry goes black at the edge within twenty minutes.
method.l: Alu chu sekin at la, kadai a lum hma chuan a tluangte chu tui vawt-ah dah rawh. At alu ro-in dah chuan minute sawmhnih chhungin a kam chu a dum.

method.en: Dry every round on a cloth before it meets the batter. A wet round slides out of the batter in the oil and fries bare.
method.l: Chhang a tawh hmain a tluang tin chu puan chungah ro-in dah rawh. Tluang hnawng chuan hriak chhungah chhang aṭangin a hlir chhuak a, a ruakin a chhum.

method.en: A pinch of hing in the batter. In a kitchen with no onion it is the only thing standing where the onion would.
method.l: Chhang chhungah hing tlemte. Purun awm lo chawthleng-ah chuan purun awmna hmun ah ding chu chu chauh a ni.

method.en: Fry in lots of forty and strain the oil between them. Bits that fall off the first lot burn and colour every bora after them.
method.l: Sawmli vawi khatin chhum la, a kar tinah hriak chu sil rawh. A hmasa ber aṭanga a tlak tlangte chu a kang a, a hnua bora zawng zawng chu a tirawng.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees fifty a head. Alu is in an Aizawl store room every month of the year, and eight bora with a thingpui holds a devotee to the evening prasad.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpathum leh sawmnga. Kum chhung thla tinah Aizawl thil dahnaah alu a awm a, bora riat leh thingpui chuan tlai prasad thlengin mi chu a vawn.

start.en: Nothing soaks. The batter rests fifteen minutes. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Chhang chu minute sawmpanga a awm. A zawng zawngin minute sawmkua.

vessel.en: A deep kadai, a holding pot of cold water and a strainer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Kadai thuk, tui vawt dahna bel leh silna. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: All year, and the thlasik counter bora when the greens have gone.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thlai hring a boral hun thlasik lai sem hnaih vela bora.

recipes.name: Iskut Bora
recipes.sub: Chayote grated with its leaf and fried in a thick batter
recipes.sub_l: Iskut a hnah nen thlur a, chhang sang-ah a chhum

method.en: Grate the iskut and chop the leaf fine. The leaf holds the batter together and without it seven hundred bora fall apart in the oil.
method.l: Iskut chu thlur la, a hnah chu sang zawkin at rawh. A hnah chuan chhang chu a tikhawm a, chu tel lo chuan bora za sarih chu hriak chhungah a chhe hlum.

method.en: Grate, salt and squeeze twenty minutes ahead. Five kilos of iskut gives up a litre and a wet batter cannot be dropped in oil at all.
method.l: Minute sawmhnih hmaah thlur la, mluh thlak la, chhir rawh. Iskut kilo nga chuan litre khat a pe a, chhang hnawng chu hriak chhungah thlak tur a ni lo.

method.en: Drop them with the fingers and not a spoon. An iskut bora should be ragged; a neat ball of it fries raw in the middle.
method.l: Chawpna ni lovin kutzung hmangin thlak rawh. Iskut bora chu a inrem lo tur a ni; a bal fel takin chuan a laiah a thing a chhum.

method.en: Fry on a medium flame right through. Iskut carries more water than a mai and a hot kadai browns the outside while the inside is wet.
method.l: A tawp thlengin mei tlangpui chungah chhum rawh. Iskut chuan mai aiin tui a keng tam zawk a, kadai lum chuan a chhungah a hnawng lai a pawn lam chu a tidum.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees fifty a head. An iskut vine on a Serchhip fence gives fruit and leaf for eight months and both of them go into this batter.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh sawmnga. Serchhip huan kulh chunga iskut hrui chuan thla riat chhung rah leh hnah a pe a, a pahnihin he chhang chhungah a lut.

start.en: Grate and salt twenty minutes ahead. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: Minute sawmhnih hmaah thlur la mluh thlak rawh. A zawng zawngin minute sawmkua.

vessel.en: A grater, a colander and a deep kadai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Thlurna, tui senna leh kadai thuk. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Fur to thlasik, off the fence behind the kitchen.
season.l: Fur aṭanga thlasik thleng, chawthleng hnung lam kulh aṭangin.

recipes.name: Vaimim Bora
recipes.sub: Sweetcorn crushed coarse and fried as fritters with no flour
recipes.sub_l: Vaimim sang zawka deng a, chhang tel lovin bora angin a chhum

method.en: Crush two thirds of the kernels and leave a third whole. The crushed part binds and the whole part is what a vaimim bora is asked for.
method.l: A mim chu a thum chhinga hnih deng la, a thum chhinga pakhat chu a pumin dah rawh. A deng chuan a tikhawm a, a pum chu vaimim bora dilna chhan a ni.

method.en: No besan at all. Sweetcorn has enough starch of its own and six hundred grams of buh chhang is only there to steady the drop.
method.l: Besan a awm hrim hrim lo. Vaimim chuan amah hnim a nei tawk a, buh chhang gram 600 chu a thlak chu tinghet nan chauh a ni.

method.en: Crush it in a stone mortar and not a mixer. A mixed vaimim is a milk and eight kilos of it runs straight off the ladle.
method.l: Mixer-ah ni lovin sumtual lungah dengin. Mixer-a tih vaimim chu hnutetui a lo ni a, kilo riat chu chawpna aṭangin a luang thla vek.

method.en: Fry on a medium flame right through. A hot kadai browns the outside in a minute and the kernel inside is raw and it is not seen.
method.l: A tawp thlengin mei tlangpui chungah chhum rawh. Kadai lum chuan minute khatah a pawn lam a dum a, a chhunga mim chu a thing a, chu chu hmuh a ni lo.

recipes.why: Ten rupees twenty a head, and there is no besan in it at all. In fur the Mamit vaimim is fifteen rupees a kilo and eight kilos becomes seven hundred fritters.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmhnih, tin a chhungah besan a awm hrim hrim lo. Fur lai-ah Mamit vaimim chu kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, kilo riat chuan bora za sarih a lo ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, most of it stripping the cobs.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmkua, a tam zawk chu hling phel chhuah a ni.

vessel.en: A stone mortar, a deep kadai and a strainer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Sumtual lung, kadai thuk leh silna. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Fur to favang, while the vaimim is in the fields.
season.l: Fur aṭanga favang thleng, vaimim lo-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Bekang
recipes.sub: Fermented soybean
recipes.sub_l: Bepui thur

method.en: Bekang is fermented soybean and it is the reason this book works. It does the job that sa-um, fermented pork fat, does in a Mizo kitchen.
method.l: Bekang hi bepui thur a ni a, he lehkhabu hi a hnathawhtir. Mizo chaw suk in-ah sa-um hna a thawk.

method.en: Soak the soybean overnight and boil it four hours until a bean crushes to paste between the fingers.
method.l: Bepui chu zan khat dah la, darkar 4 thlawp la, kutzung karah a chhia hlen thlengin.

method.en: Drain thoroughly and cool to just warm — not hot. Wrapped hot it sours instead of fermenting.
method.l: Tui chhuah fel la, a lum tawk tawk-ah tidai rawh. A lum lai tuam chuan a thur ni lovin a chhia ang.

method.en: Wrap in banana leaves and keep in a covered basket in a warm place for three to four days.
method.l: Balhla hnah-ah tuam la, bawm khuh chhungah hmun lum-ah ni thum li dah rawh.

method.en: It is ready when a sticky white thread pulls between two beans. That thread is the sign the ferment has taken; without it, throw the batch away.
method.l: Bepui pahnih kar-ah hrui var a chhuah hunah a puitling tawh a ni. Chu a awm loh chuan paih rawh.

method.en: Bekang is not smoked and does not keep six months. Use it within three weeks and make it in small quantity.
method.l: Bekang hi meikhu-ah dah a ni lo va, thla ruk a awm lo. Chhun thum chhungin hmang la, tlem te siam rawh.

recipes.why: Three weeks, not six months. This ferment is fresh, and a kitchen should make it little and often.
recipes.why_l: Chhun thum, thla ruk ni lo. Hei hi thil thar a ni a, tlem te leh fovin siam tur a ni.

start.en: A four-day ferment. Plan a week from soaking to use.
start.l: Ni li thur tur. Chhun khat ruahmanna siam rawh.

vessel.en: A large pot, banana leaves and a covered basket. One cook, twenty minutes a day.
vessel.l: Bel lian, balhla hnah leh bawm khuh. Chaw suk pakhat, ni khatah minute 20.

season.en: Made in the warm months; the ferment is slow in a Mizoram winter.
season.l: Thla lum-ah siam; khaw vawt lai chuan a thur thruk lo.

recipes.name: Maian
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo shoot
recipes.sub_l: Rawtuai thur

method.en: Peel down to the pale tender core. Anything that resists the knife is too old to ferment and will stay woody in the jar.
method.l: A chhung nawi thleng hlip rawh. Chem hnena a nghet chu a upa lutuk a ni.

method.en: Boil the shoots twice in fresh water, twenty minutes each, discarding the water both times, before the ferment starts.
method.l: Thur tan hmain rawtuai chu tui thar-ah vawi hnih, minute 20 zel thlawp la, a tui paih rawh.

method.en: Raw bamboo shoot is genuinely toxic and it is the boiling and discarding that removes it. This is not a step to shorten.
method.l: Rawtuai hel-ah thil chhia a awm a, thlawp a a tui paih chauhin a paih thei.

method.en: Slice thin, pack tight into the jar, and cover with a brine of one part salt to about seven of water.
method.l: A pang takin at la, bel-ah nghet takin dah la, chi tui nen khuh rawh.

method.en: Weigh the shoots down so they stay under the brine. Any piece above the liquid grows mould and the mould takes the jar.
method.l: A tui hnuaiah a awm nan lungin nemnghet rawh. A chunga awm chu a thei ang a, bel pumpui a tichhia ang.

method.en: Cover with cloth rather than a lid and keep it in the shade for three weeks. A sealed jar builds pressure and bursts.
method.l: Khuhna ni lovin puanin khuh la, hlim lamah chhun thum dah rawh.

recipes.why: Fifteen kilos of a four-month vegetable turned into a year of flavour. Keep it under the brine and it cannot fail.
recipes.why_l: Thla li thlai kg 15 chu kum khat chhung tur a lo ni ta.

start.en: A three-week ferment. Start in the monsoon and use from September.
start.l: Chhun thum thur tur. Ruah lai-ah tan la, September atangin hmang rawh.

vessel.en: A 20 L glazed jar or a length of green bamboo. One cook, ten minutes a day.
vessel.l: Bel 20 L emaw rua hring emaw. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: Made June to August, when the fresh shoots are up.
season.l: June atanga August thleng siam, rawtuai chhuah lai.

recipes.name: Hmarcha Achar
recipes.sub: Bird's eye chilli preserved in salt
recipes.sub_l: Hmarcha te, chi-ah dah

method.en: Wear gloves or bind the hands in cloth, and do not rub the eyes for an hour afterwards even after washing.
method.l: Kut chu puanin tuam rawh, a hnuah darkar khat chhung mit hnawih suh.

method.en: Wipe each chilli dry rather than washing it on the day. A single drop of water in the jar grows mould and takes the batch.
method.l: Hmarcha chu sil lovin puanin hnawi rawh. Bel-ah tui tla khat pawh a thei tir ang.

method.en: Leave the chillies whole and slit them along one side. Cut through and the seeds come out and the pickle is far hotter than intended.
method.l: Hmarcha chu a pumin dah la, a kawng khatah at rawh. A that phel chuan a chi a chhuak a, a ur lutuk ang.

method.en: Pack into the jar in layers with salt and sliced ginger, and add lemon juice to cover.
method.l: Bel-ah chi leh sawhthing at nen inthlak thlakin dah la, serthlum tui nen khuh rawh.

method.en: Cover with cloth and stand in the sun a fortnight, shaking the jar daily.
method.l: Puanin khuh la, chhun hnih ni-ah dah la, ni tin bel chu sing rawh.

method.en: There is no oil in this pickle and none is needed. Salt and lemon alone keep it a year.
method.l: He achar-ah hian hriak a tel lo va, a ngai bawk lo. Chi leh serthlum chauhin kum khat a vawng.

recipes.why: No oil, a year on the shelf, and it is served one chilli at a time.
recipes.why_l: Hriak a tel lo, kum khat a awm, tin pakhat zelin sem a ni.

start.en: A two-week salt cure. No oil at all.
start.l: Chhun hnih chi-ah dah tur. Hriak a tel lo.

vessel.en: A 10 L glass jar and cloth. One cook, gloved.
vessel.l: Bel 10 L leh puan. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: August to October, when the chillies ripen red.
season.l: August atanga October thleng, hmarcha sen lai.

recipes.name: Passion Rah Jam
recipes.sub: Passion fruit pulp cooked down with sugar to a set
recipes.sub_l: Passion rah hnim chu sugar nen a chhum, a khal thlengin

method.en: Keep half the seeds and strain the rest out. Seedless, a passion jam looks like a bought one; all the seeds and it cannot be spread.
method.l: A chi chanve chu dah la, a dang chu sil chhuak rawh. Chi tel lo chuan passion jam chu lei ang a lo ni; a chi zawng zawng nen chuan hnawih theih a ni lo.

method.en: Test it on a cold plate every four minutes near the end. A passion jam goes from loose to hard in ninety seconds and there is no warning.
method.l: A tawp hnaih chuan minute li danin thlengbel vawt chungah teh rawh. Passion jam chu second sawmkuain sek aṭanga khauh a lo ni a, vaukhânna a awm lo.

method.en: Lemon in the last minute. It is what stops five kilos of sugar crystallising in the jar by the second month.
method.l: Serthlum chu minute hnuhnung berah. Chuan thla hnihnaah bel chhunga sugar kilo nga a khal lo turin a vawn.

method.en: Fill the jars hot and close them hot. A jam cooled in the pan and then jarred grows a skin on the top within a fortnight.
method.l: Bel te chu a lum lai dah khat la, a lum lai khar rawh. Bel-a a vawt hnua dah jam chu chawlhkar hnihah a chunga hnawng a chhuak.

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees sixty a kilo of jam and it keeps a year. Passion grows over every Mamit fence and eight kilos costs the picking.
recipes.why_l: Jam kilo khatah tangka sawmpariat leh sawmruk, tin kum khat a awm thei. Mamit huan kulh tinah passion a chuang a, kilo riat chu la man chauh a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Two hours from the first cut fruit.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Rah at hmasa ber aṭangin darkar hnih.

vessel.en: A heavy pan, a strainer and wide-mouthed glass jars. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel rit, silna leh kam zau glass bel te. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Made in fur and eaten all year.
season.l: Fur lai-ah siam a, kum tin ei a ni.

recipes.name: Sawhthing Achar
recipes.sub: Ginger cut in matchsticks and set in lemon juice, no oil
recipes.sub_l: Sawhthing chu maichher angin at a, serthlum tui-ah a dah, hriak tel lo

method.en: Scrape the skin with a spoon and never peel it with a knife. The layer just under the skin is where the whole smell sits and a knife takes it away.
method.l: A hnawng chu chawpna hmangin hlip la, chhema hlip ngai lo. A hnawng hnuai vela awm chu rim pumpui awmna a ni a, chhem chuan chu chu a la bo.

method.en: Cut in matchsticks and not rounds. A round of sawhthing is too much in one mouthful and the jar goes untouched on the counter.
method.l: Maichher angin at la, tluang angin at suh. Sawhthing tluang chu ka khat atan a tam lutuk a, bel chu sem hnaih velah khawih loh a awm.

method.en: No oil and no heat at any point. The lemon is the whole preservative and it works only if the jar is dry and the ginger is dry.
method.l: Khawi hun mahah hriak leh lum a awm lo. Serthlum chu vawn nan pumpui a ni a, bel a ro a sawhthing a ro chauh chuan a hna a thawk.

method.en: Leave it a week in the sun before it goes to the counter. On the day it is made it is ginger and salt; the week is when it becomes an achar.
method.l: Sem hnaih vel a thleng hmain chawlhkar khat ni-ah dah rawh. Siam ni chuan sawhthing leh mluh a ni; a chawlhkar chuan achar a lo tisiam.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees ninety a kilo, and it is the one thing on a heavy Mizo plate that will settle a stomach after a zawngtah bai. The vaidya asks for it before the cook does.
recipes.why_l: Kilo khatah tangka sawmhnih leh pahnih leh sawmkua, tin zawngtah bai hnua pum tidam thei Mizo thlengbel rit chunga thil pakhat chu hei a ni. Chawmi hmain doctor-in a dil.

start.en: Nothing cooks. Cut, salt and jar in one afternoon, then a week in the sun.
start.l: Engmah chhum a ngai lo. Chawhnu khatah at la, mluh thlak la, bel-ah dah la, chumi hnuah chawlhkar khat ni-ah.

vessel.en: A glass or clay jar with a dry lid. One cook for the cutting.
vessel.l: Khuhna ro nei glass emaw lei bel. At tur chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Made in favang and eaten from thlasik to thal.
season.l: Favang lai-ah siam a, thlasik aṭanga thal thleng ei a ni.

recipes.name: Serthlum Achar
recipes.sub: Lemon cut in wedges and salted down a month before use
recipes.sub_l: Serthlum chu tluangin at a, hman hmain thla khat mluh-ah a dah

method.en: Cut them and put them in salt alone for a month before any spice goes near them. This is not an achar that can be made on the day it is wanted.
method.l: At la, hmangte an hnaih hmain thla khat mluh chauhvah dah rawh. Hei hi a duh ni-ah siam theih achar a ni lo.

method.en: Weigh the fruit down under a stone so the brine covers it. Any wedge standing above the brine grows a white skin and has to be thrown.
method.l: Mluh tui-in a khuh theih nan lung hnuaiah nam rawh. Mluh tui chunga ding tluang apiang chuan hnawng var a chhuah a, paih a ngai.

method.en: Keep the white pith out. The pith is the bitterness in a lemon and it does not go away in a jar however long it stands.
method.l: A chhunga var chu la chhuak rawh. Chu chu serthlum khahna a ni a, bel chhungah a awm rei pawhin a bo lo.

method.en: The spices go on cold and never into a hot pan with the fruit. Heat at this stage turns a lemon achar bitter and there is no recovering it.
method.l: Hmangte chu a vawt lai a thlak a ni a, rah nen bel lum-ah thlak ngai lo. He hunah lum chuan serthlum achar chu a tikhah a, siamthat theih a ni lo.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees ten a kilo and it keeps two years. A temple that salts down five kilos in favang has achar till the next favang.
recipes.why_l: Kilo khatah tangka sawmpali leh sawm, tin kum hnih a awm thei. Favang lai-a kilo nga mluh-ah dah biak in chuan favang leh thlengin achar a nei.

start.en: A month in salt before the spices go on. Planned in favang for thlasik.
start.l: Hmangte thlak hmain thla khat mluh-ah. Thlasik atan favang lai-ah ruahmanh a ni.

vessel.en: A clay jar, a flat stone to weigh it down and a dry ladle. One cook, a month apart.
vessel.l: Lei bel, nam nan lung phen leh chawpna ro. Chawmi pakhat, thla khat kar.

season.en: Made in favang, ready in thlasik, eaten two years.
season.l: Favang lai-ah siam, thlasik-ah a tling, kum hnih ei a ni.

recipes.name: Antam Achar
recipes.sub: Mustard leaf and stalk salted down in a jar for a fortnight
recipes.sub_l: Antam hnah leh a kung chu bel chhungah chawlhkar hnih mluh-ah a dah

method.en: Wilt the leaves a full day in the sun before they go in the jar. A fresh leaf in salt ferments in three days and the jar swells.
method.l: Bel chhunga an luh hmain hnah te chu ni khat famkim ni-ah duai rawh. Mluh chhunga hnah thar chu ni thumah a thur a, bel chu a puak.

method.en: Cut the stalk in and do not throw it. The stalk is a third of the weight and it is the part that keeps its bite for a fortnight.
method.l: A kung chu at luh la, paih suh. A kung chu a rit a thum chhinga pakhat a ni a, chawlhkar hnih chhung a khauhna vawng chu a ni.

method.en: Press it down with a stone so the brine covers it. Any leaf above the brine grows a white skin and the whole jar has to be thrown.
method.l: Mluh tui-in a khuh theih nan lung hmangin nam rawh. Mluh tui chunga hnah apiang chuan hnawng var a chhuah a, bel pumpui paih a ngai.

method.en: Eat it within a fortnight. This is not a year achar; the leaf goes soft after two weeks and the jar smells of it.
method.l: Chawlhkar hnih chhungin ei rawh. Hei hi kum khat achar a ni lo; chawlhkar hnih hnuah hnah chu a nem a, bel chu a rim.

recipes.why: Ten rupees forty a kilo, the cheapest jar on this shelf. In thlasik the antam is fifteen rupees a kilo and seven kilos is a fortnight of achar.
recipes.why_l: Kilo khatah tangka sawm leh sawmli, he thlaite-a bel man tlawm ber. Thlasik lai-ah antam chu kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, kilo sarih chuan chawlhkar hnih achar a ni.

start.en: A day in the sun, then a fortnight in the jar.
start.l: Ni khat ni-ah, chumi hnuah bel chhungah chawlhkar hnih.

vessel.en: A drying mat, a clay jar and a flat stone. One cook.
vessel.l: Duaina phaici, lei bel leh lung phen. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Made in thlasik, eaten in thlasik.
season.l: Thlasik lai-ah siam, thlasik lai-ah ei.

recipes.name: Rawtuai Achar
recipes.sub: Fresh bamboo shoot boiled once and set in oil with chilli
recipes.sub_l: Rawtuai thar chu vawi khat chhum a, hmarcha nen hriak-ah a dah

method.en: Boil the rawtuai once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sharpness and it also carries what makes a jar swell.
method.l: Rawtuai chu tui ngaihngai-ah vawi khat chhum la, chu tui chu paih rawh. Tui hmasa ber chuan a khauhna chu a keng a, bel tipuak thei pawh a keng bawk.

method.en: Dry it on a cloth in the sun a full day before the spice goes on. Rawtuai jarred wet ferments a second time and the lid comes off by itself.
method.l: Hmangte a luh hmain ni khat famkim puan chungah ni-ah ro-in dah rawh. Hnawng lai bel-a dah rawtuai chu vawi hnihna a thur a, a khuhna chu amah ngeiin a chhuak.

method.en: Keep the oil above the level of the shoot. Rawtuai is the first achar on this shelf to spoil if any part of it is sitting dry.
method.l: Hriak chu rawtuai chunglamah dah rawh. A tlangte engemaw ro-in a awm chuan he thlaite-a achar chhia hmasa ber chu rawtuai a ni.

method.en: Use a dry ladle every time. One wet spoon and eight kilos of rawtuai is a jar of froth by the fourth day.
method.l: Vawi tinah chawpna ro hmang rawh. Chawpna hnawng khat chuan ni linaah rawtuai kilo riat chu phuk bel a lo ni.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees thirty a kilo. In fur the shoot comes off the Champhai hill for the cutting, and an achar is how eight kilos of it lasts to the next fur.
recipes.why_l: Kilo khatah tangka sawmpali leh sawmthum. Fur lai-ah rawtuai chu Champhai tlang aṭangin at man chauhvin a lo chhuak a, achar chuan kilo riat chu fur leh thlengin a vawn.

start.en: Boil, dry a full day in the sun, spice and jar. Two days from the hill to the shelf.
start.l: Chhum la, ni khat famkim ni-ah ro-in dah la, hmangte thlak la, bel-ah dah rawh. Tlang aṭanga thlaite thleng ni hnih.

vessel.en: A boiling pot, drying cloths and a clay jar with a dry lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Chhum nan bel, duaina puan te leh khuhna ro nei lei bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Made in fur, eaten all year.
season.l: Fur lai-ah siam, kum tin ei a ni.

recipes.name: Antam Sour Bai
recipes.sub: Sour mustard green broth
recipes.sub_l: Antam thur, a tui nen

method.en: There is no curd in a Mizo kitchen, so there is no kadhi and no raita. What this cuisine has instead is the sour bai, and it does the same job on the plate.
method.l: Mizo chaw suk in-ah hnute a awm lo, kadhi leh raita a awm lo. A aiawh chu bai thur a ni.

method.en: Wash the greens in three changes of water and strip the tough lower stems.
method.l: Thlai chu tui vawi thum thlakin sil la, a kung khauh chu paih rawh.

method.en: Add the chhang with the stems. It softens them and keeps the whole pot green rather than olive.
method.l: Chhang chu a kung nen dah rawh. A tinawi a, bel pumpui a hring reng tir.

method.en: Boil hard with the lid off from start to finish. A lid traps the sulphur and the greens go dull within minutes.
method.l: A tirah atanga a tawp thlengin khuh lovin nasa takin thlawp rawh.

method.en: Crumble the bekang in for the last ten minutes and add the tomato with it.
method.l: A tawp minute 10-ah bekang chal la, tomato nen dah rawh.

method.en: Finish with lemon off the fire and keep it genuinely thin. This is drunk from the bowl alongside rice, not ladled over it.
method.l: Mei atanga la chhuah hnuah serthlum dah la, a tui takin dah rawh.

recipes.why: The sour dish a kitchen without dairy has instead of a kadhi, and it costs a fraction of one.
recipes.why_l: Hnute nei lo chaw suk in tan kadhi aiawh a ni a, a man a tlawm zawk.

start.en: Wash the greens three times. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Thlai chu vawi thum sil rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 30 L, khuh lo. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: November to March, when the antam is in.
season.l: November atanga March thleng.

recipes.name: Bamboo Sour Soup
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo shoot broth
recipes.sub_l: Maian tui

method.en: Rinse the maian twice in cold water and squeeze it out. Straight from the jar it is far too sour for a soup.
method.l: Maian chu tui dai-ah vawi hnih sil la, hnawh chhuak rawh. Bel atanga la chhuah mai chu a thur lutuk.

method.en: Keep the second rinse water aside. It goes back in at the end, a little at a time, once the soup has been tasted.
method.l: A vawi hnihna sil tui chu dah bel rawh. A tawpah tlem te zelin dah leh theih a ni.

method.en: Fry the drained maian in the oil for five minutes before anything else goes in. This takes the raw edge off the ferment.
method.l: Maian chu hriak-ah minute 5 chhum hmasa rawh. Chuan a thur hel chu a bo ang.

method.en: Add the potato and water and cook twenty minutes until the potato is soft enough to mash against the side.
method.l: Alu leh tui dah la, minute 20 thlawp la, alu chu bel kaah nep theih thlengin.

method.en: Mash a few pieces of potato into the broth. That is what gives it body — there is no dairy and no flour here.
method.l: Alu thenkhat chu tui-ah nep rawh. Chuan a khauh ang — hnute leh chhang a tel lo.

method.en: Add the tomato and bekang in the last ten minutes. Salt at the very end, because the maian brought its own.
method.l: A tawp minute 10-ah tomato leh bekang dah rawh. Chi chu a tawp berah, maian-ah a tel tawh avangin.

recipes.why: Sour, hot and thin, and made from a jar that has been standing since August. Salt last.
recipes.why_l: A thur, a ur, a tui. August atanga dah bel atanga siam a ni. Chi chu a tawpah.

start.en: Rinse the maian twice. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Maian chu vawi hnih sil rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 30 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year — maian keeps a year in its jar.
season.l: Kum tin — maian chu kum khat a awm thei.

recipes.name: Curd Raita
recipes.sub: Curd with cucumber and cumin
recipes.sub_l: Hnute, fanghma leh jeera nen

method.en: This dish is not Mizo and the book should say so. It is here because a temple kitchen serves curd and because nothing in this cuisine fills the same place on a thali.
method.l: He chaw hi Mizo chaw a ni lo. Biak in chaw suk in-ah hnute an sem avangin a awm a ni.

method.en: Curd is not made in these hills and has to be brought in or set in the temple kitchen itself.
method.l: He tlangah hnute an siam ngai lo va, pawn atanga hruai lut emaw, biak in-ah siam emaw a ngai.

method.en: Grate the cucumber and squeeze the water out in the hand, keeping that water to thin the curd.
method.l: Fanghma chu chhiat la, kutin a tui hnawh chhuak la, chu tui chu hnute tui nan dah rawh.

method.en: Whisk the curd smooth with that liquid and both salts.
method.l: Hnute chu chu tui leh chi hnihte nen sawi nal rawh.

method.en: Taste it cold — chilled curd needs more salt than it seems to.
method.l: A dai lai tem rawh — hnute dai chuan chi tam zawk a ngai.

method.en: Fold in the cucumber, green chilli and roasted cumin, and serve cold.
method.l: Fanghma, hmarcha leh jeera dah la, a dai lain sem rawh.

recipes.why: Imported, and marked as such. It fills the place on the thali that a Mizo kitchen has never needed to fill.
recipes.why_l: Pawn lam atanga lo kal a ni a, chutiang chuan ziak a ni.

start.en: Make it within an hour of serving.
start.l: Sem hma darkar khat chhungin siam rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 30 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year, and doubled in summer.
season.l: Kum tin, a lum lai chuan a let hnih.

recipes.name: Fanghma Raita
recipes.sub: Cucumber grated into thin curd with roasted cumin
recipes.sub_l: Fanghma chu hnute sek-ah thlur a, jeera kang nen

method.en: Grate the fanghma and squeeze it dry before it meets the curd. Five kilos gives up two litres and that water thins twenty litres to nothing.
method.l: Hnute a tawh hmain fanghma chu thlur la, ro-in chhir rawh. Kilo nga chuan litre hnih a pe a, chu tui chuan litre 20 chu a tihsek vek.

method.en: Taste the stem end before it goes in. One bitter fanghma in five kilos is found by four devotees and remembered by all of them.
method.l: A luh hmain a kung lam chu tem rawh. Kilo nga zinga fanghma khah pakhat chu mi li-in an hmu a, an zain an hre reng.

method.en: Whisk the curd with the water first and get it smooth before the cucumber goes in. Lumps of curd will not break once there is anything solid in the vessel.
method.l: Fanghma a luh hmain hnute chu tui nen chhawm la, tihnem rawh. Bel chhungah thil khauh a awm chuan hnute bal chu a kek thei tawh lo.

method.en: Roast the cumin dry and crush it coarse, do not use a powder. A raita is a plain thing and the jeera is the only interest it has.
method.l: Jeera chu ro-in kang la, sang zawkin dengin; vut hmang suh. Raita chu thil ngaihngai a ni a, jeera chauh chu a hlutna a ni.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees fifty a head and no fire under it. In thal the fanghma is twenty rupees a kilo at Bara Bazar and a cold bowl on a hot day empties before the buh does.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh sawmnga, a hnuaiah mei a awm lo. Thal lai-ah fanghma chu Bara Bazar-ah kilo khat tangka sawmhnih a ni a, ni lum ni-ah kchu vawt chu buh hmain a ral.

start.en: Curd is set the night before. Grate half an hour before the bell.
start.l: Hnute chu a ni hmaa zanah khal a ni. Dar a ri hmain darkar chanve-ah thlur rawh.

vessel.en: A grater, a squeezing cloth and a shallow 25 L tray. One cook.
vessel.l: Thlurna, chhirna puan leh litre 25 tray sek. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Thal to fur, while the fanghma is in the market.
season.l: Thal aṭanga fur thleng, fanghma bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Alu Raita
recipes.sub: Potato boiled, broken by hand and folded into thin curd
recipes.sub_l: Alu chhum, kut hmangin kek a, hnute sek-ah a chhawm

method.en: Boil the alu in the skin and break it by hand. A knife-cut potato in curd keeps its edges and the raita never takes hold of it.
method.l: Alu chu a hnawng nen chhum la, kut hmangin kek rawh. Hnute chhunga chhema at alu chuan a kam chu a vawn a, raita chuan a vawn thei lo.

method.en: Let it go completely cold before it meets the curd. Warm potato splits ten kilos of curd before the vessel reaches the counter.
method.l: Hnute a tawh hmain a vawt famkim tur a ni. Alu lum chuan bel chu sem hnaih vel a thleng hmain hnute kilo sawm chu a tiinṭhen.

method.en: Black salt as well as salt. An alu raita without black salt tastes of nothing and twenty litres comes back half eaten.
method.l: Mluh nen mluh dum bawk. Mluh dum tel lo alu raita chu engmah tui a nei lo a, litre 20 chu chanve ei-in a rawn kir.

method.en: Keep it shallow and cold. A deep vessel of raita warms from the middle out and sours before the line has passed.
method.l: Sek leh vawtin dah rawh. Raita bel thuk chu a lai aṭangin a lum a, mi zawng zawng an lo kal hmain a thur.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees ninety a head. Alu is in an Aizawl store room every month of the year and this is the raita for a thlasik day when there is nothing fresh to grate.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh sawmkua. Kum chhung thla tinah Aizawl thil dahnaah alu a awm a, hei hi thlur tur thar engmah awm loh thlasik ni-a raita a ni.

start.en: Potatoes boil the night before and go cold. Twenty minutes on the day.
start.l: Alu chu a ni hmaa zanah chhum a, a vawt tur a ni. A ni ah minute sawmhnih.

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a shallow 25 L tray. One cook.
vessel.l: Chhum nan bel leh litre 25 tray sek. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and the thlasik raita when the tunnels have nothing.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thlai in-ah engmah awm loh thlasik lai raita.

recipes.name: Boondi Raita
recipes.sub: Gram flour drops soaked warm and folded into salted curd
recipes.sub_l: Besan tlangte chu tui lum-ah dah a, mluh nei hnute-ah a chhawm

method.en: Soak the boondi in warm water two minutes and squeeze it between the palms. Dropped hard into curd it stays hard and drinks the raita dry.
method.l: Boondi chu tui lum-ah minute hnih dah la, kutphah kara chhir rawh. Khauh lai hnute-ah thlak chuan a khauh reng a, raita chu a in ro.

method.en: The batter for the boondi is thin, about the run of a dosa batter. A thick batter gives tails on every drop and the tails are felt in the mouth.
method.l: Boondi chhang chu a sek a, dosa chhang luan ang chiah. Chhang sang chuan a tlang tinah a mei a siam a, chu mei chu kaah a hriat.

method.en: Hold the perforated ladle a hand above the oil. Held close, the drops join before they land and come out as a sheet.
method.l: Chawpna kua nei chu hriak chunga kut khat sanah vawng rawh. A hnaih taka vawng chuan a tlangte chu an tla hmain an inzawm a, phen khat angin a lo chhuak.

method.en: Fold it in at the counter. Boondi in curd for half an hour is a bowl of paste and the whole point of it is the give.
method.l: Sem hnaih velah chhawm luh rawh. Hnute chhunga darkar chanve awm boondi chu bal kchu a lo ni a, a hlutna pumpui chu a nemna a ni.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees twenty a head. The boondi is fried in a spare hour and kept in a tin, so on a thlasik day when nothing fresh can be grated this is the raita a kitchen reaches for.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpanga leh sawmhnih. Boondi chu darkar zalen khatah chhum a, tin-ah dah a ni a; chuvangin thlur tur thar awm loh thlasik ni-ah chawthlengin a hmuh chhuah raita chu hei a ni.

start.en: Boondi can be fried a fortnight ahead and kept in a tin. Twenty minutes on the day.
start.l: Boondi chu chawlhkar hnih hmaa chhum a, tin-ah dah theih a ni. A ni ah minute sawmhnih.

vessel.en: A deep kadai and a perforated ladle for the boondi; a 25 L tray for the raita. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Boondi atan kadai thuk leh chawpna kua nei; raita atan litre 25 tray. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: All year, and the thlasik raita when the store room has nothing to grate.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thil dahnaah thlur tur engmah awm loh thlasik lai raita.

recipes.name: Kadhi Bora
recipes.sub: Gram flour bora dropped into a sour curd kadhi at the counter
recipes.sub_l: Besan bora chu sem hnaih velah hnute thur kadhi-ah a thlak

method.en: The curd should be a day old and sour. Fresh curd gives a kadhi that tastes of besan and of nothing else, and the sourness is the whole dish.
method.l: Hnute chu ni khat awm leh thur tur a ni. Hnute thar chuan besan tui chauh nei kadhi a pe a, a thurna chu chaw pumpui a ni.

method.en: Whisk the besan into cold curd and get every lump out before any heat. A lump that reaches hot kadhi never breaks up again.
method.l: Besan chu hnute vawt-ah chhawm luh la, lum a thleng hmain a bal zawng zawng chu la chhuak rawh. Kadhi lum thleng bal chu a kek leh ngai lo.

method.en: Boil it a full forty minutes before the bora go in. A kadhi cooked twenty minutes tastes raw however good the curd was.
method.l: Bora an luh hmain minute sawmli famkim chhum rawh. Minute sawmhnih chhung chhum kadhi chu hnute a tha pawh ni se a thing tui a nei.

method.en: Drop the bora in ten minutes before serving and no earlier. An hour in the kadhi and they are paste and the vessel is a besan soup.
method.l: Sem hmain minute sawm chauhvin bora chu thlak rawh. Kadhi-ah darkar khat awm chuan bal a lo ni a, bel chu besan tui a lo ni.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees ninety a head. The plain sour bai on this shelf is the everyday one; this is the Chapchar Kut version and worth the extra six rupees.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpasarih leh sawmkua. He thlaite-a bai thur ngaihngai chu ni tin tan a ni; hei hi Chapchar Kut tan a ni a, tangka ruk belhchhah man a tlin.

start.en: The curd should be a day old. Bora are fried while the kadhi boils. Two hours in all.
start.l: Hnute chu ni khat awm tur a ni. Kadhi a chhum lai bora chu chhum a ni. A zawng zawngin darkar hnih.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, a deep kadai and a tempering pan. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel, kadai thuk leh tihremna bel. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: All year, and at Chapchar Kut above all.
season.l: Kum tin, tin Chapchar Kut-ah a bik takin.

recipes.name: Tomato Raita
recipes.sub: Tomato roasted, peeled and broken into thin curd
recipes.sub_l: Tomato kang, hnawng hlip a, hnute sek-ah a kek

method.en: Roast the tomato on the flame and peel it before it goes into the curd. A raw tomato in curd sours nine kilos of it within the hour.
method.l: Hnute a luh hmain tomato chu mei chungah kang la, a hnawng hlip rawh. Hnute chhunga tomato thing chuan darkar khat chhungin kilo kua chu a tithur.

method.en: Break it by hand and do not chop it. A knife-cut tomato bleeds and the whole vessel is pink instead of white with red in it.
method.l: Kut hmangin kek la, chhema at suh. Chhema at tomato chu a luang a, bel pumpui chu var leh sen ni lovin a sen dur mai.

method.en: A pinch of sugar against the chilli and the tomato. It is what a Mizo kitchen puts in a curd dish and nobody can name it afterwards.
method.l: Hmarcha leh tomato dodalna atan sugar tlemte. Chu chu Mizo chawthlengin hnute chaw chhungah a thlak a ni a, a hnuah tuman a hming a sawi thei lo.

method.en: Fold it in at the counter and keep it shallow. A deep vessel warms from the middle and a warm tomato raita is thrown, not served.
method.l: Sem hnaih velah chhawm luh la, sekin dah rawh. Bel thuk chu a lai aṭangin a lum a, tomato raita lum chu sem ni lovin paih a ni.

recipes.why: Ten rupees eighty a head, and it is the raita to make when the fanghma season is over. Tomato is at Bara Bazar every month of the year.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmriat, tin fanghma hun a ral hnua siam tur raita chu hei a ni. Kum chhung thla tinah Bara Bazar-ah tomato a awm.

start.en: Curd is set the night before. Roast and peel half an hour before the bell.
start.l: Hnute chu a ni hmaa zanah khal a ni. Dar a ri hmain darkar chanve-ah kang la hlip rawh.

vessel.en: An open flame and a shallow 25 L tray. One cook.
vessel.l: Mei hawng leh litre 25 tray sek. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and cheapest in favang.
season.l: Kum tin, tin favang lai a man tlawm ber.

recipes.name: Buh-bal
recipes.sub: Plain rice porridge with ginger
recipes.sub_l: Buh-bal, sawhthing nen

method.en: Cook the rice with plenty of water until the grains have burst completely. This is a porridge and it should pour.
method.l: Buh chu tui tam takin a chhia hlen hlen thlengin thlawp rawh. Hei hi bal a ni a, a luang tur a ni.

method.en: Do not add chhang. Alkali in a plain porridge makes it slippery and this dish is meant to be gentle.
method.l: Chhang dah suh. Bal-ah chuan a nal lutuk ang.

method.en: Season with black pepper rather than chilli. This is the dish given to someone who is unwell.
method.l: Hmarcha ai chuan hmarcha dum dah rawh. Hei hi mi dam lo tan a ni.

method.en: Stir up from the bottom every few minutes with a flat ladle. Rice settles and catches, and once it has caught the whole vessel tastes of it.
method.l: Minute tlemte zelin bel bul atangin kaihkawh rawh.

method.en: Add the ginger only in the last five minutes so it stays sharp.
method.l: Sawhthing chu a tawp minute 5-ah dah rawh.

method.en: Keep hot water aside. It thickens hard as it stands and is loosened rather than cooked further.
method.l: Tui lum dah bel rawh. A khauh zel a, thlawp belh lovin tiuain rawh.

recipes.why: Six kilos of rice and nothing else. It is what a Mizo household gives a child or a sick person.
recipes.why_l: Buh kg 6 leh engmah dang a tel lo. Naupang leh mi dam lo hnenah an pe thin.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel. One cook who stays with it.
vessel.l: Bel rit 40 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year. Given to anyone who is unwell.
season.l: Kum tin. Mi dam lo hnenah pek a ni.

recipes.name: Sabzi Buh-bal
recipes.sub: Rice porridge with vegetables
recipes.sub_l: Buh-bal, thlai nen

method.en: Add the taro first and cook it twenty minutes before the rice goes in. It breaks down and thickens the pot.
method.l: Dawl chu hmasain dah la, buh dah hmain minute 20 thlawp rawh.

method.en: Cut the vegetables to the same size. Mixed sizes mean the carrot is raw when the beans are collapsing.
method.l: Thlai chu a lian dan inang lo takin at rawh.

method.en: Add the chhang with the hard vegetables only. Rice does not need it and alkali makes a porridge slippery.
method.l: Chhang chu thlai khauh nen chauh dah rawh. Buh-ah chuan a ngai lo.

method.en: Crumble the bekang in halfway through so it breaks down into the pot rather than sitting on top.
method.l: Bekang chu a kim chanve-ah chal rawh, chutichuan bel-ah a chhia ang.

method.en: Cook until the rice grains have burst completely.
method.l: Buh a chhia hlen hlen thlengin thlawp rawh.

method.en: Keep hot water aside — it thickens a great deal as it stands.
method.l: Tui lum dah bel rawh — a khauh zel a ni.

recipes.why: One vessel and whatever came in. The taro does the thickening that a dal would do elsewhere.
recipes.why_l: Bel khat leh thil awm apiang. Dawl hian dal hna a thawk.

start.en: Cut the vegetables an hour ahead. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Thlai chu darkar khat hmain at rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy 45 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bel rit 45 L. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: All year with whatever came in.
season.l: Kum tin, thil awm apiang nen.

recipes.name: Moong Buh-bal
recipes.sub: Rice and moong dal porridge
recipes.sub_l: Buh leh mung bal

method.en: Use more dal and less rice than in an ordinary buh-bal. That is what makes this the dish given to someone unwell.
method.l: Buh-bal danga aiin mung tam zawk dah rawh.

method.en: Wash both in three changes of water and soak thirty minutes.
method.l: Pahnihin tui vawi thum thlakin sil la, minute 30 dah rawh.

method.en: Cook it looser than a plain buh-bal — closer to four parts water than three.
method.l: Buh-bal danga aiin a tui zawkin thlawp rawh.

method.en: Season with black pepper rather than chilli. This is meant to be gentle and chilli defeats the purpose entirely.
method.l: Hmarcha ai chuan hmarcha dum dah rawh.

method.en: Stir up from the bottom every few minutes. Dal settles and catches, and once it has caught the whole vessel tastes of it.
method.l: Minute tlemte zelin bel bul atangin kaihkawh rawh.

method.en: Add the ginger only in the last five minutes and finish with coriander.
method.l: Sawhthing chu a tawp minute 5-ah dah la, hnahchiar dah rawh.

recipes.why: The dish to have ready when someone cannot eat what everyone else is eating. Nothing in it is heavy.
recipes.why_l: Mi dang ei an ei theih loh hunah a tha. Rit a tel lo.

start.en: Soak rice and dal thirty minutes. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Buh leh mung chu minute 30 dah rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel rit 40 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year. The dish for a sick tray and for a child.
season.l: Kum tin. Mi dam lo leh naupang tan.

recipes.name: Bepui Buh-bal
recipes.sub: Rice and soybean cooked soft in one vessel with chhang water
recipes.sub_l: Buh leh bepui chu bel khatah chhang tui nen nemin a chhum

method.en: Soak the bepui eight hours and cook it half done before the rice goes in. Started together, the rice is paste while the bean is still a bead.
method.l: Bepui chu darkar riat tui-ah dah la, buh a luh hmain a chanve chhum rawh. Khawmin tan chuan bepui chu be ang bawka a awm lai buh chu bal a lo ni.

method.en: Rub the skins off after soaking. A bepui skin does not soften and it is felt in every spoon of thirty-two litres.
method.l: Tui-a a dah hnuah a hnawng chu chhir chhuak rawh. Bepui hnawng chu a nem lo va, litre 32-a chawpna tinah a hriat.

method.en: Four parts water to one of grain and let it go soft. This is not a pulao; a buh-bal with separate grains has failed at what it was for.
method.l: Buh pakhat-ah tui pali, tin a nem ang che. Hei hi pulao a ni lo; buh chi inṭhen nei buh-bal chuan a tum chu a hlen thei lo.

method.en: Raw mustard oil over each plate at the counter. In a Mizo buh-bal that spoon of uncooked oil is what a ghee would be elsewhere.
method.l: Sem hnaih velah thlengbel tin chungah antam hriak thing. Mizo buh-bal ah chuan hriak thing chawpna khat chu hmun danga ghee ang chu a ni.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees fifty a head, one vessel and one cook. Two kilos of bepui gives a hundred people the protein of a meal without a second pot on the fire.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh pahnih leh sawmnga, bel khat leh chawmi pakhat. Bepui kilo hnih chuan mei chunga bel hnihna dah lovin mi za-a tan chaw thanna a pe.

start.en: Bepui soaks eight hours. Start the evening before.
start.l: Bepui chu darkar riat tui-ah a awm. A ni hmaa tlaiah tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nghet nei litre 40 bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and any day the hall is short of cooks.
season.l: Kum tin, tin chawmi a tlachham ni apiangah.

recipes.name: Masoor Buh-bal
recipes.sub: Whole masoor cooked with rice until the skins split
recipes.sub_l: Masoor pum chu buh nen a chhum, a hnawng a kek thlengin

method.en: Soak the masoor two hours. The whole lentil has a skin and an unsoaked one is still a bead when the rice has gone to paste.
method.l: Masoor chu darkar hnih tui-ah dah rawh. Masoor pum chuan hnawng a nei a, tui-a dah loh chu buh bal a lo nih lai pawhin be ang bawkin a awm.

method.en: Cook the masoor twenty minutes before the rice goes in. Started together, this is a buh-bal with hard lentils and broken rice in the same spoon.
method.l: Buh a luh hmain masoor chu minute sawmhnih chhum rawh. Khawmin tan chuan chawpna khatah masoor khauh leh buh kek nei buh-bal a lo ni.

method.en: Tomato in the last ten minutes only. Cooked from the start it goes to a paste and the buh-bal has a sour taste nobody can place.
method.l: Tomato chu minute sawm hnuhnung berah chauh. Tir aṭanga chhum chuan bal a lo ni a, buh-bal chuan tuman a hriatthiam loh thur tui a nei.

method.en: Take it off looser than it should be. Masoor drinks for twenty minutes in the vessel and comes to the counter right.
method.l: A dan aiin sek zawkin la chhuak rawh. Masoor chuan bel chhungah minute sawmhnih a in a, sem hnaih velah a dik takin a thleng.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees fifty a head, and masoor is the cheapest whole pulse at Bara Bazar eight months of the year. It cooks in half the time a bepui takes.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh sawmnga, tin kum chhunga thla riat chu Bara Bazar-ah masoor chu be pum man tlawm ber a ni. Bepui hun a hmuh chanve chhungin a chhum.

start.en: Masoor soaks two hours. Three hours before the bell in all.
start.l: Masoor chu darkar hnih tui-ah a awm. Dar a ri hmain darkar thum a tul.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 40 bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and every second day in thlasik.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thlasik lai ni hnih danah.

recipes.name: Mai Buh-bal
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked into the buh-bal until it thickens it
recipes.sub_l: Mai chu buh-bal chhungah a chhum, a tisang thlengin

method.en: Cut the mai large, an inch to the side. A small dice dissolves and thirty-four litres is orange with nothing to find in it.
method.l: Mai chu lian zawkin at la, a kam inch khat. At tlemte chuan a duai a, litre 34 chu a sen a, a chhungah hmuh tur engmah a awm lo.

method.en: The mai goes in when the rice is half done. From the start it is gone; at the end it is raw in the middle.
method.l: Buh a chanve a chhum hunah mai chu a lut. Tir aṭanga a luh chuan a bo a; a tawpa a luh chuan a laiah a thing.

method.en: The mai is what thickens this buh-bal and no flour is needed. Six kilos in thirty-four is the whole measure.
method.l: He buh-bal tisang chu mai a ni a, chhang a tul lo. Litre 34-ah kilo ruk chu teh nihna pumpui a ni.

method.en: Keep it looser than it should be. Mai drinks for twenty minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a solid in the hall.
method.l: A dan aiin sek zawkin dah rawh. Mei a mit hnuah mai chuan minute sawmhnih a in a, chawthlengah a dik chu in chhungah a khauh.

recipes.why: Ten rupees twenty a head. Six kilos of mai takes the place of a kilo of dal and in favang a Mamit jhum gives more than the kitchen can use.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmhnih. Mai kilo ruk chuan dal kilo khat hmun a luah a, favang lai-ah Mamit lo chuan chawthleng hman zawng aiin a tam zawk a pe.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, and the mai is cut while the rice comes to the boil.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmnga, tin buh a chhum lai mai chu at a ni.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 40 bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, lo aṭangin, chumi hnuah thil dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Antam Buh-bal
recipes.sub: Mustard leaf folded in at the end so the buh-bal stays green
recipes.sub_l: Antam hnah chu a tawpah chhawm luh, buh-bal a hring reng theih nan

method.en: Chop the antam and keep it aside until the buh-bal is done. Cooked from the start, five kilos of it turns thirty-two litres the colour of a wet road.
method.l: Antam chu at la, buh-bal a chhum hma chuan a hrangin dah rawh. Tir aṭanga chhum chuan kilo nga chuan litre 32 chu kawng hnawng rawng a siam.

method.en: Fold it in with the fire off and put the lid on four minutes. The heat left in the vessel wilts it and nothing more is needed.
method.l: Mei mit hnuah chhawm luh la, minute li khuh rawh. Bel chhunga lum nghak chuan a tiduai a, thil dang a tul lo.

method.en: Half a litre of chhang water and no more. Chhang holds the green; a litre of it and thirty-two litres tastes of soap.
method.l: Chhang tui litre chanve chauh, chu aia tam lo. Chhang chuan a hringna chu a vawn; litre khat chuan litre 32 chu sabuar angin a tui.

method.en: Serve within the half hour. Antam in a warm vessel goes from green to grey faster than any other leaf on this shelf.
method.l: Darkar chanve chhungin sem rawh. Bel lum chhunga antam chu he thlaite-a hnah dang zawng zawng aiin hring aṭanga vardum a lo ni rang.

recipes.why: Ten rupees eighty a head, and in thlasik the antam is the cheapest green at Bara Bazar. Green on a plate in that month is worth putting on the board for its own sake.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmriat, tin thlasik lai-ah Bara Bazar-ah antam chu thlai hring man tlawm ber a ni. Chu thla-a thlengbel chunga hringna chu amah ngei avang pawhin thlirna board-ah dah tlak a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the antam is chopped while the buh-bal cooks.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, tin buh-bal a chhum lai antam chu at a ni.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid. Two cooks — one for the chopping.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 40 bel. Chawmi pahnih — pakhat chu at tur.

season.en: Favang to thal, while the antam is in the market.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, antam bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Bekang Buh-bal
recipes.sub: Fermented soybean folded into the buh-bal off the fire
recipes.sub_l: Bekang chu mei aṭanga la chhuah hnuah buh-bal-ah a chhawm

method.en: The bekang goes in with the fire off. Boiled twenty minutes it loses the smell it is bought for and becomes an ordinary bean.
method.l: Bekang chu mei mit hnuah a lut. Minute sawmhnih chhum chuan a lei chhan rim chu a hloh a, be ngaihngai a lo ni.

method.en: Crush half and leave half whole. The crushed half carries through thirty-two litres and the whole half is what a Mizo looks for in the plate.
method.l: A chanve dengin, a chanve chu a pumin dah rawh. A chanve deng chuan litre 32 chu a thleng a, a chanve pum chu Mizoin thlengbel chhunga a zawn a ni.

method.en: Cook the buh-bal uncovered from the moment the bekang goes in. Under a lid two kilos of it will empty a hall.
method.l: Bekang a luh atang chuan buh-bal chu khuh lovin chhum rawh. Khuh chuan kilo hnih chuan in khat a tihruak thei.

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. A bekang is salted in the jar and a hundred and ninety grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: Mluh a luh hmain tem rawh. Bekang chu bel chhungah mluh thlak tawh a ni a, gram 190 chu bel engemaw zat tan a tam tawh.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees fifty a head. Bekang is the protein of a Mizo meal and two kilos gives a hundred people what a kilo of paneer would at four times the price.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpathum leh sawmnga. Bekang chu Mizo chaw thanna a ni a, kilo hnih chuan man vawi li to paneer kilo khatin a pe tur chu mi za a pe.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the bekang in the last five.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, tin bekang chu minute nga hnuhnung berah.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel, uncovered at the end. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 40 bel, a tawpah khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, out of the jar put down in fur.
season.l: Kum tin, fur lai-a dah bel aṭangin.

recipes.name: Chhang
recipes.sub: Alkaline water filtered from wood ash
recipes.sub_l: Vut atanga chhuah chhang tui

method.en: Chhang is alkaline water made by filtering water through wood ash, and it is the one technique in this book a cook from outside will not have met.
method.l: Chhang hi vut atanga chhuah tui a ni a, he lehkhabu-a hnathawh dan hriat loh ber a ni.

method.en: Burn dried banana stems and bamboo to a clean white-grey ash. Do not use ash from a fire that has had oil, plastic or painted wood in it.
method.l: Balhla kung ro leh rua ro chu vut var hlen thlengin hal rawh. Hriak, plastic emaw thing hnawih emaw hal a vut hmang suh.

method.en: Steep the cooled ash in the water overnight, stirring twice.
method.l: A vut daih chu tui-ah zan khat dah la, vawi hnih kaihkawh rawh.

method.en: Filter it through four layers of cloth the next morning and discard the ash. The liquid should be clear and pale straw-coloured, and it will feel slippery between the fingers.
method.l: A tuk zingah puan phek li hmangin chher la, a vut chu paih rawh. A tui chu a fai a, kutzung karah a nal ang.

method.en: That slippery feel is the alkali and it is what softens a tough green or a hard bean. Taste a drop on the tongue — it should be faintly bitter, not sharp.
method.l: Chu a nal chu chhang a ni a, thlai khauh leh be nghet a tinawi. A dawn tlemte tem la — a kha tlemte tur a ni.

method.en: Use it a spoon at a time and never more than a recipe says. Too much chhang gives a soapy taste and a slippery texture that cannot be corrected, and it is the commonest way this whole cuisine goes wrong.
method.l: Tlem te zelin hmang la, ziak aia tam hmang suh. Chhang tam lutuk chuan siam tha leh theih a ni tawh lo.

recipes.why: It softens greens and pulses, keeps them green, and cuts the fuel. Nothing else in this book does all three.
recipes.why_l: Thlai a tinawi a, a hring a humhalh a, thing a tihtlem. Thil dang chuan a ti thei lo.

start.en: Burn the material, steep the ash overnight, filter the next morning.
start.l: Hal la, a vut chu zan khat dah la, a tuk zingah chher rawh.

vessel.en: A clean drum, a cloth filter and a storage jar. One cook.
