vessel.l: Drum thianghlim, puan chherna leh dahna bel. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: Made whenever the jar runs low. The ash keeps indefinitely.
season.l: Bel a tlem hunah siam. A vut chu rei tak a awm thei.

recipes.name: Chilli Powder
recipes.sub: Dried and ground bird's eye chilli
recipes.sub_l: Hmarcha te ro, sukin

method.en: Grind this outdoors and never in a closed kitchen. The airborne dust will empty a room and it genuinely hurts to breathe.
method.l: Pawnah suk la, chaw suk in khar chhungah suk suh. A vut hian in a tikeng ang.

method.en: Wear cloth over the nose and mouth and gloves on the hands, and wash the grinder outside afterwards.
method.l: Hnar leh ka chu puanin tuam la, kut chu tuam bawk rawh.

method.en: Dry the chillies whole in full sun for a week until they rattle when shaken.
method.l: Hmarcha chu a pumin chhun khat ni-ah tikang rawh, a sin hunah a ri thleng.

method.en: Do not dry them over a fire. Smoke-dried chilli tastes of the fire and not of the chilli, which is fine for a rawt and wrong for a powder.
method.l: Mei chungah tikang suh. Meikhu-a kang chuan mei rim a nei ang.

method.en: Grind in short bursts, letting the dust settle in the machine between each, and open the lid away from the face.
method.l: Rei lo te zelin suk la, a vut a thlen hnuah hawng rawh, hmai lam pan lo takin.

method.en: A kilo and a half is more than a temple kitchen will use in a year. Label the jar clearly and keep it separate from the ordinary chilli.
method.l: Kg 1.5 hi kum khat chhung tan a tam tawh. Bel-ah ziak la, hmarcha danga nen dah suh.

recipes.why: A year's supply from five kilos, and the only recipe in this book that needs a mask.
recipes.why_l: Kg 5 atanga kum khat chhung tur. Hmai tuam ngai chhun a ni.

start.en: Sun-dry the chillies a week. Grind outdoors, wearing cloth over the face.
start.l: Hmarcha chu chhun khat ni-ah tikang rawh. Pawnah suk la, hmai chu tuam rawh.

vessel.en: Drying trays and a dry grinder. One cook, gloved and masked.
vessel.l: Tikanna tray leh hnawihna. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: Made in October when the chillies ripen.
season.l: October-ah siam, hmarcha min lai.

recipes.name: Roasted Sesame Powder
recipes.sub: Sesame ground with salt and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Chhawhchhi, chi leh hmarcha nen suk

method.en: This is the dry dip that goes beside boiled food, and in these hills it does the work a wet chutney does elsewhere.
method.l: Hei hi thlai chhum bulah dah tur chartawk ro a ni.

method.en: Roast the sesame on a dry pan on a low flame until it pops steadily and turns a shade darker.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu bel ro-ah mei tlem berah a puak zel thlengin kang rawh.

method.en: Take it off the moment it smells. Sesame goes from roasted to burnt in about thirty seconds and burnt til is bitter right through.
method.l: A rim a chhuah veleh la chhuak rawh. Second 30 chhungin a kang zo thei.

method.en: Cool completely before pounding. Warm sesame turns to a paste instead of a powder.
method.l: Suk hmain tidai fel rawh. A lum lai suk chuan a nal ang.

method.en: Pound with the salt rather than grinding in a machine. The salt keeps the seed from oiling up under the pestle.
method.l: Machine-a hnawih lovin chi nen sum-ah suk rawh. Chi hian a hriak a chhuah lo tir.

method.en: Add the dried chilli last and in a very small quantity — sixty grams in three kilos. This is a dip, not a chilli powder.
method.l: Hmarcha ro chu a tawpah, tlem te dah rawh — kg 3-ah gram 60.

recipes.why: The dry dip that turns boiled tubers into a meal, and it keeps two months in a tin.
recipes.why_l: Bahra chhum chu chaw a tihnihna. Bawm-ah thla hnih a awm.

start.en: Roast, cool and grind the same day. Keeps two months.
start.l: Chumi ni-ah kang la, tidai la, suk rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy pan and a mortar. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel rit leh sum. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year.
season.l: Kum tin.

recipes.name: Sawhthing Vut
recipes.sub: Ginger dried three days in the sun and milled fine
recipes.sub_l: Sawhthing chu ni thum ni-ah ro-in dah a, sang zawkin a deng

method.en: Slice it thin before it goes in the sun. A whole sawhthing takes eight days to dry in Aizawl and it goes black on the fourth.
method.l: Ni-ah a luh hmain sekin at rawh. Sawhthing pum chu Aizawl-ah ni riat ro-a a ngai a, ni linaah a dum.

method.en: Three days in the sun and one night in a warm kitchen. A ginger that is not bone dry moulds in the tin within a fortnight.
method.l: Ni thum ni-ah, tin zan khat chawthleng lum-ah. Ro famkim lo sawhthing chu chawlhkar hnih chhungin tin-ah a duk.

method.en: Eight kilos of fresh ginger gives a kilo and a half of powder. A kitchen that does not know that buys eight and expects eight.
method.l: Sawhthing thar kilo riat chuan vut kilo khat leh chanve a pe. Chu hre lo chawthleng chuan riat a lei a, riat a beisei.

method.en: Dry ginger is four times the strength of the fresh root. A hundred grams stands where four hundred of fresh would.
method.l: Sawhthing ro chu sawhthing thar aiin vawi li a nghet. Gram 100 chuan gram 400 thar awmna hmun ah a ding.

recipes.why: Five hundred and seventy rupees a kilo of powder, and it is what lets a Jain plate be cooked in the same kitchen on the same morning as everything else.
recipes.why_l: Vut kilo khatah tangka za nga leh sawmsarih, tin chu chuan Jain thlengbel chu thil dang zawng zawng nen chawthleng khatah zing khatah chhum theihin a siam.

start.en: Three days in the sun and one night indoors. Two hours at the mill.
start.l: Ni thum ni-ah, tin zan khat in chhungah. Denna-ah darkar hnih.

vessel.en: A drying mat, a mill and a tin with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Duaina phaici, denna leh khuhna nghet nei tin. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Milled in favang when the ginger comes off the jhum.
season.l: Lo aṭanga sawhthing a chhuah favang lai-ah deng a ni.

recipes.name: Garam Masala
recipes.sub: The warm powder for the north Indian dishes on the same menu
recipes.sub_l: Menu khata chhuak Bharat hmar lam chaw atana vut lum

method.en: Roast each spice on its own and not together. A clove is done in forty seconds and a coriander seed takes three minutes; roasted together, half the tin is burnt.
method.l: Hmangte tin chu a hrangin kang la, khawmin kang suh. Laung chu second sawmliah a tling a, dhania chi chuan minute thum a ngai; khawmin kang chuan tin a chanve chu a kang.

method.en: Let every spice go completely cold before it is ground. Warm spice in a mill turns to an oily cake and no sieve takes it apart.
method.l: A deng hmain hmangte tin chu a vawt famkim tur a ni. Denna chhunga hmangte lum chu hriak bal a lo ni a, silna engmahin a tihran thei lo.

method.en: Two kilos and no more at a time. Ground garam masala is at its best for six weeks and a bigger tin smells of dust by the third month.
method.l: Vawi khatah kilo hnih chauh, chu aia tam lo. Garam masala deng chu chawlhkar ruk a tha ber a, tin lian zawk chuan thla thumnaah sepaipui angin a rim.

method.en: Add it at the end of the cooking and not the start. A garam masala boiled twenty minutes has given up everything it had.
method.l: Chhum tirah ni lovin a tawpah thlak rawh. Minute sawmhnih chhung chhum garam masala chuan a neih zawng zawng chu a pe zo tawh.

recipes.why: Fourteen hundred rupees a kilo and it lasts six weeks. Half the menu of an Aizawl temple is now north Indian and there is no honest way round keeping this tin.
recipes.why_l: Kilo khatah tangka sang khat leh za li, tin chawlhkar ruk a awm thei. Aizawl biak in menu a chanve chu tunah Bharat hmar lam a ni a, he tin vawn lo tur kawng dik a awm lo.

start.en: Roast, cool completely, grind and sieve. Two hours for two kilos.
start.l: Kang la, vawt famkim ang che, deng la, sil rawh. Kilo hnih atan darkar hnih.

vessel.en: A dry pan, a cooling tray, a mill and a tin with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel ro, vawtna tray, denna leh khuhna nghet nei tin. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Ground every six weeks, all year.
season.l: Chawlhkar ruk danin deng a ni, kum tin.

recipes.name: Dhania Vut
recipes.sub: Coriander seed roasted and milled alone, a tin every fortnight
recipes.sub_l: Dhania chi chu amah hrangin kang a deng, chawlhkar hnih danin tin khat

method.en: Roast it on the lowest flame you can hold. Coriander burns from the inside and a seed that looks right can already be bitter.
method.l: I vawn theih mei tlem ber chungah kang rawh. Dhania chu a chhung aṭangin a kang a, a lang tha chi pawh chu a khah tawh thei.

method.en: Ground alone and not in a garam masala. Three quarters of the coriander a temple kitchen uses goes into dishes that want no clove in them.
method.l: Garam masala-ah ni lovin amah hrangin deng rawh. Biak in chawthlengin dhania a hman a li chhinga thum chu laung duh lo chaw-ah a kal.

method.en: Mill it medium and sieve it once. The husk that comes off in the sieve is what floats on a bai and looks like dust on the surface.
method.l: Tlangpuiin deng la, vawi khat sil rawh. Silna-a a chhuak chhun chu bai chunga a leng a, a chungah sepaipui angin a lang.

method.en: Three kilos at a time and no more. A dhania vut is at its best for a fortnight and after a month it is a filler.
method.l: Vawi khatah kilo thum chauh, chu aia tam lo. Dhania vut chu chawlhkar hnih a tha ber a, thla khat hnuah chuan tikhat nan chauh a ni.

recipes.why: Two hundred rupees a kilo. Coriander is the one spice a Mizo kitchen uses by the kilo rather than the gram, and milling it in the house is half the price of the packet.
recipes.why_l: Kilo khatah tangka za hnih. Dhania chu Mizo chawthlengin gram-in ni lovin kilo-in a hman hmangte pakhat a ni a, in-ah deng chu packet man a chanve a ni.

start.en: Roast, cool and mill in one hour. Made every fortnight.
start.l: Darkar khatah kang, vawt leh deng. Chawlhkar hnih danin siam a ni.

vessel.en: A dry pan, a mill, a sieve and a tin. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel ro, denna, silna leh tin. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, every fortnight.
season.l: Kum tin, chawlhkar hnih danin.

recipes.name: Buh Chhang Vut
recipes.sub: Rice roasted and milled coarse, the thickener for every bai
recipes.sub_l: Buh chu kang a, sang zawkin deng — bai tin tisangna

method.en: Roast it until it just takes colour, no further. Rice roasted brown thickens as well but every bai it goes into tastes of toast.
method.l: A rawng a chhuah vak vak thlengin kang la, chu aia rei lo. Buh dum thlengin kang chuan a tisang bawk mahse a luh bai tin chu chhang kang angin a tui.

method.en: Mill it coarse. A fine flour goes to lumps the second it touches a hot bai and the lumps do not break up again.
method.l: Sang zawkin deng rawh. Chhang sang chuan bai lum a tawh veleh bal a lo ni a, chu bal chu a kek leh ngai lo.

method.en: Mix it to a slurry in cold water before it goes into the vessel. Thrown in dry, five kilos of it becomes five hundred lumps.
method.l: Bel chhunga a luh hmain tui vawt-ah chhawm la. Ro-in thlak chuan kilo nga chu bal za nga a lo ni.

method.en: Keep it dry and use it in a month. Roasted rice flour picks up the damp of an Aizawl fur and goes musty in the tin.
method.l: Ro-in dah la, thla khat chhungin hmang rawh. Buh chhang kang chuan Aizawl fur hnawngna chu a chhawp a, tin-ah a rim chhia.

recipes.why: Fifty-seven rupees a kilo, the cheapest thing on this shelf, and it is what lets a Mizo kitchen thicken thirty litres of bai with no besan and no cream.
recipes.why_l: Kilo khatah tangka sawmnga leh sarih, he thlaite-a man tlawm ber; tin chu chuan besan leh cream tel lovin Mizo chawthleng chu bai litre 30 tisang theihin a siam.

start.en: Roast and mill in one hour. Made every month.
start.l: Darkar khatah kang a deng. Thla tin siam a ni.

vessel.en: A dry pan, a mill and a tin with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel ro, denna leh khuhna nghet nei tin. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and milled fresh every month.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thla tin thar a deng a ni.

recipes.name: Antam Ur Vut
recipes.sub: Mustard leaf dried and milled, the winter green in a tin
recipes.sub_l: Antam hnah ro-in dah a deng — tin chhunga thlasik thlai hring

method.en: Twenty kilos of fresh leaf gives two kilos of powder. A kitchen that does not know that dries twenty and expects six.
method.l: Hnah thar kilo sawmhnih chuan vut kilo hnih a pe. Chu hre lo chawthleng chuan sawmhnih a ro-in dah a, ruk a beisei.

method.en: Dry it in the shade and not in the sun. Direct sun takes the green out and a grey antam vut is a colouring and nothing more.
method.l: Ni-ah ni lovin hlim-ah ro-in dah rawh. Ni thlangin a hringna chu a la bo a, antam vut vardum chu tirawngna chauh a ni.

method.en: Strip the stalk out before it dries. A dried stalk will not mill and what comes out of the machine is a fibre that sits on the tongue.
method.l: A ro hmain a kung chu la chhuak rawh. Kung ro chu deng theih a ni lo va, machine aṭanga a chhuak chu leiah a awm hnim a ni.

method.en: Use it in a bai and never in a chartawk. Two tablespoons in thirty litres is a green vessel in thlasik; a spoon of it raw is a dust.
method.l: Bai-ah hmang la, chartawk-ah hmang ngai lo. Litre 30-ah chawpna lian hnih chuan thlasik lai-ah bel hring a siam; a thing lai chawpna khat chu sepaipui a ni.

recipes.why: Two hundred and forty rupees a kilo and it keeps four months. In thal the antam is fifteen rupees a kilo and twenty kilos dried in thal is a green bai in the middle of thlasik.
recipes.why_l: Kilo khatah tangka za hnih leh sawmli, tin thla li a awm thei. Thal lai-ah antam chu kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, thal lai-a kilo sawmhnih ro-in dah chuan thlasik lai takah bai hring a ni.

start.en: Three days in the shade, then milled. Made once in thal.
start.l: Ni thum hlim-ah, chumi hnuah deng. Thal lai-ah vawi khat siam.

vessel.en: Drying racks in the shade, a mill and a tin with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Hlim-a duaina rack te, denna leh khuhna nghet nei tin. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Made in thal, used through thlasik.
season.l: Thal lai-ah siam, thlasik chhung hman a ni.

recipes.name: Buhfai
recipes.sub: Plain boiled hill rice
recipes.sub_l: Buh thlawp mai

method.en: Mizoram eats a short, slightly sticky rice, not a basmati. Do not buy basmati for this book — it is wrong on the plate and costs three times as much.
method.l: Mizoram-ah buh tawi, nal deuh an ei a, basmati an ei lo. Basmati lei suh.

method.en: Rinse until the water runs clear and soak twenty minutes.
method.l: A tui a fai hlen thlengin sil la, minute 20 dah rawh.

method.en: Boil in an open vessel with plenty of water and drain the excess off. This is the drained method and it is what these hills use.
method.l: Bel hawng-ah tui tam takin thlawp la, a tui thal chu chhuah rawh.

method.en: Keep the rice water. It is drunk warm with salt, given to anyone unwell, and thrown away only by a wasteful kitchen.
method.l: Buh tui chu dah rawh. Chi nen a lum lain in a ni a, mi dam lo hnenah pek a ni.

method.en: Cover and rest ten minutes after draining, and do not fork it through.
method.l: Tui chhuah hnuah khuh la, minute 10 dah rawh, kaihkawh suh.

method.en: The grains are meant to sit together. A bai is poured over them and a separate grain will not hold the broth.
method.l: A tang chu inbeng tur a ni. Bai chu a chungah leih a ni.

recipes.why: The base of every meal in this book. Buying the right rice matters more than anything done to it afterwards.
recipes.why_l: Chaw tin bul a ni. Buh dik lei chu a hnuaia tih zawng zawng aiin a pawimawh.

start.en: Rinse and soak twenty minutes. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Sil la, minute 20 dah rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy 45 L vessel and a large strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel rit 45 L leh chherna lian. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year, at every meal.
season.l: Kum tin, chaw tinah.

recipes.name: Bamboo Rice
recipes.sub: Rice cooked inside green bamboo
recipes.sub_l: Rua hring chhunga buh chhum

method.en: Use only fresh green bamboo, cut the same day. Dry bamboo catches fire and burns through before the rice is cooked.
method.l: Rua hring, chumi ni-a tan chauh hmang rawh. Rua ro chu a kang thruk.

method.en: Cut each length so that one node closes the bottom, leaving a sealed tube.
method.l: A hnung lam chu a zik-ah khar la, bawm ang siam rawh.

method.en: Fill each tube no more than two-thirds and add water to just cover the rice. Sticky rice swells hard and a full tube splits along its length.
method.l: A pathum zela hnih aia tam thun suh. Buh nal chu a puak thruk a, a khat lutuk chuan a keh ang.

method.en: Plug the open end with a rolled banana leaf, pressed in firmly.
method.l: A kawr lam chu balhla hnah zial hmangin nghet takin khar rawh.

method.en: Lean the tubes against the fire at an angle rather than laying them in it, and turn each one every ten minutes so they char evenly.
method.l: Mei-ah dah lovin a kaah nghat la, minute 10 zelin letling rawh.

method.en: They are done in about an hour, when the outside is charred black all round. Split the tube at the table — the inner skin of the bamboo comes away with the rice and is eaten with it.
method.l: Darkar khat vel-ah a min ta. Dawhkan chungah phel la — rua hnah chhung chu buh nen a lo chhuak a, ei tel a ni.

recipes.why: The vessel is the fuel and the flavour and it is thrown on the fire afterwards. Nothing to wash.
recipes.why_l: Bel chu thing a ni bawk a, a hnuah mei-ah paih a ni. Sil tur a awm lo.

start.en: Cut fresh green bamboo the same morning. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: Rua hring chu chumi zingah tan rawh.

vessel.en: Forty lengths of green bamboo and an open wood fire. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Rua hring 40 leh thing mei. Chaw suk 3.

season.en: Feast days, and only where green bamboo can be cut fresh.
season.l: Kut ni-ah, rua hring tan theih hmunah chauh.

recipes.name: Sticky Rice
recipes.sub: Glutinous rice, steamed
recipes.sub_l: Buh nal chhum

method.en: Sticky rice is never boiled. It is soaked and then steamed, and boiling it gives a solid paste that cannot be served.
method.l: Buh nal hi thlawp ngai lo. Dah la, chhum a ni. Thlawp chuan a nal vek ang.

method.en: Soak at least six hours. The steamer cannot soften this grain the way boiling water would, so all the softening happens in the soak.
method.l: Darkar 6 dah rawh. Chhum na hian a tinawi thei lo va, a dahna-ah a nawi a ni.

method.en: Drain it thoroughly and line the steamer with a wet cloth rather than putting the rice on the tray.
method.l: Tui chhuah fel la, tray chungah dah lovin puan hnawih phah rawh.

method.en: Steam forty minutes without opening the lid. Every look lets the steam out and the batch cooks unevenly.
method.l: Khuhna hawng lovin minute 40 chhum rawh.

method.en: Turn the whole mass over once at the halfway point and steam on. The top layer cooks slower than the bottom.
method.l: A chanve-ah vawi khat letling la, chhum zel rawh.

method.en: Serve it warm, in the hand. Sticky rice is eaten by pinching a ball off and dipping it, so no spoon is needed.
method.l: A lum lain kutah sem rawh. Buh nal chu kutin nep a, chawh a ni.

recipes.why: Never boiled, always steamed. That one rule is the difference between rice and glue.
recipes.why_l: Thlawp ngai lo, chhum ngai. Chu dan chuan buh leh nal a then.

start.en: Soak the sticky rice six hours. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: Buh nal chu darkar 6 dah rawh.

vessel.en: Three large steamers lined with cloth. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chhum na lian 3, puan phah nen. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: All year. The rice of a feast day.
season.l: Kum tin. Kut ni buh a ni.

recipes.name: Buh Sen
recipes.sub: Red jhum rice cooked plain and drained, nothing added
recipes.sub_l: Lo lam buh sen chu ngaihngaiin chhum a, tui sen chhuah, thil dang tel lo

method.en: Wash it twice and no more. A red rice washed four times is a white rice and the bran is where the whole taste of a jhum buh is.
method.l: Vawi hnih chauh sil la, chu aia tam lo. Vawi li sil buh sen chu buh var a lo ni a, lo lam buh tui pumpui chu a chhun-ah a awm.

method.en: Twice the water of a plain white rice and eight minutes longer. Red rice takes a bran off before the grain will soften.
method.l: Buh var ngaihngai tui aiin a let hnih, tin minute riat rei zawk. Buh sen chuan a chi a nem hmain a chhun chu a paih hmasa.

method.en: Drain it and do not let it absorb. A buh sen that has drunk its water is a porridge and thirty kilos of it cannot be served on a leaf.
method.l: Tui sen chhuak la, a in vek suh. A tui in zo buh sen chu bawl a lo ni a, kilo 30 chu hnah chungah sem theih a ni lo.

method.en: Keep the drained water for a bai. Ten kilos of red rice gives eight litres of dark water and it is a vessel of its own.
method.l: Tui sen chhuah chu bai atan dah rawh. Buh sen kilo sawm chuan tui dum litre riat a pe a, chu chu amah bel a lo ni.

recipes.why: Seven rupees fifty a head. A Lawngtlai jhum buh sen is fifty rupees a kilo against forty for a plains rice, and a temple that buys it keeps a jhum sown.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sarih leh sawmnga. Lawngtlai lo lam buh sen chu kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, phaizawl buh chu sawmli; tin, chu lei biak in chuan lo chu a thlawh reng.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty-five minutes and eight minutes standing.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmthum leh nga, tin minute riat awm reh.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel and a draining basket. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 40 bel leh tui senna bawm. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, after the jhum harvest.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, lo buh seng hnuah.

recipes.name: Buh Chhawhchhi
recipes.sub: Plain rice turned through with roasted sesame and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Buh ngaihngai chu chhawhchhi kang leh hmarcha nen a chhawm

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi until the seeds jump and crush it coarse. A powdered nei disappears into thirty kilos and nothing is tasted.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu a chi a chhuah thlengin kang la, sang zawkin dengin. Chhawhchhi vut chuan kilo 30 zingah a bo a, engmah tui a awm lo.

method.en: Cook the rice drier than usual and let it cool ten minutes before it is turned. Warm rice breaks under a ladle and thirty kilos is a paste.
method.l: Buh chu a dan aiin ro zawkin chhum la, a chhawm hmain minute sawm vawtin dah rawh. Buh lum chu chawpna hnuaiah a kek a, kilo 30 chu bal a lo ni.

method.en: Turn it with two ladles and lift, do not stir. A rice stirred in a round breaks and the whole vessel goes to a single mass.
method.l: Chawpna pahnih hmangin chhawm la, chawi kang rawh; kualin chhawm suh. Kualin chhawm buh chu a kek a, bel pumpui chu bal khat a lo ni.

method.en: Raw mustard oil turned through at the counter. Heated oil coats the grain and the sesame slides off it onto the plate.
method.l: Sem hnaih velah antam hriak thing chhawm luh rawh. Hriak lum chuan buh chu a hnawih a, chhawhchhi chu a chungah a hlir thla a, thlengbelah a awm.

recipes.why: Nine rupees twenty a head. Chhawhchhi grows on a Mizo jhum and a kilo of it gives thirty kilos of rice the fat it needs without a rupee of ghee.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka kua leh sawmhnih. Chhawhchhi chu Mizo lo-ah a chuang a, kilo khat chuan ghee tangka khat pawh tel lovin buh kilo 30 hriak a mamawh chu a pe.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the rice cools ten of them.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, chung zinga minute sawm chu buh vawtna a ni.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel, a dry pan and two long ladles. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Litre 40 bel, bel ro leh chawpna sei pahnih. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: All year, and after the favang harvest above all.
season.l: Kum tin, tin favang buh seng hnuah a bik takin.

recipes.name: Buh Hnute
recipes.sub: Rice cooled and folded through with salted curd
recipes.sub_l: Buh chu vawtah dah a, mluh nei hnute-ah a chhawm

method.en: The rice has to be completely cold. Warm rice in curd splits six kilos of it before the vessel reaches the hall.
method.l: Buh chu a vawt famkim tur a ni. Hnute chhunga buh lum chuan bel chu in a thleng hmain kilo ruk chu a tiinṭhen.

method.en: Cook the rice softer than usual and break the grain a little. A separate grain will not hold curd and the vessel goes watery at the bottom.
method.l: Buh chu a dan aiin nem zawkin chhum la, a chi chu tlemte kek rawh. Chi inṭhen chuan hnute a vawn thei lo va, bel chu a hnuaiah a tui thla.

method.en: Fold it in an hour before the bell and no earlier. Curd in rice for three hours is a sour rice and nobody asked for one.
method.l: Dar a ri hmain darkar khat chauhvin chhawm luh rawh. Buh chhunga darkar thum awm hnute chuan buh thur a siam a, tuman a dil lo.

method.en: Keep a litre of curd back and stir it in at the counter. Rice drinks curd for an hour and the vessel that was right in the kitchen is dry in the hall.
method.l: Hnute litre khat vawng la, sem hnaih velah chhawm luh rawh. Buh chuan darkar khat hnute a in a, chawthlengah a dik bel chu in chhungah a ro.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees fifty a head and no fire under it at the counter. On a thal day when the hall is at thirty-two degrees it is the only rice a devotee finishes.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpathum leh sawmnga, tin sem hnaih velah a hnuaiah mei a awm lo. In chu degree sawmthum leh hnih a nih thal ni-ah chuan mi-in a zo buh chauh chu hei a ni.

start.en: Rice is cooked two hours ahead and cooled. Curd folded in an hour before the bell.
start.l: Buh chu darkar hnih hmaah chhum a, a vawt tur a ni. Dar a ri hmain darkar khatah hnute chhawm luh a ni.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel, a cooling tray and a tempering pan. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Litre 40 bel, vawtna tray leh tihremna bel. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Thal to fur, and on any day above thirty degrees.
season.l: Thal aṭanga fur thleng, tin degree sawmthum chunga ni apiangah.

recipes.name: Buh Mai
recipes.sub: Rice cooked with diced pumpkin so the grains take its colour
recipes.sub_l: Buh chu mai at nen a chhum, a chi-in a rawng a lak theih nan

method.en: Dice the mai large, an inch to the side. A small dice dissolves and thirty kilos of rice is orange with nothing in it.
method.l: Mai chu lian zawkin at la, a kam inch khat. At tlemte chuan a duai a, buh kilo 30 chu a sen a, a chhungah engmah a awm lo.

method.en: Put the mai in when the rice is half done. From the start it is gone; at the end it is raw in the middle.
method.l: Buh a chanve a chhum hunah mai chu thlak rawh. Tir aṭanga a luh chuan a bo a; a tawpa a luh chuan a laiah a thing.

method.en: Cook the rice drier than usual. A mai gives up water for twenty minutes after the fire is out and a wet vessel is a buh-bal.
method.l: Buh chu a dan aiin ro zawkin chhum rawh. Mei a mit hnuah mai chuan minute sawmhnih tui a pe a, bel hnawng chu buh-bal a lo ni.

method.en: No sugar of any kind. A favang mai is sweet enough to be mistaken for a sweet rice already.
method.l: Sugar chi hrang hrang a awm lo. Favang mai chu buh thlum niin ngaih theih khawpin a thlum tawh.

recipes.why: Eight rupees sixty a head, the cheapest rice in this book. In favang a Mamit jhum gives more mai than the kitchen can use and four kilos colours thirty.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka riat leh sawmruk, he lehkhabu-a buh man tlawm ber. Favang lai-ah Mamit lo chuan chawthleng hman zawng aiin mai a tam zawk a pe a, kilo li chuan kilo 30 a tirawng.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the mai is diced while the rice comes to the boil.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, tin buh a chhum lai mai chu at a ni.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 40 bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, lo aṭangin, chumi hnuah thil dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Pulao
recipes.sub: Rice cooked in ghee with whole spice and the winter vegetables
recipes.sub_l: Buh chu ghee-ah hmangte pum leh thlasik thlai nen a chhum

method.en: Soak the basmati twenty minutes and no longer. An hour's soak gives a grain that breaks in the vessel and a pulao of broken rice is a buh-bal with a garnish.
method.l: Basmati chu minute sawmhnih dah la, chu aia rei lo. Darkar khat dah chuan bel chhungah a kek chi a pe a, buh kek pulao chu chawhnawmna nei buh-bal a ni.

method.en: Fry the whole spice in the ghee until it is smelt across the kitchen, then the rice. Spice added after the rice sits on top and gives nothing.
method.l: Chawthleng pumah a rim a thleng thlengin hmangte pum chu ghee-ah chhum la, chumi hnuah buh. Buh hnua thlak hmangte chuan a chungah a awm a, engmah a pe lo.

method.en: One and a half measures of water to one of soaked rice. Two measures is the plain-rice ratio and it gives a pulao that sticks in the ladle.
method.l: Buh dah pakhat-ah tui teh nihna khat leh chanve. Nihna hnih chu buh ngaihngai teh nihna a ni a, chawpna-a bet pulao a siam.

method.en: Off the fire, lid on, twelve minutes, and nobody opens it. Every look costs the vessel two minutes of steam and thirty kilos cannot be recooked.
method.l: Mei aṭangin la chhuak, khuh la, minute sawmhnih, tin tuman hawng suh. Enna tinin bel chu minute hnih chhung mei-tui a chân a, kilo 30 chu chhum leh theih a ni lo.

recipes.why: Thirty-four rupees ninety a head, most of it the ghee and the basmati. This is the Chapchar Kut rice and the wedding rice, and on any other day the hall gets a buh sen.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmthum leh pali leh sawmkua, a tam zawk chu ghee leh basmati a ni. Hei hi Chapchar Kut buh leh inneihna buh a ni a, ni dang apiangah in chhungin buh sen an dawng.

start.en: Rice soaks twenty minutes. Fifty minutes in all, and twelve of them under the lid.
start.l: Buh chu minute sawmhnih a awm. A zawng zawngin minute sawmnga, chung zinga minute sawmhnih chu khuh a.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel with a close lid. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Khuhna nghet nei litre 40 bel rit. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Favang to thlasik for the vegetables; at Chapchar Kut with peas alone.
season.l: Thlai atan favang aṭanga thlasik thleng; Chapchar Kut-ah matar chauh nen.

recipes.name: Rice Flour Roti
recipes.sub: Flatbread from rice flour
recipes.sub_l: Buh chhang chapati

method.en: There is no wheat tradition in these hills, so the breads in this book are few. That is honest rather than a gap.
method.l: He tlangah gehu hman dan a awm lo, chuvangin chapati a tlem. Hei hi a dik a ni.

method.en: Pour boiling water onto the rice flour, not the flour into the water, and stir hard with a wooden spoon.
method.l: Tui tibuk chu buh chhang chungah leih rawh, chhang chu tui-ah theh suh.

method.en: Boiling water, not warm. Rice flour has no gluten and it is the heat that binds the starch — that is the only thing holding the roti together.
method.l: Tui lum ni lovin tui tibuk. Buh chhang-ah gluten a awm lo.

method.en: Knead as soon as it can be handled, while still genuinely hot. A cooled dough will not come together and cannot be rescued.
method.l: Kut hmanga hman theih veleh, a lum lain sut rawh.

method.en: Pat between two greased sheets rather than rolling on a floured board, and keep the dough covered — it dries within minutes.
method.l: Phek hriak hnih kar-ah nemnghet la, a chhang chu khuh reng rawh.

method.en: Cook on a medium tawa and expect a shorter shelf than a wheat roti. These go hard within twenty minutes.
method.l: Tawa lai lai-ah chhum rawh. Minute 20-ah a khauh ta ang.

recipes.why: Boiling water and hot hands. Mizoram eats rice, and this is what happens when rice has to become a bread.
recipes.why_l: Tui tibuk leh kut lum. Mizoram-ah buh an ei a, buh chapati a nihna dan chu hei a ni.

start.en: The dough must be made with boiling water and used hot.
start.l: A chhang chu tui tibuk hmangin siam tur a ni.

vessel.en: Four heavy tawas. Four cooks.
vessel.l: Tawa rit 4. Chaw suk 4.

season.en: All year. Mizoram is rice country and this section is thin for that reason.
season.l: Kum tin. Mizoram hi buh ram a ni a, chuvangin he bung hi a tlem.

recipes.name: Millet Roti
recipes.sub: Foxtail millet flatbread
recipes.sub_l: Sabu chhang chapati

method.en: Mix the millet flour with a fifth part rice flour. Pure millet has nothing to bind it and the roti falls apart as it is lifted.
method.l: Sabu chhang-ah buh chhang panga zela khat dah rawh. Sabu chauh chuan a phum khawm lo.

method.en: Knead with hot water. Cold water gives a dough that crumbles under the hand.
method.l: Tui lum hmangin sut rawh. Tui dai chuan a chhe ang.

method.en: Knead only as much as can be used in ten minutes. Millet dough dries and cracks faster than anything else in these books.
method.l: Minute 10 chhunga hman theih chauh sut rawh. Sabu chhang chu a kang thruk a, a keh thruk.

method.en: Pat between wet palms rather than rolling, turning the roti as you go, and keep the palms wet — dry hands crack the edge.
method.l: Chhat lovin kutphah hnawih kar-ah nemnghet la, kut chu hnawih reng rawh.

method.en: Keep it thicker than a wheat roti. A thin millet roti tears when it is lifted and cannot be saved.
method.l: Gehu chapati aiin sa deuhin dah rawh.

method.en: Cook on a hot tawa on both sides until brown spots appear and serve at once.
method.l: Tawa lum-ah a lam hnihin a dum thleng chhum la, nghal takin sem rawh.

recipes.why: Made from grain that grows where rice will not. Hot water and wet hands are the two requirements.
recipes.why_l: Buh chin theih loh hmuna buh chin atanga siam. Tui lum leh kut hnawih a ngai.

start.en: Nothing rests. Knead in small lots as you go.
start.l: Dah a ngai lo. Tlem te zelin sut rawh.

vessel.en: Five heavy tawas. Five cooks.
vessel.l: Tawa rit 5. Chaw suk 5.

season.en: November to March, after the millet harvest.
season.l: November atanga March thleng, sabu seng hnuah.

recipes.name: Phulka
recipes.sub: Plain puffed wheat roti
recipes.sub_l: Gehu chapati

method.en: Knead soft — softer than feels right. A stiff dough gives a phulka that will not puff no matter how hot the flame.
method.l: Nem takin sut rawh. A nghet lutuk chuan a puak lo vang.

method.en: Rest thirty minutes under a damp cloth so the flour takes up the water fully.
method.l: Puan hnawih hnuaiah minute 30 dah rawh.

method.en: Knead again briefly after the rest, then divide into equal balls.
method.l: A hnuah sut leh la, a inanin then rawh.

method.en: Roll evenly. A phulka thicker in the middle than at the edge will puff only at the rim.
method.l: A inan takin chhat rawh. A laia sa lutuk chuan a kam chauh a puak ang.

method.en: Cook the first side lightly, the second until spots appear, then move it onto the open flame where it should balloon in seconds.
method.l: A lam khatna chu tlem te, a hnihna chu a dum thleng chhum la, mei chungah dah rawh.

method.en: Stack in a cloth-lined basket with a smear of oil. Bare stacking steams them soft and leathery.
method.l: Bawm puan phah chungah hriak nen dah rawh.

recipes.why: Soft dough, even rolling, open flame. Nothing else, and every kitchen still gets one of the three wrong.
recipes.why_l: Chhang nem, chhat inan, mei hawng. Chu chauh.

start.en: Rest the dough thirty minutes. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: A chhang chu minute 30 dah rawh.

vessel.en: Six tawas and an open flame. Six cooks.
vessel.l: Tawa 6 leh mei. Chaw suk 6.

season.en: All year. Wheat is brought in rather than grown here.
season.l: Kum tin. Gehu hi pawn atanga lo kal a ni.

recipes.name: Puri
recipes.sub: Wheat rolled small and fried to order in a deep kadai
recipes.sub_l: Gohum chhang chu tê zawkin lan a, dil ang bawkin kadai thuk-ah a chhum

method.en: The dough is stiff, stiffer than a chapati dough. A soft dough drinks oil and five hundred puri come out heavy.
method.l: Chhang chu a khauh a, chapati chhang aiin a khauh zawk. Chhang nem chuan hriak a in a, puri za nga chu a rit thla.

method.en: A handful of sooji in the flour. It is what keeps a puri crisp for the twenty minutes between the kadai and the plate.
method.l: Chhang chhungah sooji kut khat. Chu chuan kadai leh thlengbel kara minute sawmhnih chhung puri chu a tikrai reng.

method.en: Rest the dough half an hour and no longer. A dough left an hour goes slack and the puri will not puff.
method.l: Chhang chu darkar chanve dah la, chu aia rei lo. Darkar khat dah chhang chu a duai a, puri chu a puak lo.

method.en: Fry in lots of twenty and press each one down once with the ladle. That one press is what makes it rise and a puri pressed twice is flat.
method.l: Sawmhnih vawi khatin chhum la, chawpna hmangin pakhat tin chu vawi khat nam rawh. Chu vawi khat namna chuan a puak a, vawi hnih nam puri chu a phen.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees fifty a head. Wheat is not a Mizoram crop and every kilo comes up the road, so this is the roti for a Chapchar Kut and a buhfai carries an ordinary day.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh ruk leh sawmnga. Gohum chu Mizoram thlai a ni lo va, kilo tin chu kawng zawh chhuah a ni; chuvangin hei hi Chapchar Kut roti a ni a, ni ngaihngai chu buhfai-in a phur.

start.en: The dough rests half an hour. Two hours in all for five hundred.
start.l: Chhang chu darkar chanve a awm. Za nga atan a zawng zawngin darkar hnih.

vessel.en: A deep kadai and two rolling boards. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Kadai thuk leh lanna dawhkan pahnih. Chawmi pathum.

season.en: All year, at Chapchar Kut and Janmashtami above all.
season.l: Kum tin, tin Chapchar Kut leh Janmashtami-ah a bik takin.

recipes.name: Paratha
recipes.sub: Wheat folded in layers with ghee and turned on a griddle
recipes.sub_l: Gohum chhang chu ghee nen phen phenin fawlh a, tawa chungah a chhum

method.en: The dough is soft here, softer than for a puri. A stiff dough will not take layers and the paratha comes off the tawa as a board.
method.l: Hetah chhang chu a nem a, puri atan aiin a nem zawk. Chhang khauh chuan phen a pdiang thei lo va, paratha chu tawa aṭangin thlingleng angin a chhuak.

method.en: Ghee between the folds and not in the dough. Ghee kneaded in gives a rich flat bread; ghee folded in gives the layers.
method.l: Ghee chu chhang chhungah ni lovin fawlh kara. Chhang chhunga chher ghee chuan chhang nuam phen a siam; fawlh kara ghee chuan phen a pe.

method.en: Three folds and no more. Every fold past three is a layer nobody can taste and a minute more on a tawa for three hundred.
method.l: Fawlhna thum chauh, chu aia tam lo. Thum aia fawlh apiang chu tuman tem hriat theih loh phen a ni a, za thum atan tawa chungah minute khat a be belh.

method.en: Stack them in a cloth-lined basket and never on a plate. A paratha on a metal plate sweats and the bottom of the stack is wet in ten minutes.
method.l: Puan-a khuh bawm-ah pawn khawm la, thlengbel chungah dah ngai lo. Thir thlengbel chunga paratha chu a thlan a, a hnuai lam chu minute sawmah a hnawng.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees ninety a head, and the ghee is most of it. This is the morning bread of a festival day; on any other morning the hall gets chhangban and thingpui.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmhnih leh pahnih leh sawmkua, tin a tam zawk chu ghee a ni. Hei hi kut ni zinga chaw a ni; zing dang apiangah in chhungin chhangban leh thingpui an dawng.

start.en: The dough rests forty minutes. Two and a half hours in all for three hundred.
start.l: Chhang chu minute sawmli a awm. Za thum atan a zawng zawngin darkar hnih leh chanve.

vessel.en: Two large tawa and two rolling boards. Four cooks.
vessel.l: Tawa lian pahnih leh lanna dawhkan pahnih. Chawmi pali.

season.en: All year, on festival mornings.
season.l: Kum tin, kut ni zingah.

recipes.name: Alu Paratha
recipes.sub: Wheat stuffed with mashed potato and chilli, rolled thick
recipes.sub_l: Gohum chhang chu alu deng leh hmarcha-in a khat, sang zawkin a lan

method.en: The filling must be completely dry and completely cold. A warm filling steams inside the paratha and tears it on the tawa.
method.l: A khatna chu ro famkim leh vawt famkim tur a ni. Khatna lum chuan paratha chhungah mei-tui a siam a, tawa chungah a tikek.

method.en: Boil the alu in the skin and mash it warm, then let it cool. A potato peeled before boiling drinks water and the filling is wet whatever is done to it.
method.l: Alu chu a hnawng nen chhum la, a lum lai dengin, chumi hnuah vawt ang che. Chhum hmaa hlip alu chuan tui a in a, eng ang pawh tih se a khatna chu a hnawng.

method.en: Equal weights of dough and filling in each one. More filling than that and the paratha will not close; less and it is a plain paratha with a rumour in it.
method.l: Pakhat tinah chhang leh khatna rit intluk. Chu aia khatna tam chuan paratha chu a khar thei lo; a tlem chuan a chhunga thusawi nei paratha ngaihngai a ni.

method.en: Roll from the centre out and turn the disc a quarter each time. Rolled in one direction the filling gathers at one edge and that edge splits.
method.l: A lai aṭangin a pawn lam pan lan la, vawi tinah a bul chu li chhinga pakhatin hawi rawh. Lam khat chauhvah lan chuan khatna chu kam khatah a khawm a, chu kam chu a kek.

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees ninety a head and it is a meal on its own. On the morning of a long walk a devotee needs no bai beside this and the kitchen saves a vessel.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmhnih leh pali leh sawmkua, tin amah ngeiin chaw a ni. Kal rei tur zing lai chuan mi chuan hei bulah bai a mamawh lo va, chawthlengin bel khat a chân lo.

start.en: Potatoes boil and cool the night before. Three hours on the day for three hundred.
start.l: Alu chu a ni hmaa zanah chhum a, a vawt tur a ni. Za thum atan a ni ah darkar thum.

vessel.en: Two large tawa, a mashing tray and two rolling boards. Four cooks.
vessel.l: Tawa lian pahnih, dengna tray leh lanna dawhkan pahnih. Chawmi pali.

season.en: All year, and on any morning the hall is walking out.
season.l: Kum tin, tin in chhungin an kal chhuah zing apiangah.

recipes.name: Missi Roti
recipes.sub: Wheat and gram flour together on a dry griddle, no oil in it
recipes.sub_l: Gohum leh besan chu tawa ro chungah khawmin, hriak tel lo

method.en: Two parts wheat to one of besan and no more besan than that. Half and half gives a roti that cracks on the tawa and cannot be turned.
method.l: Besan pakhat-ah gohum pahnih, tin chu aia besan tam lo. Chanve chanve chuan tawa chungah a kek roti a pe a, letling theih a ni lo.

method.en: Knead with warm water. Besan does not take cold water and a cold-kneaded dough is still crumbling twenty minutes later.
method.l: Tui lum hmangin chher rawh. Besan chuan tui vawt a pdiang lo va, tui vawta chher chhang chu minute sawmhnih hnu pawhin a chhe reng.

method.en: Rest it a full hour. Besan needs the time to take up the water and a dough rolled early tears in the middle of every roti.
method.l: Darkar khat famkim awm ang che. Besan chuan tui a chhawp theih nan hun a ngai a, hma taka lan chhang chu roti tin lai lai ah a kek.

method.en: A dry tawa and no oil on it. A missi roti is fried in nothing and an oiled one goes soft in the basket before the line has passed.
method.l: Tawa ro, a chungah hriak a awm lo. Missi roti chu engmah tel lovin chhum a ni a, hriak nei chu mi zawng zawng an lo kal hmain bawm chhungah a duai.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees fifty a head, no ghee and no kadai. Besan is half the price of wheat at Bara Bazar and this is the roti a thlasik day can afford four of.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh pahnih leh sawmnga, ghee leh kadai tel lo. Bara Bazar-ah besan chu gohum man a chanve a ni a, hei hi thlasik ni-in pali a lei theih roti a ni.

start.en: The dough rests a full hour. Two hours in all for four hundred.
start.l: Chhang chu darkar khat famkim a awm. Za li atan a zawng zawngin darkar hnih.

vessel.en: Two dry tawa and two rolling boards. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Tawa ro pahnih leh lanna dawhkan pahnih. Chawmi pathum.

season.en: All year, and every second day in thlasik.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thlasik lai ni hnih danah.

recipes.name: Chhawhchhi Chapati
recipes.sub: Rice flour kneaded with roasted sesame and pressed by hand
recipes.sub_l: Buh chhang chu chhawhchhi kang nen chher a, kut hmangin a nam

method.en: Knead the buh chhang with boiling water and never cold. Rice flour in cold water will not bind and three hundred and fifty roti fall apart on the board.
method.l: Buh chhang chu tui chhum lai hmangin chher la, vawt hmang ngai lo. Tui vawta buh chhang chu a inzawm thei lo va, roti za thum leh sawmnga chu dawhkan chungah a chhe hlum.

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi and crush it before it goes in. Raw sesame in the dough tastes of nothing and eight hundred grams of it is wasted.
method.l: A luh hmain chhawhchhi chu kang la dengin. Chhang chhunga chhawhchhi thing chuan engmah tui a nei lo va, gram 800 chu a boral.

method.en: Press each one out by hand on a wet cloth and do not use a pin. A rice flour dough cracks under a rolling pin however soft it is.
method.l: Pakhat tin chu puan hnawng chungah kut hmangin nam chhuak la, lanna hmang suh. Buh chhang chhang chu a nem pawh ni se lanna hnuaiah a kek.

method.en: A dry tawa and press the roti down with a cloth. A rice flour roti puffs at one edge and stays raw at the other unless it is held down.
method.l: Tawa ro, tin puan hmangin roti chu nam rawh. Buh chhang roti chu kam khatah a puak a, nam loh chuan kam khat lamah a thing reng.

recipes.why: Ten rupees eighty a head, and there is no wheat in it at all. A Champhai kitchen has rice flour by the sack and wheat by the kilo, and this roti is why.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmriat, tin a chhungah gohum a awm hrim hrim lo. Champhai chawthleng chuan buh chhang chu ip-in a nei a, gohum chu kilo-in; he roti hi a chhan a ni.

start.en: Nothing rests. The dough is kneaded hot and shaped warm. Two hours in all.
start.l: Awm reh a ngai lo. Chhang chu a lum lai chher a, a lum lai nam a ni. A zawng zawngin darkar hnih.

vessel.en: Two dry tawa, wet cloths and a boiling kettle. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Tawa ro pahnih, puan hnawng te leh tui chhum bel. Chawmi pathum.

season.en: All year, and every second day in favang.
season.l: Kum tin, tin favang lai ni hnih danah.

recipes.name: Rawtuai Chhum
recipes.sub: Fresh bamboo shoot boiled dry
recipes.sub_l: Rawtuai chhum ro

method.en: Boil the fresh shoot twice in fresh water, twenty minutes each, discarding the water both times. Raw bamboo shoot is genuinely toxic and this is not a step to shorten.
method.l: Rawtuai chu tui thar-ah vawi hnih thlawp la, a tui paih rawh. Hei hi tihtlem theih a ni lo.

method.en: Peel down to the pale tender core and slice thin. Anything that resists the knife is too old for the pan.
method.l: A chhung nawi thleng hlip la, a pang takin at rawh.

method.en: Fry on a high flame with the lid off. A lid steams the shoot and turns a dry dish into a wet one.
method.l: Mei nasa-ah khuh lovin chhum rawh. Khuh chuan a tui ang.

method.en: Crumble the bekang in halfway through so it coats the shoot rather than sitting on top.
method.l: A chanve-ah bekang chal rawh.

method.en: Add no water at all. Bamboo shoot releases a great deal of its own and a chhum is meant to be dry.
method.l: Tui reng reng dah suh. Rawtuai chuan a tui a chhuah tam.

method.en: Salt only in the last three minutes and finish with coriander off the flame.
method.l: Chi chu a tawp minute 3-ah dah la, hnahchiar dah rawh.

recipes.why: Boil it twice or do not cook it at all. After that it is the cheapest vegetable in these hills for four months.
recipes.why_l: Vawi hnih thlawp rawh. Chumi hnuah chuan thla li chhung a man a tlawm ber.

start.en: Boil the fresh shoot twice, an hour ahead.
start.l: Rawtuai chu vawi hnih thlawp rawh.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel zau 30 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: June to September, while the fresh shoots are up.
season.l: June atanga September thleng.

recipes.name: Antam Chhum
recipes.sub: Mustard greens boiled with chhang
recipes.sub_l: Antam, chhang nen chhum

method.en: Antam is the Mizo mustard green and it is at its best after the first cold. Wash in three changes of water.
method.l: Antam chu khaw vawt hmasa hnuah a tha ber.

method.en: Strip the tough lower stems and keep them separate. The stems go in ten minutes earlier than the leaf.
method.l: A kung khauh chu hran rawh. A kung chu minute 10 hmain a lut.

method.en: Add the chhang with the stems and nothing else. This is the dish chhang exists for — it is what makes an antam stem edible rather than stringy.
method.l: Chhang chu a kung nen chauh dah rawh. Chhang awm chhan ber chu hei a ni.

method.en: Boil hard with the lid off from start to finish. A lid traps the sulphur and the greens go dull olive within minutes.
method.l: A tirah atanga a tawp thlengin khuh lovin thlawp rawh.

method.en: Crumble the bekang in for the last five minutes.
method.l: A tawp minute 5-ah bekang chal rawh.

method.en: Add the salt only in the last two minutes. Greens salted early collapse and release all their water.
method.l: Chi chu a tawp minute 2-ah chauh dah rawh.

recipes.why: Chhang and no lid. Those two are the whole technique and both are about keeping the pot green.
recipes.why_l: Chhang leh khuh loh. Pahnih hian bel a hring reng tir.

start.en: Wash three times. Start thirty minutes before serving.
start.l: Vawi thum sil rawh.

vessel.en: Two wide 30 L kadhais, uncovered. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bel zau 30 L pahnih, khuh lo. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: November to March, when the antam is in.
season.l: November atanga March thleng.

recipes.name: Iskut Chhum
recipes.sub: Chayote with its leaves and tendrils
recipes.sub_l: Iskut, a hnah leh a hrui nen

method.en: The fruit, the leaves and the young tendrils are all used. In these hills the chayote is grown as much for its shoots as for the fruit.
method.l: A rah, a hnah leh a hrui nawi zawng zawng hman a ni.

method.en: Strip the fibrous string from the tendrils. Left on, it catches between the teeth and there is no way to eat around it.
method.l: A hrui hnah chu hlip rawh. A awm chuan ha kar-ah a kai ang.

method.en: Peel the fruit and cut it thick. Chayote is watery and thin slices disappear entirely.
method.l: A rah chu hlip la, sa deuhin at rawh. Iskut chu a tui a, a pang lutuk chuan a bo vek ang.

method.en: Fry the fruit six minutes before the leaves and tendrils go in.
method.l: A rah chu minute 6 chhum hmasa la, a hnah leh a hrui chu a hnuah dah rawh.

method.en: Keep the lid off. Chayote holds a great deal of water and a lid turns the kadhai into a pot of soup.
method.l: Khuh suh. Iskut chuan tui a chhuah tam.

method.en: Salt only in the last two minutes and crumble the bekang in off the flame.
method.l: Chi chu a tawp minute 2-ah dah la, bekang chu mei atanga la chhuah hnuah chal rawh.

recipes.why: The part of the plant most kitchens throw away, and here it feeds a hundred for the price of nothing.
recipes.why_l: Mi tam takin an paih chu hian mi 100 a chawm.

start.en: String the tendrils and wash three times. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: A hrui chu hlip la, vawi thum sil rawh.

vessel.en: Two wide 30 L kadhais. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bel zau 30 L pahnih. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: All year. The vine grows over every roof in Mizoram.
season.l: Kum tin. Iskut hrui hi in chhip tinah a kai.

recipes.name: Zawngtah Chhum
recipes.sub: Tree bean boiled with bekang
recipes.sub_l: Zawngtah, bekang nen chhum

method.en: Zawngtah is the tree bean and it is the most strongly scented thing in this book. It is a legume, not an allium, and it is permitted — but a kitchen serving it for the first time should say so on the menu.
method.l: Zawngtah hi a rim a chak ber a ni. Purun chi a ni lo va, ei theih a ni.

method.en: Shell the pods and split each bean, removing the thin skin. Unskinned zawngtah is tough and far more strongly scented.
method.l: A rah chu hlip la, a hnah pang chu paih rawh. A hnah nen chuan a khauh a, a rim a chak zawk.

method.en: Blanch the shelled beans two minutes and drain. This takes some of the sharpness off without losing the character.
method.l: Minute 2 thlawp la, tui chhuah rawh. Chuan a chak lutuk chu a tlem ang.

method.en: Fry the beans with the ginger for five minutes before the potato goes in.
method.l: Alu dah hmain zawngtah chu sawhthing nen minute 5 chhum rawh.

method.en: Add the potato and cover for ten minutes. This is the one dry dish in the book that takes a lid, because the potato needs it.
method.l: Alu dah la, minute 10 khuh rawh. Alu avang chauhin khuh a ni.

method.en: Crumble the bekang in off the flame and salt at the very end.
method.l: Bekang chu mei atanga la chhuah hnuah chal la, chi chu a tawp berah dah rawh.

recipes.why: The most distinctive dish in these hills and the most divisive. Skin the beans and blanch them, and it is far less severe.
recipes.why_l: He tlanga chaw hriat hlawh ber a ni. A hnah hlip la, thlawp hmasa rawh.

start.en: Shell the zawngtah the evening before. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Zawngtah chu a tlai lamah hlip rawh.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. Two cooks — shelling is the bottleneck.
vessel.l: Bel zau 30 L. Chaw suk 2 — a hlip hi a rei ber.

season.en: March to June, when the pods are on the tree.
season.l: March atanga June thleng, a rah chhuah lai.

recipes.name: Alu Chhum
recipes.sub: Potato cut small and cooked dry until every face has caught
recipes.sub_l: Alu chu tê zawkin at a, a mai tin a kang thlengin ro-in a chhum

method.en: Cut small, a half inch to the side, and keep the pieces even. A mixed cut gives some pieces raw and some to paste in the same ladle.
method.l: Tê zawkin at la, a kam inch chanve, tin a tlangte chu intluk ang che. At intluk lo chuan chawpna khatah a tlangte engemaw a thing a, engemaw chu bal a lo ni.

method.en: No water and no lid. A lid on sixteen kilos of potato steams it and a steamed potato is a boiled potato in oil.
method.l: Tui leh khuhna a awm lo. Alu kilo 16 khuh chuan a chhum a, alu chhum chu hriak chhunga alu chhum a ni mai.

method.en: Turn it four times in forty minutes and no more. Every extra turn breaks a face and sixteen kilos turned constantly is a mash.
method.l: Minute sawmliah vawi li letling la, chu aia tam lo. Letling belh apiangin a mai a tikek a, letling reng kilo 16 chu bal a lo ni.

method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering. In a kitchen with no onion it is the only thing standing where the onion would.
method.l: Tihremna-ah hing. Purun awm lo chawthleng-ah chuan purun awmna hmun ah ding chu chu chauh a ni.

recipes.why: Ten rupees twenty a head. Alu is in an Aizawl store room every month of the year, and this is the dry dish that goes beside a puri when nothing else has come in.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmhnih. Kum chhung thla tinah Aizawl thil dahnaah alu a awm a, hei hi thil dang engmah a lo luh loh hunah puri bula kal ro rem a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes on the fire, in two batches.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Mei chungah minute sawmli, vawi hnihin.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai and a flat ladle. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 kadai zau leh chawpna phen. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and every third day in thlasik.
season.l: Kum tin, tin thlasik lai ni thum danah.

recipes.name: Mai Chhum
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked dry until the edges catch and go sweet
recipes.sub_l: Mai chu a kam a kang a a thlum thlengin ro-in a chhum

method.en: No water at any point. Sixteen kilos of mai gives up all the water it needs in the first ten minutes.
method.l: Khawi hun mahah tui a awm lo. Mai kilo 16 chuan minute sawm hmasa berah a mamawh tui zawng zawng chu a pe.

method.en: Cook it in two batches in a wide kadai. Sixteen kilos at once steams in its own water and a steamed mai is a wet bai without a name.
method.l: Kadai zau-ah vawi hnihin chhum rawh. Kilo 16 khawmin chuan amah tui-ah a chhum a, mai chhum chuan hming nei lo bai hnawng a lo ni.

method.en: Let the edges catch before it is turned. That caught edge is where the sweetness comes from and one turned every minute has none.
method.l: Letling hmain a kam chu kang ang che. Chu kam kang chu a thlumna lohna a ni a, minute tinin letling chuan a nei lo.

method.en: No sugar. A favang mai is already sweet and one that has caught at the edges is sweeter still.
method.l: Sugar a awm lo. Favang mai chu a thlum tawh a, a kam kang chu a thlum zual bawk.

recipes.why: Seven rupees fifty a head, the cheapest dry dish in this book. In favang a Mamit jhum gives more mai than the kitchen can use and sixteen kilos costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sarih leh sawmnga, he lehkhabu-a ro rem man tlawm ber. Favang lai-ah Mamit lo chuan chawthleng hman zawng aiin mai a tam zawk a pe a, kilo 16 chu phurhna man chauh a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, in two batches.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmnga, vawi hnihin.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai and a flat ladle. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 kadai zau leh chawpna phen. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, lo aṭangin, chumi hnuah thil dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Fanghma Chhum
recipes.sub: Ripe cucumber cooked dry with sesame, skin and seed left in
recipes.sub_l: Fanghma hmin chu a hnawng leh a chi nen chhawhchhi nen ro-in a chhum

method.en: Use the ripe yellow fanghma and not the young green one. A young cucumber is for the salad tray; a ripe one holds its shape on the fire.
method.l: Fanghma hmin eng chu hmang la, a hring naupang chu ni lo. Fanghma naupang chu thlai hring tray atan a ni; a hmin chuan mei chungah a lam a vawn.

method.en: Keep the seed in. Half the taste of a fanghma chhum is in the seed and scooping it out wastes two kilos in fourteen.
method.l: A chi chu dah rawh. Fanghma chhum tui a chanve chu a chi-ah a awm a, chu chu chhuah chuan kilo 14 zingah kilo hnih a boral.

method.en: No water and no lid. A lid on fourteen kilos steams it and a steamed fanghma is a bowl of water with skins in it.
method.l: Tui leh khuhna a awm lo. Kilo 14 khuh chuan a chhum a, fanghma chhum chuan hnawng nei tui kchu a lo ni.

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi and crush it in at the end. It is what holds eighteen kilos together and no flour is needed anywhere in it.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu kang la, a tawpah dengin thlak rawh. Chu chuan kilo 18 chu a tikhawm a, khawi hmunah mah chhang a tul lo.

recipes.why: Eight rupees sixty a head. In thal the Lunglei fanghma is left on the vine to ripen because nobody buys a ripe one, and this is what a kitchen does with it.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka riat leh sawmruk. Thal lai-ah Lunglei fanghma chu tuman a hmin a lei loh avangin hrui chungah a hmin thlengin dah a ni a, hei hi chawthlengin chu a tih dan a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes on the fire.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Mei chungah minute sawmli.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai and a flat ladle. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 kadai zau leh chawpna phen. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Thal to fur, when the fanghma is left to ripen.
season.l: Thal aṭanga fur thleng, fanghma hmin turin dah hun.

recipes.name: Bepui Chhum
recipes.sub: Soybean boiled soft and fried dry with chilli and sesame
recipes.sub_l: Bepui chu nemin chhum a, hmarcha leh chhawhchhi nen ro-in a chhum

method.en: Soak the bepui eight hours and rub the skins off. A bepui skin does not soften and it is felt in every spoon of eighteen kilos.
method.l: Bepui chu darkar riat tui-ah dah la, a hnawng chu chhir chhuak rawh. Bepui hnawng chu a nem lo va, kilo 18-a chawpna tinah a hriat.

method.en: Boil it soft and drain it completely before it goes in the kadai. A wet bepui in oil throws the oil the moment it goes in.
method.l: Kadai-ah a luh hmain nemin chhum la, tui chu famkimin sen chhuak rawh. Hriak chhunga bepui hnawng chuan a luh veleh hriak chu a chhehchhuak.

method.en: Let the edges catch before it is turned. A boiled bean fried without catching is a boiled bean and eighteen kilos of it comes back.
method.l: Letling hmain a kam chu kang ang che. Kang lova chhum be chhum chu be chhum a ni mai a, kilo 18 chu a rawn kir.

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi and crush it in at the end. It is what makes eighteen kilos of bean taste like something a cook decided on.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu kang la, a tawpah dengin thlak rawh. Chu chuan be kilo 18 chu chawmi thutlukna ang tui a nei.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees ninety a head. Five kilos of bepui gives a hundred people the protein of a meal and a dry tray keeps four hours on a counter without souring.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh pakhat leh sawmkua. Bepui kilo nga chuan mi za-a tan chaw thanna a pe a, tray ro chuan sem hnaih velah darkar li a thur lovin a awm thei.

start.en: Bepui soaks eight hours and boils an hour. Start the evening before.
start.l: Bepui chu darkar riat tui-ah a awm a, darkar khat a chhum. A ni hmaa tlaiah tan rawh.

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a draining basket and a wide 30 L kadai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chhum nan bel, tui senna bawm leh litre 30 kadai zau. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Favang to thal, out of the granary.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, buh dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Bekang Bai
recipes.sub: The everyday bai, seasoned with bekang
recipes.sub_l: Bai, bekang nen

method.en: Bai is the central dish of this book and of Mizo cooking. It is a thin boiled stew of whatever greens came in, seasoned with bekang, and it is eaten with rice at nearly every meal.
method.l: Bai hi Mizo chaw thil pawimawh ber a ni. Thlai awm apiang thlawp a, bekang nen thleng a ni.

method.en: Add the taro and pumpkin first and cook them fifteen minutes. Both break down and give the broth what body it has.
method.l: Dawl leh mai chu hmasain dah la, minute 15 thlawp rawh. Pahnihin tui a tikhauh.

method.en: Add the chhang with the tough greens. It softens the stems and keeps the whole pot green rather than olive.
method.l: Chhang chu thlai khauh nen dah rawh. A kung a tinawi a, bel a hring reng tir.

method.en: Crumble the bekang in halfway through rather than at the end. It needs ten minutes in the pot to break down and season the broth.
method.l: Bekang chu a chanve-ah chal rawh, a tawpah dah suh. Minute 10 a ngai.

method.en: Boil with the lid off from start to finish. A lid traps the sulphur and the greens go dull within minutes.
method.l: Khuh lovin thlawp rawh, a tirah atanga a tawp thleng.

method.en: Keep it thin. A bai is a broth poured over rice, not a thick stew, and thickening it is the commonest mistake a plains cook makes here.
method.l: A tui takin dah rawh. Bai chu buh chunga leih tur tui a ni.

recipes.why: The dish this whole book is built on. Bekang in early, chhang with the stems, and no lid.
recipes.why_l: He lehkhabu bul a ni. Bekang hmasa, chhang a kung nen, khuh loh.

start.en: Wash the greens three times. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Thlai chu vawi thum sil rawh.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel zau 40 L, khuh lo. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year with whatever greens came in.
season.l: Kum tin, thlai awm apiang nen.

recipes.name: Maian Bai
recipes.sub: Bai with fermented bamboo shoot
recipes.sub_l: Maian bai

method.en: Rinse the maian twice in cold water and squeeze it out. Straight from the jar it will take over the whole pot.
method.l: Maian chu tui dai-ah vawi hnih sil la, hnawh chhuak rawh.

method.en: Fry the drained maian in the oil for eight minutes before anything else goes in. That frying is what turns a raw ferment into a dish.
method.l: Maian chu hriak-ah minute 8 chhum hmasa rawh. Chuan a thur hel chu a bo ang.

method.en: Add the potato and water and cook fifteen minutes, then the greens with the chhang.
method.l: Alu leh tui dah la, minute 15 thlawp la, chuan thlai hring leh chhang dah rawh.

method.en: Crumble the bekang in for the last ten minutes. Maian and bekang together are strong and neither should be increased.
method.l: A tawp minute 10-ah bekang chal rawh. Maian leh bekang chu a chak tawh.

method.en: Salt only at the end and taste first. Maian is salted in the jar and a heavy hand cannot be taken back.
method.l: Chi chu a tawpah chauh, tem hmasa rawh. Maian-ah chi a tel tawh.

method.en: Keep it thin and finish with coriander off the fire.
method.l: A tui takin dah la, mei atanga la chhuah hnuah hnahchiar dah rawh.

recipes.why: One jar opened in September is still on the table in June. Fry the ferment first or it never becomes a dish.
recipes.why_l: September-a hawn bel chu June thlengin dawhkan chungah a la awm.

start.en: Rinse the maian twice. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Maian chu vawi hnih sil rawh.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel zau 40 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year — maian keeps a year in its jar.
season.l: Kum tin — maian chu kum khat a awm thei.

recipes.name: Maian Bai leh Mai
recipes.sub: Pumpkin bai with bekang
recipes.sub_l: Mai bai, bekang nen

method.en: The fruit, the leaves and the young tendrils are all used. In these hills the pumpkin is grown as much for its leaves as for the fruit.
method.l: A rah, a hnah leh a hrui zawng zawng hman a ni.

method.en: Cut the pumpkin into large chunks with the skin on if it is a tender one. The skin holds the pieces together in a long boil.
method.l: Mai chu a hnah nen at rawh, a nawi a nih chuan. A hnah hian a phum khawm.

method.en: Add no water beyond what is listed. Pumpkin releases a great deal of its own and a heavy hand gives a soup.
method.l: Ziak aia tam tui dah suh. Mai chuan a tui a chhuah tam.

method.en: Add the chhang with the leaves and tendrils only, not with the fruit. Pumpkin flesh needs no alkali and it turns slippery.
method.l: Chhang chu a hnah leh a hrui nen chauh dah rawh, a rah nen dah suh.

method.en: Crumble the bekang in halfway through and cook until about a third of the pumpkin has gone into the broth.
method.l: A chanve-ah bekang chal la, mai a pathum zela pakhat a chhia hlen thlengin thlawp rawh.

method.en: Add the leaves in the last six minutes and salt in the last two.
method.l: A hnah chu a tawp minute 6-ah dah la, chi chu minute 2-ah dah rawh.

recipes.why: The sweetness of the pumpkin against the salt of the bekang, and the leaves cost nothing.
recipes.why_l: Mai a thlum a, bekang a al a, a hnah chu man a awm lo.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel zau 40 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year, cheapest July to October.
season.l: Kum tin, July atanga October a man a tlawm ber.

recipes.name: Alu Bai
recipes.sub: Potato bai for a day with no greens
recipes.sub_l: Thlai awm loh ni atan alu bai

method.en: This is the bai for a day when nothing green came down from the jhum, and every Mizo kitchen has such days.
method.l: Hei hi lo atanga thlai a lo kal loh ni atan bai a ni.

method.en: Do not add chhang. There are no tough stems here and alkali on potato makes it slippery and grey.
method.l: Chhang dah suh. Alu-ah chuan a ngai lo va, a nal a, a dum ang.

method.en: Fry the bekang in the oil with the ginger for five minutes before the potato goes in.
method.l: Alu dah hmain bekang chu sawhthing nen minute 5 chhum rawh.

method.en: Add the potato and water and simmer twenty minutes until it is soft enough to mash against the side.
method.l: Alu leh tui dah la, minute 20 thlawp la, bel kaah nep theih thlengin.

method.en: Mash a few pieces of potato into the broth to thicken it. There is no dairy and no flour in this book to do that job.
method.l: Alu thenkhat chu tui-ah nep la, tikhauh rawh.

method.en: Add the tomato in the last ten minutes and finish with coriander off the fire.
method.l: A tawp minute 10-ah tomato dah la, mei atanga la chhuah hnuah hnahchiar dah rawh.

recipes.why: Ingredients that are always in the store, fifty minutes from cold, and it goes with rice or roti equally.
recipes.why_l: Bel-ah a awm reng thin. Minute 50 chauh a la.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel zau 40 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year. The dish for a morning when nothing came in.
season.l: Kum tin. Thlai awm loh ni-ah.

recipes.name: Tomato Bai
recipes.sub: Tomato cooked down thin with roasted rice flour
recipes.sub_l: Tomato chu buh chhang kang nen sekin a chhum

method.en: Roast the tomato on the flame and peel it. The skin in a bai rolls up into strings and every devotee finds one.
method.l: Tomato chu mei chungah kang la, a hnawng hlip rawh. Bai chhunga hnawng chu a inkual a, mi tinin pakhat an hmu.

method.en: Mix the rice flour to a slurry in cold water before it goes in. Thrown in dry, four hundred grams of it becomes forty lumps.
method.l: A luh hmain buh chhang chu tui vawt-ah chhawm tifual rawh. Ro-in thlak chuan gram 400 chu bal sawmli a lo ni.

method.en: Cook the tomato twenty minutes before the flour goes in. Flour in early stops the tomato breaking and the bai tastes of raw fruit.
method.l: Chhang a luh hmain tomato chu minute sawmhnih chhum rawh. Chhang hma taka luh chuan tomato kek chu a tibang a, bai chuan rah thing tui a nei.

method.en: Keep it thin. A tomato bai is drunk off the plate and a thick one is a chartawk that came to the wrong vessel.
method.l: Sekin dah rawh. Tomato bai chu thlengbel aṭangin in a ni a, a sang chuan bel dik lo-a lo thleng chartawk a ni.

recipes.why: Nine rupees twenty a head. Tomato is at Bara Bazar every month of the year and the roasted rice flour does the work a cream would do in a plains gravy.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka kua leh sawmhnih. Kum chhung thla tinah Bara Bazar-ah tomato a awm a, buh chhang kang chuan phaizawl bai-a cream hna thawh tur chu a thawk.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, most of it roasting and peeling.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmnga, a tam zawk chu kang leh hlip a ni.

vessel.en: An open flame for the roasting and a 35 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Kang nan mei hawng leh litre 35 bel. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: All year, and cheapest in favang.
season.l: Kum tin, tin favang lai a man tlawm ber.

recipes.name: Bandari Bai
recipes.sub: Cabbage and peas in a thin gravy with chhang water
recipes.sub_l: Bandari leh matar chu chhang tui nen bai sek-ah

method.en: Cut the bandari in wide pieces and not shreds. A shredded cabbage in a bai disappears and twenty-six litres is a green water.
method.l: Bandari chu zau zawkin at la, sang zawkin at suh. Bai chhunga bandari at sang chu a bo a, litre 26 chu tui hring a lo ni.

method.en: The peas go in with the fire off. Cooked twenty minutes they are grey and two kilos of grey peas is seen from the door.
method.l: Matar chu mei mit hnuah a lut. Minute sawmhnih chhum chuan a vardum a, matar vardum kilo hnih chu kawngkhar aṭangin a lang.

method.en: Cook it uncovered. Under a lid ten kilos of cabbage steams and the smell reaches the far end of the hall.
method.l: Khuh lovin chhum rawh. Khuh chuan bandari kilo sawm chu a chhum a, a rim chu in a tawp thlengin a thleng.

method.en: Take it off while a piece still holds. Cabbage cooks for ten minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a mash in the hall.
method.l: A tlangte a khauh reng lai la chhuak rawh. Mei a mit hnuah bandari chuan minute sawm a chhum a, chawthlengah a dik chu in chhungah bal a lo ni.

recipes.why: Ten rupees eighty a head. Bandari keeps ten days in an Aizawl store room where a green leaf keeps two, and two kilos of peas make it a dish and not a filler.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmriat. Thlai hring chu ni hnih chauh a awm theih Aizawl thil dahnaah bandari chu ni sawm a awm thei a, matar kilo hnih chuan tikhat nan ni lovin chaw ngei a siam.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, uncovered throughout.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, a tawp thlengin khuh lo.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 35 bel, khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, while the bandari is in the market.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, bandari bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Paneer Bai
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and sesame gravy, no onion and no garlic
recipes.sub_l: Paneer chu tomato leh chhawhchhi bai-ah, purun leh purunsen tel lo

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi and grind it with the tomato and the cashew. Between them they do the whole job an onion base would do and the sesame costs a fifth of the cashew.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu kang la, tomato leh kaju nen dengin. An zavai chuan purun bul hna thawh tur zawng zawng chu an thawk a, chhawhchhi chu kaju man a nga chhinga pakhat a ni.

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the ghee goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and a spoon of sugar hides it for a minute only.
method.l: Ghee a luh hmain tomato bal chu minute sawmhnih leh nga chhum rawh. Chhum tawk lo tomato chu a thur a, sugar chawpna khat chuan minute khat chhung chauh a thup.

method.en: Hold the cut paneer in warm salted water until the gravy is ready. Left dry on a tray five kilos hardens at the edges within the hour.
method.l: Bai a tling hma chuan paneer at chu tui lum mluh nei-ah dah rawh. Tray chunga ro-in dah chuan darkar khat chhungin kilo nga chu a kam a khauh.

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Five kilos boiled in gravy is five kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: Sem hmain minute li chauhvin paneer chu a lut. Bai-a chhum kilo nga chu sem hnaih velah rabar kilo nga a ni.

recipes.why: Thirty-four rupees ninety a head, the dearest wet dish in this book. Paneer comes up the road and it shows in the price, so this is for Chapchar Kut and a wedding.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmthum leh pali leh sawmkua, he lehkhabu-a chaw tui to ber. Paneer chu kawng zawh chhuah a ni a, a manah a lang; chuvangin hei hi Chapchar Kut leh inneihna tan a ni.

start.en: Cashew soaks an hour. Two hours in all.
start.l: Kaju chu darkar khat tui-ah a awm. A zawng zawngin darkar hnih.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, a grinder and a holding pot for the paneer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Litre 35 bel, denna leh paneer dahna bel. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: At Chapchar Kut, Janmashtami and a wedding.
season.l: Chapchar Kut, Janmashtami leh inneihna-ah.

recipes.name: Mai Bekang Bai
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked thin and finished with fermented soybean
recipes.sub_l: Mai chu sekin chhum a, bekang nen a tihrem

method.en: The bekang goes in with the fire off. Boiled twenty minutes it loses the smell it is bought for and becomes an ordinary bean.
method.l: Bekang chu mei mit hnuah a lut. Minute sawmhnih chhum chuan a lei chhan rim chu a hloh a, be ngaihngai a lo ni.

method.en: Cook the mai until it falls apart and do not mash it. The pumpkin is the body of this vessel and the bekang is only the smell.
method.l: Mai chu a chhe thlengin chhum la, deng suh. He bel taksa chu mai a ni a, bekang chu a rim chauh a ni.

method.en: Cook it uncovered from the moment the bekang goes in. Under a lid a kilo and a half of it will empty a hall.
method.l: Bekang a luh atang chuan khuh lovin chhum rawh. Khuh chuan kilo khat leh chanve chuan in khat a tihruak thei.

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. A bekang is salted in the jar and a hundred and sixty grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: Mluh a luh hmain tem rawh. Bekang chu bel chhungah mluh thlak tawh a ni a, gram 160 chu bel engemaw zat tan a tam tawh.

recipes.why: Nine rupees eighty a head. A kilo and a half of bekang carries ten kilos of mai, and in favang the mai costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka kua leh sawmriat. Bekang kilo khat leh chanve chuan mai kilo sawm a phur a, favang lai-ah mai chu phurhna man chauh a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the bekang in the last five.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, tin bekang chu minute nga hnuhnung berah.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, uncovered at the end. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 35 bel, a tawpah khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, out of the jar put down in fur.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, fur lai-a dah bel aṭangin.

recipes.name: Cucumber Salad
recipes.sub: Hill cucumber with chilli and sesame
recipes.sub_l: Fanghma, hmarcha leh chhawhchhi nen

method.en: The Mizo cucumber is large and thick-skinned and is nothing like a salad cucumber from the plains.
method.l: Mizo fanghma hi a lian a, a hnah a sa a, phaia fanghma nen a inang lo.

method.en: Peel it thickly and cut the seeded core out. Both the skin and the core are tough and neither belongs in the bowl.
method.l: A hnah sa takin hlip la, a chi chu paih rawh.

method.en: Cut into thick pieces rather than thin. This is a substantial salad eaten as part of the meal, not a garnish.
method.l: A pang lovin sa takin at rawh. Hei hi chaw pum a ni.

method.en: Roast the sesame, cool it and crush it coarsely.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu kang la, tidai la, per takin suk rawh.

method.en: Use one bird's eye chilli to about four kilos of cucumber, chopped very fine. Any more and nobody finishes the bowl.
method.l: Fanghma kg 4-ah hmarcha te pakhat, mial takin at rawh.

method.en: Add the salt and lemon at the counter, not in the kitchen. Salted early the cucumber weeps and the tray sits in liquid.
method.l: Chi leh serthlum chu sem hmunah dah rawh, chaw suk inah dah suh.

recipes.why: Salt at the counter, and one chilli to four kilos. Those two rules are the whole salad.
recipes.why_l: Chi chu sem hmunah, hmarcha pakhat kg 4-ah. Chu chauh a ni.

start.en: Cut within the hour of serving. Nothing is made ahead.
start.l: Sem hma darkar khat chhungin at rawh.

vessel.en: Two large trays and sharp knives. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Tray lian 2 leh chem hriam. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: May to September, when the hill cucumber is in.
season.l: May atanga September thleng.

recipes.name: Tomato Shorba
recipes.sub: Thin peppered tomato broth
recipes.sub_l: Tomato tui, hmarcha dum nen

method.en: Use ripe tomatoes and do not peel them. Boil them whole with the ginger and water for twenty-five minutes.
method.l: Tomato min chu a pumin sawhthing nen minute 25 thlawp rawh, hlip suh.

method.en: Press through a strainer rather than grinding. A grinder pulps the skin and seeds into the broth and turns it cloudy and slightly bitter.
method.l: Hnawih lovin chherna-ah hnawh chhuak rawh.

method.en: Add the sugar. It is not there to sweeten — it corrects the acidity of the tomato, and without it the broth tastes thin and sharp.
method.l: Chini dah rawh. Thlum tur ni lovin tomato a thur chu tidik tur a ni.

method.en: Season with a great deal of crushed black pepper. Pepper rather than chilli is what makes this a Mizo broth.
method.l: Hmarcha dum tam tak dah rawh. Hmarcha ai chuan hmarcha dum a ni.

method.en: Simmer ten minutes with the salt and finish with coriander.
method.l: Chi nen minute 10 thlawp la, hnahchiar dah rawh.

method.en: Serve very hot. Held on a flame it reduces and turns sour, so make it close to serving.
method.l: A lum takin sem rawh. Mei chungah dah reng chuan a thur ang.

recipes.why: Twelve kilos of tomato feeds a hundred, and on a cold Aizawl evening it does more than a second bai would.
recipes.why_l: Tomato kg 12 chuan mi 100 a chawm.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 30 L leh chherna. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: November to February, served hot before the meal.
season.l: November atanga February thleng.

recipes.name: Sprouted Bean Salad
recipes.sub: Sprouted moong with lemon and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Mung tho, serthlum leh hmarcha nen

method.en: Soak the whole moong overnight, drain it thoroughly, then tie it loosely in damp cloth.
method.l: Mung pum chu zan khat dah la, tui chhuah fel la, puan hnawih-ah nuai lovin tuam rawh.
