method.en: Rinse and re-drain twice a day. Sprouts sitting in their own water sour within a day and a soured batch cannot be served.
method.l: Ni khatah vawi hnih sil la, tui chhuah rawh.

method.en: They are ready when the tail is about the length of the grain — a day and a half here, longer in the cold months.
method.l: A mei chu a tang zawng ang a nih hunah a puitling tawh a ni.

method.en: Steam the sprouts three minutes before serving them to a crowd. Raw sprouts served in quantity to a hall is not worth the risk, and three minutes changes nothing about the texture.
method.l: Mi tam taka sem hmain minute 3 chhum rawh.

method.en: Cool them completely, then mix with the diced tomato, cucumber, chilli and ginger.
method.l: Tidai fel la, tomato, fanghma, hmarcha leh sawhthing nen chhun rawh.

method.en: Salt and lemon at the counter only, in small lots as the line moves.
method.l: Chi leh serthlum chu sem hmunah, tlem te zelin dah rawh.

recipes.why: Four kilos of dry moong becomes sixteen of salad. Nothing else in this book multiplies like that.
recipes.why_l: Mung ro kg 4 chu kg 16 a lo ni. Thil dang chuan chutiang a ti thei lo.

start.en: Soak overnight and sprout a further day and a half.
start.l: Zan khat dah la, ni khat chanve tho tir rawh.

vessel.en: Two cloth-lined baskets and a steamer. One cook.
vessel.l: Bawm puan phah 2 leh chhum na. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year, best in the hot months.
season.l: Kum tin, a lum lai a tha ber.

recipes.name: Mai Tui
recipes.sub: Pumpkin boiled soft and pressed through a sieve, no cream
recipes.sub_l: Mai chu nemin chhum a, silna-ah a nam, cream tel lo

method.en: Peel it for a soup even though a bai keeps the skin. The skin will not go through a sieve and it is the one thing a devotee finds in a bowl.
method.l: Bai chuan a hnawng a vawn nain tui atan chuan hlip rawh. A hnawng chu silna-ah a lut thei lo va, kchu chhunga mi-in a hmuh thil pakhat chu chu a ni.

method.en: Roasted rice flour in place of a cream. Three hundred grams thickens twenty-two litres and a Mizo kitchen has it on the shelf anyway.
method.l: Cream hmun ah buh chhang vut. Gram 300 chuan litre 22 a tisang a, Mizo chawthleng chuan a thlaite-ah a nei tawh.

method.en: Press it through a sieve and do not use a blender. A blended pumpkin holds air and twenty-two litres of it froths over in the vessel.
method.l: Silna-ah nam la, blender hmang suh. Blender-a tih mai chuan thaw a keng a, litre 22 chu bel chhungah a phuk a luang chhuak.

method.en: Black pepper and no chilli. This is the one dish in the book that goes to the sick room and a hmarcha in it defeats the purpose.
method.l: Hmarcha dum, hmarcha hring ni lo. He lehkhabu-a damlo in-a kal chaw pakhat chu hei a ni a, a chhunga hmarcha chuan a tum chu a tichhia.

recipes.why: Seven rupees fifty a head, no cream and no dairy at all. In favang a Mamit jhum gives twelve kilos for the carrying, and this is the bowl that goes to whoever cannot take a full plate.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sarih leh sawmnga, cream leh hnute a awm hrim hrim lo. Favang lai-ah Mamit lo chuan phurhna man chauhvin kilo 12 a pe a, hei hi thlengbel famkim ei thei lote hnena kal kchu a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. An hour, most of it boiling and sieving.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Darkar khat, a tam zawk chu chhum leh sil a ni.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a wide sieve. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel leh silna zau. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, lo aṭangin, chumi hnuah thil dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Antam Tui
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves boiled in plain water and drunk as a broth
recipes.sub_l: Antam hnah chu tui ngaihngai-ah chhum a, tui angin a in

method.en: No oil at any point and nothing else in the vessel. This is leaves and water and the whole art of it is not adding anything.
method.l: Khawi hun mahah hriak a awm lo va, bel chhungah thil dang a awm lo. Hei hi hnah leh tui a ni a, a thiamna pumpui chu engmah thlak lohna a ni.

method.en: Twelve minutes and no more. Antam boiled twenty minutes gives a broth the colour of a wet road and the bitterness of a medicine.
method.l: Minute sawmhnih chauh, chu aia rei lo. Minute sawmhnih aia rei chhum antam chuan kawng hnawng rawng leh damdawi khahna nei tui a pe.

method.en: Bruise the ginger and drop it in whole, then take it out. Grated sawhthing clouds the broth and an antam tui should be looked through.
method.l: Sawhthing chu dengin, a pumin thlak la, chumi hnuah la chhuak rawh. Sawhthing thlur chuan tui chu a tihthim a, antam tui chu a chhungthlir theih tur a ni.

method.en: Serve it hot and never reheated. An antam tui boiled a second time is bitter and twenty-two litres go back to the kitchen.
method.l: Lum lai sem la, tilum leh ngai lo. Vawi hnihna chhum antam tui chu a khah a, litre 22 chu chawthlengah a rawn kir.

recipes.why: Three rupees ninety a head, the cheapest wet thing in this book. In thlasik the antam is fifteen rupees a kilo and a bowl of it is what a Mizo house drinks instead of a thingpui.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka thum leh sawmkua, he lehkhabu-a thil tui man tlawm ber. Thlasik lai-ah antam chu kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, a kchu khat chu thingpui hmun ah Mizo in-in an in a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Twenty-five minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmhnih leh nga.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel, khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, while the antam is in the market.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, antam bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Bandari Thlai Hring
recipes.sub: Cabbage shredded raw and tossed with sesame and black salt
recipes.sub_l: Bandari thing chu at a, chhawhchhi leh mluh dum nen a chhawm

method.en: Shred the bandari fine and do not chop it. A thlai hring is eaten with the fingers and a chunk of cabbage cannot be picked up with anything else on it.
method.l: Bandari chu sang zawkin at la, lian zawkin at suh. Thlai hring chu kutzung hmangin ei a ni a, bandari tum lian chu thil dang nen pdiang theih a ni lo.

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi and crush it coarse. It is the whole dressing and no oil goes into a thlai hring at all.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu kang la, sang zawkin dengin. Chu chu a tui tuina pumpui a ni a, thlai hring chhungah hriak a lut hrim hrim lo.

method.en: Salt and lemon at the counter and not in the kitchen. Ten kilos of salted cabbage gives up two litres in half an hour and the tray is a soup.
method.l: Mluh leh serthlum chu chawthlengah ni lovin sem hnaih velah. Mluh nei bandari kilo sawm chuan darkar chanve-ah litre hnih a pe a, tray chu tui a lo ni.

method.en: Toss with the hands and not a ladle. A thlai hring turned with a ladle bruises and the whole tray weeps within twenty minutes.
method.l: Chawpna ni lovin kut hmangin chhawm rawh. Chawpna hmanga chhawm thlai hring chu a nem a, tray pumpui chu minute sawmhnih chhungin a tui thla.

recipes.why: Six rupees ninety a head, no fire and no oil. Bandari keeps ten days in an Aizawl store room where a green leaf keeps two.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka ruk leh sawmkua, mei leh hriak tel lo. Thlai hring chu ni hnih chauh a awm theih Aizawl thil dahnaah bandari chu ni sawm a awm thei.

start.en: Nothing cooks. Shred half an hour before the bell; dress at the counter.
start.l: Engmah chhum a ngai lo. Dar a ri hmain darkar chanve-ah at rawh; sem hnaih velah tui tui rawh.

vessel.en: A shredding board and two wide trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Atna dawhkan leh tray zau pahnih. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Favang to thal, out of the store room.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, thil dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Rawtuai Thlai Hring
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot boiled once, cut fine and tossed with sesame
recipes.sub_l: Rawtuai chu vawi khat chhum, sang zawkin at a, chhawhchhi nen a chhawm

method.en: Boil the rawtuai once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sharpness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: Rawtuai chu tui ngaihngai-ah vawi khat chhum la, chu tui chu paih rawh. Tui hmasa ber chuan lei tihrual thei khauhna chu a keng.

method.en: Squeeze it dry between the palms after boiling. A wet rawtuai will not take the sesame and the tray is a grey water by the time the line starts.
method.l: Chhum hnuah kutphah kara ro-in chhir rawh. Rawtuai hnawng chuan chhawhchhi a pdiang lo va, mi an lo kal hunah tray chu tui vardum a lo ni.

method.en: Cut it in strips along the grain and never across. Cut across, the shoot falls into short pieces and there is nothing to pick up.
method.l: A hri zawnin at la, a kang zawnin at ngai lo. A kang zawna at chuan rawtuai chu a tlang tê a lo ni a, pdiang tur engmah a awm lo.

method.en: No oil and no lemon. The rawtuai is sharp enough on its own and a lemon over it is a tray nobody can eat past two mouthfuls.
method.l: Hriak leh serthlum a awm lo. Rawtuai chu amah ngeiin a khauh tawk a, a chunga serthlum chuan tuman ka hnih aia tam an ei theih loh tray a siam.

recipes.why: Eight rupees sixty a head. In fur the shoot comes off the Champhai hill for the cutting and eight kilos of it is a tray for a hundred with no oil bought at all.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka riat leh sawmruk. Fur lai-ah rawtuai chu Champhai tlang aṭangin at man chauhvin a lo chhuak a, kilo riat chuan hriak lei tel lovin mi za atan tray a ni.

start.en: Boil and squeeze two hours ahead. Dress at the counter.
start.l: Darkar hnih hmaah chhum la chhir rawh. Sem hnaih velah tui tui rawh.

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a squeezing cloth and two wide trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chhum nan bel, chhirna puan leh tray zau pahnih. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Fur to favang, while the fresh shoot is on the hill.
season.l: Fur aṭanga favang thleng, rawtuai thar tlang-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Iskut Tui
recipes.sub: Chayote and its leaf boiled to a clear broth with black pepper
recipes.sub_l: Iskut leh a hnah chu tui fim thlengin chhum, hmarcha dum nen

method.en: Cut the iskut in large pieces and leave the skin on. The skin is what keeps eight kilos from dissolving into a cloudy broth.
method.l: Iskut chu lian zawkin at la, a hnawng chu dah rawh. A hnawng chuan kilo riat chu tui thim-ah a duai lo turin a vawn.

method.en: The leaf goes in the last four minutes. Boiled from the start, two kilos of iskut hnah turns twenty-two litres the colour of a wet road.
method.l: A hnah chu minute li hnuhnung berah a lut. Tir aṭanga chhum chuan iskut hnah kilo hnih chuan litre 22 chu kawng hnawng rawng a siam.

method.en: No oil and no rice flour. This is the one broth on the shelf that is meant to be looked through and a thickener spoils it.
method.l: Hriak leh buh chhang a awm lo. He thlaite-a chhungthlir theih tur tui pakhat chu hei a ni a, tisangna chuan a tichhia.

method.en: Black pepper and no chilli. An iskut tui is what goes to whoever cannot take a full plate and a hmarcha in it defeats the purpose.
method.l: Hmarcha dum, hmarcha hring ni lo. Iskut tui chu thlengbel famkim ei thei lote hnena kal a ni a, a chhunga hmarcha chuan a tum chu a tichhia.

recipes.why: Four rupees ninety a head, no oil and no dairy. An iskut vine on a Serchhip fence gives fruit and leaf for eight months and both of them go into this vessel.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka li leh sawmkua, hriak leh hnute tel lo. Serchhip huan kulh chunga iskut hrui chuan thla riat chhung rah leh hnah a pe a, a pahnihin he bel chhungah a lut.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmthum.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel, khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Fur to thlasik, off the fence behind the kitchen.
season.l: Fur aṭanga thlasik thleng, chawthleng hnung lam kulh aṭangin.

recipes.name: Koat Pitha
recipes.sub: Fried banana and rice flour cake
recipes.sub_l: Balhla leh buh chhang chhum

method.en: Koat pitha is close to the only sweet these hills make, and the book should say so rather than pad the section with dishes from elsewhere.
method.l: Koat pitha hi he tlanga thlum siam tak chhun a ni a, hmun dang thlum dah luh a ngai lo.

method.en: Use bananas that are properly ripe, with black flecks on the skin. An underripe banana gives a pitha that is starchy rather than sweet.
method.l: Balhla min tak hmang rawh, a hnah dum tawh.

method.en: Mash the bananas by hand rather than grinding them. A ground banana turns to liquid and the batter will not hold its shape in the oil.
method.l: Balhla chu kutin nep rawh, machine hmang suh.

method.en: Melt the jaggery in a little water and strain it before it goes in. Jaggery always carries grit.
method.l: Kurtai chu tui tlemte-ah tihral la, chher rawh.

method.en: Rest the batter twenty minutes and check it again — rice flour absorbs slowly and it will have tightened.
method.l: A tui chu minute 20 dah la, en leh rawh.

method.en: Fry on a low to medium flame. Banana and jaggery both brown very fast, and a hot kadhai gives a pitha black outside and raw within.
method.l: Mei tlem-ah chhum rawh. Balhla leh kurtai chuan a dum thruk.

recipes.why: The one sweet these hills make. Ripe bananas and a low flame, and there is nothing else to it.
recipes.why_l: He tlanga thlum chhun a ni. Balhla min leh mei tlem chauh a ni.

start.en: Rest the batter twenty minutes. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: A tui chu minute 20 dah rawh.

vessel.en: Three deep kadhais. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Bel thuk 3. Chaw suk 3.

season.en: All year. The one sweet these hills genuinely make.
season.l: Kum tin. He tlanga thlum siam tak chu hei a ni.

recipes.name: Sticky Rice with Jaggery
recipes.sub: Steamed sticky rice with jaggery and sesame
recipes.sub_l: Buh nal chhum, kurtai leh chhawhchhi nen

method.en: Soak the sticky rice six hours and steam it forty minutes, exactly as for plain sticky rice.
method.l: Buh nal chu darkar 6 dah la, minute 40 chhum rawh.

method.en: Melt the jaggery in a little water and strain it. Jaggery always carries grit and unstrained it goes into the rice.
method.l: Kurtai chu tui tlemte-ah tihral la, chher rawh.

method.en: Cook the strained jaggery down to a thick syrup before the rice goes in. A thin syrup makes the rice wet and it will not hold.
method.l: Buh dah hmain kurtai tui chu khauh thleng thlawp rawh.

method.en: Fold the hot steamed rice into the hot syrup. Both must be hot — cold rice will not take the syrup up and cold syrup will not coat.
method.l: Buh lum chu kurtai tui lum-ah chhun rawh. Pahnihin a lum tur a ni.

method.en: Add roasted crushed sesame and a little grated ginger at the end.
method.l: A tawpah chhawhchhi kang leh sawhthing tlemte dah rawh.

method.en: Press into trays while warm and cut when cool.
method.l: A lum lain tray-ah nemnghet la, a dai hunah at rawh.

recipes.why: Rice and jaggery. No dairy, which is true of everything in this book.
recipes.why_l: Buh leh kurtai. Hnute a tel lo, he lehkhabu-ah engmah-ah a tel lo.

start.en: Soak the sticky rice six hours. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: Buh nal chu darkar 6 dah rawh.

vessel.en: Three steamers and a wide pan. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chhum na 3 leh bel zau. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: All year. The sweet of a feast day.
season.l: Kum tin. Kut ni thlum a ni.

recipes.name: Pumpkin with Jaggery
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked down with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Mai, kurtai nen thlawp

method.en: Peel the pumpkin and cut it into large chunks. Small pieces disappear entirely in a long cook.
method.l: Mai chu hlip la, sa takin at rawh. A pang lutuk chuan a bo vek ang.

method.en: Cook the pumpkin in the oil alone on a medium flame for thirty minutes before the jaggery goes in, so its water goes off.
method.l: Kurtai dah hmain mai chu hriak-ah minute 30 thlawp la, a tui a kang phal rawh.

method.en: Add no water at all. Pumpkin is nearly all water and a heavy hand turns this into a soup.
method.l: Tui reng reng dah suh. Mai chu a tui tam.

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately and strain it before it goes in.
method.l: Kurtai chu hran hranin tihral la, chher rawh.

method.en: Add the jaggery only when the pumpkin is soft and its water has gone. Sugar added early stops the pumpkin softening and it will stay firm.
method.l: Mai a nawi a, a tui a kang hnuah chauh kurtai dah rawh.

method.en: Mash about a third of the pumpkin and finish with toasted sesame and grated ginger.
method.l: Mai a pathum zela pakhat chu nep la, chhawhchhi kang leh sawhthing dah rawh.

recipes.why: Sixteen kilos of a cheap vegetable turned into a sweet. Jaggery last, or the pumpkin never softens.
recipes.why_l: Thlai man tlawm kg 16 chu thlum a lo ni. Kurtai chu a tawpah.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. Two cooks in turns.
vessel.l: Bel zau 40 L. Chaw suk 2, inthlak zelin.

season.en: July to October, when pumpkin is cheapest.
season.l: July atanga October thleng, mai man tlawm lai.

recipes.name: Buh Kheer
recipes.sub: Rice cooked down slowly in milk with cardamom
recipes.sub_l: Buh chu hnutetui-ah muangchangin chhum, elaichi nen

method.en: Wash the rice and break it a little in the hand before it goes in. A broken grain gives up its starch and eighteen litres thickens without a spoon of flour.
method.l: Buh chu sil la, a luh hmain kut hmangin tlemte kek rawh. Chi kek chuan a hnim a pe a, chhang chawpna khat pawh tel lovin litre 18 a sang.

method.en: Two kilos in eighteen litres and no more. Three kilos gives a pudding and a kheer is a thing that is drunk.
method.l: Litre 18-ah kilo hnih chauh, chu aia tam lo. Kilo thum chuan pudding a pe a, kheer chu in tur a ni.

method.en: Stir the bottom every three minutes for the whole hour. Rice sinks and eighteen litres of milk burns under it with no smell reaching the cook.
method.l: Darkar khat chhung zawngin minute thum danin a hnuai chu chhawm rawh. Buh chu a thla a, hnutetui litre 18 chu a hnuaiah a kang a, chawmi hnenah a rim a thleng lo.

method.en: Sugar in the last ten minutes. Added early it stops the rice softening and the grain stays hard through the vessel.
method.l: Sugar chu minute sawm hnuhnung berah. Hmain thlak chuan buh nem chu a tibang a, bel pumpuiah a chi chu a khauh reng.

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees ninety a head. Two kilos of rice and eighteen litres of milk is the whole sweet; there is no khoya bought and no cream anywhere in it.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmhnih leh pali leh sawmkua. Buh kilo hnih leh hnutetui litre 18 chu thil thlum pumpui a ni; khoya lei a awm lo va, khawi hmunah mah cream a awm lo.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmkua.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel rit. Chawmi pakhat, a kalsan lo tur.

season.en: All year, at Chapchar Kut and Pawl Kut above all.
season.l: Kum tin, tin Chapchar Kut leh Pawl Kut-ah a bik takin.

recipes.name: Semiya Kheer
recipes.sub: Vermicelli roasted in ghee and cooked in reduced milk
recipes.sub_l: Semiya chu ghee-ah kang a, hnutetui tiawm-ah a chhum

method.en: Roast the semiya in ghee until it is the colour of a bay leaf. Unroasted, a kilo and a half turns twenty-two litres to glue.
method.l: Semiya chu tejpatta rawng a nih thlengin ghee-ah kang rawh. Kang loh chuan kilo khat leh chanve chuan litre 22 chu bet a lo tisiam.

method.en: A kilo and a half in sixteen litres and no more. Semiya swells to four times its weight and two kilos is a vessel that cannot be poured.
method.l: Litre 16-ah kilo khat leh chanve chauh, chu aia tam lo. Semiya chu a rit aia vawi li a puak a, kilo hnih chuan sem chhuah theih loh bel a lo ni.

method.en: The semiya goes in only after the milk has reduced by a fifth. Added to full milk it swells before the milk has thickened.
method.l: Hnutetui chu a nga chhinga pakhat a tiawm hnu chauhvin semiya chu a lut. Hnutetui famkim-ah thlak chuan hnutetui a sang hmain a puak.

method.en: Take it off looser than it should be. Semiya drinks for twenty minutes in the vessel and a kheer that is right in the kitchen is a pudding in the hall.
method.l: A dan aiin sek zawkin la chhuak rawh. Semiya chuan bel chhungah minute sawmhnih a in a, chawthlengah a dik kheer chu in chhungah pudding a lo ni.

recipes.why: Twenty-six rupees fifty a head. A kilo and a half of semiya does what four kilos of rice would, and it is ready in half the time a buh kheer takes.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmhnih leh ruk leh sawmnga. Semiya kilo khat leh chanve chuan buh kilo li thawh tur chu a thawk a, buh kheer hun a hmuh chanve chhungin a tling.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmkua.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel and a roasting pan. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel rit leh kangna bel. Chawmi pakhat, a kalsan lo tur.

season.en: All year, on any festival day.
season.l: Kum tin, kut ni apiangah.

recipes.name: Sooji Halwa
recipes.sub: Semolina roasted long in ghee and cooked in a hot syrup
recipes.sub_l: Sooji chu ghee-ah rei tak kang a, sugar tui lum-ah a chhum

method.en: Roast the sooji in the ghee twenty-five minutes on a low flame. This is the whole dish; a fifteen-minute halwa tastes of raw semolina whatever is added after.
method.l: Mei tlem chungah sooji chu ghee-ah minute sawmhnih leh nga kang rawh. Hei hi chaw pumpui a ni; minute sawmpanga halwa chu a hnua thil belhchhah pawh ni se sooji thing tui a nei.

method.en: The syrup goes in boiling and never cold. Cold syrup on hot sooji seizes and twenty kilos is lumps that no ladle will break.
method.l: Sugar tui chu a chhum lai a lut a, a vawt lai a lut ngai lo. Sooji lum chunga sugar tui vawt chuan a khal a, kilo 20 chu bal a lo ni a, chawpna engmahin a tichhe thei lo.

method.en: Two parts syrup to one of sooji by weight. Less and the halwa is dry by the time the vessel crosses the yard.
method.l: Rit-in sooji pakhat-ah sugar tui pahnih. A tlem chuan bel chu huan a kan hunah halwa chu a ro tawh.

method.en: Off the fire, lid on, ten minutes. A halwa that has not stood is gritty at the centre and twenty kilos cannot be recooked.
method.l: Mei aṭangin la chhuak, khuh la, minute sawm. Awm reh lo halwa chu a laiah sepaipui angin a awm a, kilo 20 chu chhum leh theih a ni lo.

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees ninety a head, and the ghee is most of it. It is the sweet for a Chapchar Kut; on an ordinary day a koat pitha carries the hall for sixteen.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmhnih leh pathum leh sawmkua, tin a tam zawk chu ghee a ni. Hei hi Chapchar Kut thil thlum a ni; ni ngaihngai-ah koat pitha chuan tangka sawmparuk-in in chhung a phur.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, and ten of them under the lid.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmkua, chung zinga minute sawm chu khuh a.

vessel.en: A heavy wide 30 L kadai with a lid. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 30 kadai zau leh rit. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: All year, at Chapchar Kut and a wedding above all.
season.l: Kum tin, tin Chapchar Kut leh inneihna-ah a bik takin.

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
recipes.sub: Milk powder balls fried slow and soaked in a thin syrup
recipes.sub_l: Hnute vut bal te chu muangchangin chhum a, sugar tui sek-ah a dah

method.en: Bind the dough and fry it inside twenty minutes. A milk powder dough left standing goes slack and the balls flatten in the ghee.
method.l: Chhang chu tikhawm la, minute sawmhnih chhungin chhum rawh. Hnute vut chhang awm rei chu a duai a, a bal te chu ghee-ah a phen.

method.en: Fry on the lowest flame that will keep them moving. A hot ghee browns the outside in a minute and the centre is raw milk powder at the counter.
method.l: An leng reng theih nan mei tlem ber chungah chhum rawh. Ghee lum chuan minute khatah a pawn lam a dum a, sem hnaih velah a lai chu hnute vut thing a ni.

method.en: The syrup is one thread and no more. A thick syrup will not go into the jamun and six hundred of them sit in it dry.
method.l: Sugar tui chu hrui khat chauh a ni, chu aia sang lo. Sugar tui sang chuan jamun chhungah a lut thei lo va, za ruk chu a chhungah ro-in a awm.

method.en: The syrup must be warm and the jamun hot when they meet. Cold syrup on a hot jamun and the skin closes; nothing goes in after that.
method.l: An intawh hunah sugar tui chu lum a, jamun chu lum tur a ni. Jamun lum chunga sugar tui vawt chuan a hnawng chu a khar a, chu hnu chuan engmah a lut thei tawh lo.

recipes.why: Forty-two rupees ninety a head. Every ingredient comes up the road and it shows in the price, so this is for Chapchar Kut and a wedding and nothing else.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmli leh pahnih leh sawmkua. Thil hman zawng zawng chu kawng zawh chhuah a ni a, a manah a lang; chuvangin hei hi Chapchar Kut leh inneihna tan chauh a ni.

start.en: The syrup is made first and kept warm. Three hours in all for six hundred.
start.l: Sugar tui chu hmasain siam a, lumin dah a ni. Za ruk atan a zawng zawngin darkar thum.

vessel.en: A deep kadai, a 30 L syrup vessel and a rolling tray. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Kadai thuk, sugar tui atan litre 30 bel leh bal siamna tray. Chawmi pathum.

season.en: At Chapchar Kut and a wedding.
season.l: Chapchar Kut leh inneihna-ah.

recipes.name: Balhla Kurtai Nen
recipes.sub: Ripe banana cooked down in jaggery until it holds a spoon
recipes.sub_l: Balhla hmin chu chawpna a vawn thlengin kurtai-ah a chhum

method.en: Use the ripest balhla on the cart and not the firm one. A firm banana holds its shape and this dish is meant to be a paste on a leaf.
method.l: Gari chunga balhla hmin ber chu hmang la, a khauh chu ni lo. Balhla khauh chuan a lam a vawn a, he chaw hi hnah chunga bal a ni tur a ni.

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately and strain it. Field kurtai carries sand and grit in a sweet is what is remembered of it.
method.l: Kurtai chu hrangin tifual la, sil rawh. Lo lam kurtai chuan sepaipui a keng a, thil thlum chhunga sepaipui chu hre reng tur a ni.

method.en: Cook it in a wide pan and not a deep vessel. Fourteen kilos in a deep pot steams instead of reducing and it will not hold a spoon.
method.l: Bel thuk-ah ni lovin bel zau-ah chhum rawh. Bel thuk chhunga kilo 14 chu a tiawm ai chuan a chhum a, chawpna a vawn thei lo.

method.en: Ghee at the end and only four hundred grams. More than that and the sweet separates on the leaf and the oil runs to the edge.
method.l: A tawpah ghee, tin gram 400 chauh. Chu aia tam chuan thil thlum chu hnah chungah a inṭhen a, hriak chu a kam lam a luang.

recipes.why: Nine rupees eighty a head, the cheapest sweet in this book. In Kolasib the over-ripe balhla is fifteen rupees a kilo because nobody wants it, and this is what a kitchen does with it.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka kua leh sawmriat, he lehkhabu-a thil thlum man tlawm ber. Kolasib-ah balhla hmin lutuk chu tuman a duh loh avangin kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, hei hi chawthlengin chu a tih dan a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes in a wide pan.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Bel zau-ah minute sawmnga.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L pan and a jaggery pan with a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 bel zau leh silna nei kurtai bel. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, and cheapest in fur.
season.l: Kum tin, tin fur lai a man tlawm ber.

recipes.name: Sesame Laddu
recipes.sub: Sesame and jaggery balls
recipes.sub_l: Chhawhchhi leh kurtai bawm

method.en: Roast the sesame on a dry pan on a low flame, stirring constantly, until it pops steadily and turns a shade darker.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu bel ro-ah mei tlem berah kaihkawh reng chungin kang rawh.

method.en: Take it off the moment it smells. Sesame goes from roasted to burnt in about thirty seconds and burnt til is bitter right through.
method.l: A rim a chhuah veleh la chhuak rawh. Second 30 chhungin a kang zo thei.

method.en: Cool completely on a tray. Warm sesame added to syrup will not bind.
method.l: Tray-ah tidai fel rawh. A lum lai chuan a phum khawm lo.

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the water and oil and cook to the hard-ball stage — a drop in cold water should set firm and crack between the teeth.
method.l: Kurtai chu tui leh hriak nen tihral la, tui dai-ah a tla a nghet a, ha-a a keh thleng thlawp rawh.

method.en: That stage decides everything. Under-cooked syrup gives laddu that sag by evening; over-cooked gives laddu nobody can bite.
method.l: Chumi chuan zawng zawng a thlen. A min lo chuan a nem ang a, a min lutuk chuan a nghet lutuk ang.

method.en: Mix in the sesame and grated ginger and roll at once with oiled palms. The mixture sets hard within minutes and cannot be reheated.
method.l: Chhawhchhi leh sawhthing dah la, kutphah hriak nen nghal takin bawm rawh.

recipes.why: A month in a tin, no dairy at all, and warming — which is why it belongs to the cold months.
recipes.why_l: Bawm-ah thla khat. Hnute a tel lo. A tilum a ni.

start.en: Roast and cool the sesame ahead. Keeps a month in a tin.
start.l: Chhawhchhi chu kang la, tidai hmasa rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy pan and a wide kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bel rit leh bel zau. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: November to February, in the cold months.
season.l: November atanga February thleng.

recipes.name: Rice Laddu
recipes.sub: Roasted rice flour and jaggery balls
recipes.sub_l: Buh chhang kang leh kurtai bawm

method.en: Roast the rice flour in oil on a low flame for a full thirty minutes until it turns pale gold and smells nutty.
method.l: Buh chhang chu hriak-ah mei tlem berah minute 30 kang rawh.

method.en: Roast it properly. Under-roasted rice flour tastes raw right through the laddu and it will not keep three weeks.
method.l: Tha takin kang rawh. A kan lo chuan a rim a chhia a, chhun thum a awm lo vang.

method.en: Stir constantly. Rice flour is fine and catches on the bottom faster than any other flour in this book.
method.l: Kaihkawh reng rawh. Buh chhang chu a nal a, bel bulah a kai thruk.

method.en: Roast and crush the sesame separately and add it at the end so it stays crisp.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu hran hranin kang la, a tawpah dah rawh.

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the water and oil to a soft-ball stage and take it off the fire before the flour goes in.
method.l: Kurtai chu tihral la, chhang dah hmain mei atangin la chhuak rawh.

method.en: Mix and roll at once with oiled palms. The mixture stiffens fast and cannot be reheated.
method.l: Chhun la, kutphah hriak nen nghal takin bawm rawh.

recipes.why: Made from rice the kitchen already has, and three weeks in a tin. Roast the flour properly or do not make it.
recipes.why_l: Bel-a buh awm atanga siam a ni. Bawm-ah chhun thum.

start.en: Roast the flour ahead. Keeps three weeks in a tin.
start.l: Buh chhang chu kang hmasa rawh.

vessel.en: A wide kadhai and a large tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bel zau leh tray lian. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: All year.
season.l: Kum tin.

recipes.name: Ginger Jaggery Chikki
recipes.sub: Hard ginger and jaggery brittle
recipes.sub_l: Sawhthing leh kurtai nghet

method.en: Grease the trays and lay them out before beginning. Once the mixture is ready it sets in two minutes and there is no time to look for a tray.
method.l: Tan hmain tray chu hriak hnawih la, dah tha rawh.

method.en: Peel and grate the ginger fine, then squeeze the juice out and keep it. The juice goes into the syrup and the pulp goes in at the end.
method.l: Sawhthing chu hlip la, chhiat la, a tui hnawh chhuak la, dah rawh.

method.en: Grated ginger put in whole makes the chikki wet and it will not set hard. The juice carries the flavour and the pulp gives the bite.
method.l: Sawhthing chhiat a pum chuan a tui a, a nghet lo vang.

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the water, oil and ginger juice and cook to the hard-crack stage — a drop in cold water should set glassy and shatter, not bend.
method.l: Kurtai chu tui, hriak leh sawhthing tui nen tihral la, tui dai-ah a keh thleng thlawp rawh.

method.en: This is a harder stage than for a laddu. Under-cooked syrup gives a chikki that goes sticky in the tin within a week.
method.l: Laddu aiin a nghet zawk a ngai. A min lo chuan chhun khat chhungin a nal ang.

method.en: Mix in the sesame, peanut and ginger pulp, pour into the trays at once, level fast, and score into squares while still warm.
method.l: Chhawhchhi, badam leh sawhthing dah la, nghal takin tray-ah leih la, a lum lain at rawh.

recipes.why: A month in a tin and no dairy at all. Squeezing the ginger is what lets it set hard.
recipes.why_l: Bawm-ah thla khat. Sawhthing tui hnawh chhuah chuan a nghet thei.

start.en: Grease the trays before starting — it sets in two minutes.
start.l: Tan hmain tray-ah hriak hnawih rawh — minute 2-ah a nghet ta.

vessel.en: A wide kadhai and four greased trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bel zau leh tray hriak 4. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: November to February, in the dry cold months.
season.l: November atanga February thleng.

recipes.name: Sabu Laddu
recipes.sub: Millet roasted long in ghee and rolled with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Sabu chu ghee-ah rei tak kang a, kurtai nen a bal

method.en: Roast the sabu flour thirty minutes and not fifteen. This is the whole dish; under-roasted millet tastes raw and no jaggery covers it.
method.l: Sabu chhang chu minute sawmthum kang la, sawmpanga ni lo. Hei hi chaw pumpui a ni; kang tawk lo sabu chu a thing tui a nei a, kurtai chuan a thup thei lo.

method.en: The flame stays low the whole thirty minutes. A brown flour at fifteen minutes is a burnt flour and five kilos is thrown.
method.l: Minute sawmthum chhung zawngin mei chu tlem tur a ni. Minute sawmpanga chhang dum chu chhang kang a ni a, kilo nga chu paih a ni.

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately and strain it before it goes in. Field kurtai carries sand and grit in a laddu is what is remembered.
method.l: A luh hmain kurtai chu hrangin tifual la, sil rawh. Lo lam kurtai chuan sepaipui a keng a, laddu chhunga sepaipui chu hre reng tur a ni.

method.en: Roll them while the mix is still too hot for a bare hand. Cooled, millet and jaggery set into a slab that has to be broken with a ladle.
method.l: Kut ruak tan a lum lai takin bal rawh. A vawt chuan sabu leh kurtai chu chawpna hmanga tikek ngai bal khat a lo ni.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees fifty a head and it keeps a fortnight in a tin. Sabu grows on a Champhai jhum where rice will not, and kurtai is the only thing bought for it.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh sawmnga, tin tin-ah chawlhkar hnih a awm thei. Buh a chuah loh Champhai lo-ah sabu chu a chuang a, kurtai chauh chu a atana lei a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Two hours, and the rolling must be done warm.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Darkar hnih, tin bal chu a lum lai tih tur a ni.

vessel.en: A wide kadai, a jaggery pan and a strainer. Three cooks for the rolling.
vessel.l: Kadai zau, kurtai bel leh silna. Bal tur chawmi pathum.

season.en: Made in favang after the jhum harvest, kept three weeks.
season.l: Lo buh seng hnua favang lai-ah siam, chawlhkar thum dah a ni.

recipes.name: Vaimim Chikki
recipes.sub: Popped maize set in a hard jaggery syrup and cut in a tray
recipes.sub_l: Vaimim puak chu kurtai tui khauh-ah dah a, tray-ah a at

method.en: Take the syrup to the hard crack and test it in cold water. A soft syrup gives a chikki that bends and seven kilos of it sticks together in the tin.
method.l: Kurtai tui chu a khauh a kek thlengin chhum la, tui vawt-ah teh rawh. Tui nem chuan a kuai chikki a pe a, kilo sarih chu tin chhungah a inbet.

method.en: Warm the vaimim before it goes in the syrup. Cold maize drops the temperature of the syrup and it sets before it can be spread.
method.l: Kurtai tui-ah a luh hmain vaimim chu tilum rawh. Vaimim vawt chuan kurtai tui lumna chu a tihniam a, a hnawih hmain a khal.

method.en: Spread it on a greased stone and roll it thin at once. It sets in ninety seconds and a thick chikki cannot be bitten by anyone.
method.l: Ghee hnawih lung chungah hnawih la, chumi veleh sekin lan rawh. Second sawmkuain a khal a, chikki sang chu tuman a peh thei lo.

method.en: Score the squares while it is warm and break them when it is cold. Cut cold, seven kilos becomes a tray of shards.
method.l: A lum lai a kilkhawr chu ziah la, a vawt hunah kek rawh. A vawt lai at chuan kilo sarih chu tray khata kek chhuak a lo ni.

recipes.why: Seven rupees fifty a head and it keeps a month in a tin. Vaimim and kurtai are the two cheapest things a Mizo kitchen buys by the sack, and this is what they make together.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sarih leh sawmnga, tin tin-ah thla khat a awm thei. Vaimim leh kurtai chu Mizo chawthlengin ip-in a lei thil pahnih man tlawm ber a ni a, hei hi an siam khawm a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. An hour, and the spreading is a race.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Darkar khat, tin hnawih chu a rang tur a ni.

vessel.en: A syrup pan, a greased stone and a bowl of cold water. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Kurtai bel, ghee hnawih lung leh tui vawt kchu. Chawmi pathum.

season.en: Made in favang, kept a month.
season.l: Favang lai-ah siam, thla khat dah a ni.

recipes.name: Balhla Ur
recipes.sub: Ripe banana split and dried three days over a low fire
recipes.sub_l: Balhla hmin chu kap a, mei tlem chungah ni thum ur

method.en: Twenty kilos of ripe balhla gives four kilos of ur. A kitchen that does not know that dries twenty and expects eight.
method.l: Balhla hmin kilo sawmhnih chuan ur kilo li a pe. Chu hre lo chawthleng chuan sawmhnih a ur a, riat a beisei.

method.en: Split them along the length and never across. A cross-cut banana dries at the ends and stays wet at the middle for a week.
method.l: A sei zawnin kap la, a kang zawnin kap ngai lo. A kang zawna kap balhla chu a kam ah a ro a, chawlhkar khat chhung a laiah a hnawng reng.

method.en: Over a low fire and not in the sun. In fur an Aizawl sun cannot dry a banana and three days of it in the open grows mould instead.
method.l: Ni-ah ni lovin mei tlem chungah. Fur lai-ah Aizawl ni chuan balhla a ro-in a siam thei lo va, ni thum chhung pawnah dah chuan a duk zawk.

method.en: Brush them with jaggery water on the second day only. On the first day the fruit is too wet and on the third the coat will not dry.
method.l: Ni hnihnaah chauh kurtai tui hnawih rawh. Ni hmasa berah rah chu a hnawng lutuk a, ni thumnaah a hnawng chu a ro thei lo.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees ten a kilo and it keeps four months. In Kolasib the over-ripe balhla is fifteen rupees a kilo because nobody wants it, and drying it is how a thlasik counter has a sweet at all.
recipes.why_l: Kilo khatah tangka sawmpakhat leh pahnih leh sawm, tin thla li a awm thei. Kolasib-ah balhla hmin lutuk chu tuman a duh loh avangin kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, ur chu thlasik sem hnaih velah thil thlum awmna chhan a ni.

start.en: Three days over a low fire, brushed once on the second day.
start.l: Mei tlem chungah ni thum, ni hnihnaah vawi khat hnawih.

vessel.en: Drying racks over a low fire and a tin with a close lid. One cook, three days running.
vessel.l: Mei tlem chunga urna rack te leh khuhna nghet nei tin. Chawmi pakhat, ni thum chhung.

season.en: Made in fur when the balhla is cheapest.
season.l: Balhla man tlawm ber fur lai-ah siam a ni.

recipes.name: Passion Rah Titaura
recipes.sub: Passion pulp spread thin on a tray and dried to a sheet
recipes.sub_l: Passion hnim chu tray chungah sekin hnawih a, phen khat anga ur

method.en: Strain every seed out for a titaura. A seed in a dried sheet is a stone in the mouth and three kilos comes back to the counter.
method.l: Titaura atan chuan a chi zawng zawng chu sil chhuak rawh. Phen ur chhunga chi chu kaah lung a ni a, kilo thum chu sem hnaih velah a rawn kir.

method.en: Cook the pulp down to half before it is spread. Spread wet, it takes five days to dry and in fur it will not dry at all.
method.l: A hnawih hmain a hnim chu a chanve thlengin chhum rawh. Hnawng lai hnawih chuan ur ni nga a ngai a, fur lai-ah chuan a ro hrim hrim lo.

method.en: Spread it two millimetres thick and no more. A thick titaura is soft at the centre after three days and it moulds in the tin.
method.l: Millimetre hnih thut hnawih la, chu aia sang lo. Titaura sang chu ni thum hnuah a laiah a nem a, tin-ah a duk.

method.en: Turn the sheet on the second day. A titaura dried on one side curls up and cracks along every curl.
method.l: Ni hnihnaah phen chu letling rawh. Lam khat chauh ur titaura chu a inkual a, a inkual zawn tinah a kek.

recipes.why: Nineteen rupees ninety a kilo and it keeps six months. Passion grows over every Mamit fence and ten kilos of it costs the picking.
recipes.why_l: Kilo khatah tangka sawmpakhat leh kua leh sawmkua, tin thla ruk a awm thei. Mamit huan kulh tinah passion a chuang a, kilo sawm chu la man chauh a ni.

start.en: Cook the pulp down, spread and dry three days. Turn on the second.
start.l: A hnim chu chhum la, hnawih la, ni thum ur rawh. Ni hnihnaah letling rawh.

vessel.en: A heavy pan, a fine strainer and flat drying trays. One cook, three days running.
vessel.l: Bel rit, silna sang leh urna tray phen te. Chawmi pakhat, ni thum chhung.

season.en: Made in favang when the nights are dry.
season.l: Zan a ro hun favang lai-ah siam a ni.

recipes.name: Chhawhchhi Chikki
recipes.sub: White sesame set in a hard jaggery syrup and rolled thin
recipes.sub_l: Chhawhchhi var chu kurtai tui khauh-ah dah a, sekin a lan

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi until the seeds jump and take it off at once. Sesame past that point is bitter and three and a half kilos cannot be salvaged.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu a chi a chhuah thlengin kang la, chumi veleh la chhuak rawh. Chu aia kang chhawhchhi chu a khah a, kilo thum leh chanve chu chhandam theih a ni lo.

method.en: Take the syrup to the hard crack and test it in cold water. A soft syrup gives a chikki that bends and the whole tin sticks together.
method.l: Kurtai tui chu a khauh a kek thlengin chhum la, tui vawt-ah teh rawh. Tui nem chuan a kuai chikki a pe a, tin pumpui chu a inbet.

method.en: Warm the sesame before it goes in the syrup. Cold sesame drops the temperature of the syrup and it sets before it can be rolled.
method.l: Kurtai tui-ah a luh hmain chhawhchhi chu tilum rawh. Chhawhchhi vawt chuan kurtai tui lumna chu a tihniam a, a lan hmain a khal.

method.en: Roll it as thin as it will go. A chhawhchhi chikki two seeds thick breaks along the seed and one seed thick breaks anywhere.
method.l: A theih ang berin sekin lan rawh. Chhawhchhi chikki chi hnih thut chu chi zawnin a kek a, chi khat thut chu khawi lamah pawh a kek thei.

recipes.why: Ten rupees twenty a head and it keeps a month in a tin. Chhawhchhi grows on a Mizo jhum and kurtai is the only other thing bought for it.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmhnih, tin tin-ah thla khat a awm thei. Chhawhchhi chu Mizo lo-ah a chuang a, kurtai chauh chu a atana lei belh a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. An hour, and the rolling is a race.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Darkar khat, tin lan chu a rang tur a ni.

vessel.en: A dry pan, a syrup pan and a greased stone. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Bel ro, kurtai bel leh ghee hnawih lung. Chawmi pathum.

season.en: Made in favang after the harvest, kept a month.
season.l: Buh seng hnua favang lai-ah siam, thla khat dah a ni.

recipes.name: Bekang Bai Travel Dish
recipes.sub: Thick bai made for carrying
recipes.sub_l: Kalpui theih tur bai khauh

method.en: This is a bai made deliberately thick so that it survives a journey. A proper bai is thin and would separate on a bad road.
method.l: Hei hi kalpui theih tur a khauh taka siam bai a ni. Bai tak tak chu a tui a, kawng chhe-ah a inthen ang.

method.en: Leave the leafy greens out entirely. Greens go grey within an hour in a carrier and there is no way to prevent it.
method.l: Thlai hnah chu dah suh. Bawm chhungah darkar khat chhungin a dum ang.

method.en: Use root vegetables only — potato, taro and pumpkin. All three hold their shape for four hours.
method.l: Alu, dawl leh mai chauh hmang rawh. Pathum hian darkar li an chelh thei.

method.en: Fry the bekang in the oil with the ginger for five minutes before anything else goes in.
method.l: Bekang chu sawhthing nen hriak-ah minute 5 chhum hmasa rawh.

method.en: Use more oil than in a household bai. Oil is what protects a dish on a four-hour journey, and there is no dairy here to do it.
method.l: In chhunga bai aiin hriak tam zawk dah rawh.

method.en: Mash a third of the potato into the broth and carry it thicker than it should be. Thin it with hot water at the other end.
method.l: Alu a pathum zela pakhat chu nep la, khauh takin kalpui rawh. A hmun thlengin tui lum nen tiuain rawh.

recipes.why: No greens and no dairy, so there is nothing to go grey and nothing to split. Four hours and it arrives as it left.
recipes.why_l: Thlai hnah leh hnute a tel lo. Darkar li kal ta se a hlan ang bawkin a thleng ang.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bel zau 40 L. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: All year.
season.l: Kum tin.

recipes.name: Rajma Bai
recipes.sub: Kidney beans in a thick bai for catering
recipes.sub_l: Kalpui theih rajma bai

method.en: Soak the rajma overnight and throw the soaking water away.
method.l: Rajma chu zan khat dah la, a tui chu paih rawh.

method.en: Add the chhang to the cooking water. The alkali softens the skin and cuts the cooking time by about a third.
method.l: Thlawpna tui-ah chhang dah rawh. A hnah a tinawi a, a min hun a tihtlem.

method.en: Cook until a bean crushes to nothing between finger and thumb. Merely soft is not cooked, and undercooked rajma is what makes people uncomfortable afterwards.
method.l: Kutzung karah a chhia hlen thlengin thlawp rawh. A nawi mai chu a min tihna a ni lo.

method.en: Fry the bekang in the oil with the ginger for five minutes, then add the tomato and cook it right down.
method.l: Bekang chu sawhthing nen minute 5 chhum la, tomato dah la, thlawp fel rawh.

method.en: Mash a third of the beans against the side and stir them back. A catering gravy must be thick enough not to separate on a bad road.
method.l: Be a pathum zela pakhat chu bel kaah nep la, chhun leh rawh.

method.en: Carry it thicker than it should be and thin it with hot water at the other end. It is better the next day.
method.l: Khauh takin kalpui la, a hmun thlengin tui lum nen tiuain rawh.

recipes.why: Better the next day, holds four hours, and the chhang saves an hour of fuel on a bean this hard.
recipes.why_l: A tuk-ah a tha zawk. Chhang hian thing darkar khat a tihtlem.

start.en: Soak the rajma overnight. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: Rajma chu zan khat dah rawh.

vessel.en: A 40 L pressure vessel and a wide kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Pressure bel 40 L leh bel zau. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: All year. The catering dish that travels best.
season.l: Kum tin. Kalpui theih ber chaw a ni.

recipes.name: Mix Veg Chhum
recipes.sub: Mixed vegetables boiled dry for carrying
recipes.sub_l: Kalpui theih thlai chhum ro

method.en: Sort the vegetables into hard and soft before anything else, and cut everything to the same size.
method.l: Thlai chu khauh leh nem-ah then hmasa la, a inan takin at rawh.

method.en: Leave the leafy greens out. They go grey within an hour in a carrier and nothing prevents it.
method.l: Thlai hnah chu dah suh. Bawm chhungah darkar khat chhungin a dum ang.

method.en: Include taro in every batch. It breaks down and binds the dish, and without it a dry mixed vegetable falls apart in transit.
method.l: Dawl chu dah reng rawh. A chhia a, chaw a phum khawm.

method.en: Add the chhang with the hard vegetables only. It softens them and cuts the cooking time, and the soft ones do not need it.
method.l: Chhang chu thlai khauh nen chauh dah rawh.

method.en: Use more oil than in a household chhum. Oil is what protects a dry dish on a long journey.
method.l: In chhunga chhum aiin hriak tam zawk dah rawh.

method.en: Add no water at all, crumble the bekang in off the flame, and carry it dry.
method.l: Tui reng reng dah suh, bekang chu mei atanga la chhuah hnuah chal la, ro takin kalpui rawh.

recipes.why: No gravy to split, no greens to grey and no dairy to turn. It arrives as it left.
recipes.why_l: Inthen tur tui a awm lo, dum tur thlai hnah a awm lo, chhe tur hnute a awm lo.

start.en: Cut the vegetables an hour ahead, hard and soft kept apart.
start.l: Thlai chu darkar khat hmain at rawh.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bel zau 40 L. Chaw suk 2.

season.en: All year with whatever came in.
season.l: Kum tin, thil awm apiang nen.

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and cashew gravy, no onion and no garlic
recipes.sub_l: Paneer chu tomato leh kaju bai-ah, purun leh purunsen tel lo

method.en: Soak the cashew an hour and grind it with the tomato. The cashew does the whole job an onion base would do and there is no honest substitute cheaper than this.
method.l: Kaju chu darkar khat tui-ah dah la, tomato nen dengin. Kaju chuan purun bul hna thawh tur zawng zawng chu a thawk a, hei aia man tlawm thil dang dik a awm lo.

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the butter goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and a spoon of sugar only hides it for a minute.
method.l: Butter a luh hmain tomato bal chu minute sawmhnih leh nga chhum rawh. Chhum tawk lo tomato chu a thur a, sugar chawpna khat chuan minute khat chhung chauh a thup.

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Six kilos boiled in gravy is six kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: Sem hmain minute li chauhvin paneer chu a lut. Bai-a chhum kilo ruk chu sem hnaih velah rabar kilo ruk a ni.

method.en: Cream off the fire and stirred in from the side. Cream into a boiling gravy splits and twenty-eight litres cannot be brought back.
method.l: Cream chu mei aṭanga la chhuah hnuah a kam aṭangin chhawm luh rawh. Bai chhum lai-ah cream thlak chuan a inṭhen a, litre 28 chu hruai kir theih a ni lo.

recipes.why: Forty-two rupees ninety a head, the dearest dish in this book. Paneer, cashew, butter and cream all come up the road, so this is for a wedding and for Chapchar Kut and nothing else.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmli leh pahnih leh sawmkua, he lehkhabu-a chaw to ber. Paneer, kaju, butter leh cream zawng zawng chu kawng zawh chhuah a ni; chuvangin hei hi inneihna leh Chapchar Kut tan chauh a ni.

start.en: Cashew soaks an hour. Two hours in all.
start.l: Kaju chu darkar khat tui-ah a awm. A zawng zawngin darkar hnih.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, a grinder and a holding pot of warm salted water for the paneer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Litre 35 bel, denna leh paneer atan tui lum mluh nei bel. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: At Chapchar Kut, Janmashtami and a wedding.
season.l: Chapchar Kut, Janmashtami leh inneihna-ah.

recipes.name: Matar Paneer
recipes.sub: Paneer and green peas in a light tomato gravy
recipes.sub_l: Paneer leh matar hring chu tomato bai sek-ah

method.en: Peas in the last four minutes and never at the start. A pea cooked twenty minutes is grey and four kilos of grey peas is seen from the door.
method.l: Matar chu minute li hnuhnung berah, tir-ah ni lo. Minute sawmhnih chhum matar chu a vardum a, matar vardum kilo li chu kawngkhar aṭangin a lang.

method.en: Only six hundred grams of cashew here, not the kilo a butter masala takes. A matar paneer should be thin enough to see the peas through.
method.l: Hetah kaju gram 600 chauh, butter masala-a kilo khat chu ni lo. Matar paneer chu matar a chhungthlir theih khawpin sek tur a ni.

method.en: Hold the cut paneer in warm salted water until the gravy is ready. Left dry on a tray four kilos hardens at the edges within the hour.
method.l: Bai a tling hma chuan paneer at chu tui lum mluh nei-ah dah rawh. Tray chunga ro-in dah chuan darkar khat chhungin kilo li chu a kam a khauh.

method.en: Take the vessel off before the paneer has been in five minutes. It goes on cooking in the gravy all the way to the hall.
method.l: Paneer a luh minute nga a tling hmain bel chu la chhuak rawh. In a thleng thlengin bai chhungah a chhum reng.

recipes.why: Thirty-six rupees fifty a head. It is the guest dish a kitchen makes when a butter masala is beyond the day's money, and four kilos of peas does the work of two of paneer.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmthum leh ruk leh sawmnga. Ni chhung sum-in butter masala a phak loh hunah chawthlengin mikhual atan a siam chaw chu hei a ni a, matar kilo li chuan paneer kilo hnih hna chu a thawk.

start.en: Cashew soaks half an hour. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: Kaju chu darkar chanve tui-ah a awm. A zawng zawngin minute sawmkua.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, a grinder and a holding pot for the paneer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Litre 35 bel, denna leh paneer dahna bel. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Favang to thlasik for the fresh pea; frozen the rest of the year.
season.l: Matar thar atan favang aṭanga thlasik thleng; kum a dang chhung chu vawt dah.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.sub: White chana cooked soft with tea leaf for colour and amchur for sour
recipes.sub_l: Chana var chu rawng atan thingpui hnah, thurna atan amchur nen a chhum

method.en: Tie forty grams of tea leaf in a cloth and boil it with the chana. It is the whole colour of a chana masala and it costs four rupees.
method.l: Thingpui hnah gram 40 chu puan-ah phuar la, chana nen chhum rawh. Chu chu chana masala rawng pumpui a ni a, tangka li a senso.

method.en: Soak them twelve hours and cook them in the soaking water with the cloth in it. Fresh water gives a pale vessel however much tea is used.
method.l: Darkar sawmpakhat leh pahnih tui-ah dah la, puan nen a dahna tui-ah ngei chhum rawh. Tui thar chuan thingpui engzat hman pawh ni se bel eng lo a pe.

method.en: Amchur and not lemon. Lemon in a chana masala goes flat within the hour; amchur holds the sourness until the vessel is empty.
method.l: Amchur, serthlum ni lo. Chana masala chhunga serthlum chu darkar khatah a tlem a; amchur chuan bel a ruak thlengin a thurna a vawn.

method.en: Salt only after the chana is soft. Salted early it hardens and no amount of time on the fire brings it back.
method.l: Chana a nem hnu chauhvin mluh thlak rawh. Hmain mluh thlak chuan a khauh a, mei chunga hun engzat pawhin a rawn hruai kir thei lo.

recipes.why: Twenty-one rupees fifty a head. Chana is the cheapest thing on this shelf that a north Indian guest recognises, and five kilos holds a hall to the evening.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmhnih leh pakhat leh sawmnga. Chana chu Bharat hmar lam mikhualin a hriat thil, he thlaite-a man tlawm ber a ni a, kilo nga chuan tlai thlengin in chhung a vawn.

start.en: Chana soaks twelve hours and cooks two. Start the evening before.
start.l: Chana chu darkar sawmpakhat leh pahnih tui-ah a awm a, darkar hnih a chhum. A ni hmaa tlaiah tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid and a muslin cloth for the tea. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 40 bel leh thingpui phuarna puan sang. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: All year, on a guest day.
season.l: Kum tin, mikhual lo kal ni-ah.

recipes.name: Alu Phulkobi
recipes.sub: Potato and cauliflower in a light gravy with cumin
recipes.sub_l: Alu leh phulkobi chu jeera nen bai sek-ah

method.en: The alu goes in twelve minutes before the phulkobi. Started together, the cauliflower is pulp while the potato is still raw in the middle.
method.l: Phulkobi a luh hmain alu chu minute sawmhnih a lut. Khawmin tan chuan alu chu a laiah a thing lai phulkobi chu bal a lo ni.

method.en: Soak the florets ten minutes in salted water first. There is more in a thlasik cauliflower than cauliflower.
method.l: Hmasa berin a par te chu tui mluh nei-ah minute sawm dah rawh. Thlasik phulkobi chhungah phulkobi ni lo thil dang a awm.

method.en: Keep it just wet and no more. This is not a bai; the gravy should cling to the pieces and not stand around them.
method.l: A hnawng vak vak chauhvin dah la, chu aia tam lo. Hei hi bai a ni lo; bai chu a tlangte-ah bet tur a ni a, an velah awm tur a ni lo.

method.en: Take it off while a floret still holds. Both cook for ten minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a mash in the hall.
method.l: A par a khauh reng lai la chhuak rawh. Mei a mit hnuah a pahnihin minute sawm an chhum a, chawthlengah a dik chu in chhungah bal a lo ni.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees ninety a head, and it is the guest dish for a thlasik day when no paneer has come up the road. Seven kilos each fills twenty-eight litres.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpali leh sawmkua, tin kawng zawha paneer a lo thleng loh thlasik ni-a mikhual chaw a ni. Kilo sarih chuan litre 28 a khat.

start.en: Florets soak ten minutes. An hour in all.
start.l: A par te chu minute sawm tui-ah a awm. A zawng zawngin darkar khat.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel and a soaking tray. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 35 bel leh dahna tray. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, while the phulkobi is in the market.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, phulkobi bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Malai Kofta
recipes.sub: Paneer and gram flour balls dropped into a cashew gravy
recipes.sub_l: Paneer leh besan bal te chu kaju bai-ah a thlak

method.en: Grate the paneer and knead it with the besan until it takes a ball without a crack. A cracked kofta opens in the ghee and five kilos of paneer is in the kadai.
method.l: Paneer chu thlur la, a kek lova bal a nih thlengin besan nen chher rawh. Kofta kek chu ghee-ah a hawng a, paneer kilo nga chu kadai chhungah a awm.

method.en: Fry the kofta on a medium flame and never hot. A hot ghee browns the outside while the besan inside is still raw.
method.l: Kofta chu mei tlangpui chungah chhum la, lum takah chhum ngai lo. Ghee lum chuan a chhunga besan a thing lai a pawn lam chu a tidum.

method.en: The kofta go into the gravy at the counter and not in the kitchen. Five minutes in the vessel and they are gone; there is nothing left to serve.
method.l: Kofta chu chawthlengah ni lovin sem hnaih velah bai-ah a lut. Bel chhungah minute nga awm chuan an bo a; sem tur engmah a awm tawh lo.

method.en: Cream off the fire. Cream into a boiling gravy splits and twenty-six litres of it cannot be brought back.
method.l: Cream chu mei aṭanga la chhuah hnuah. Bai chhum lai-ah cream thlak chuan a inṭhen a, litre 26 chu hruai kir theih a ni lo.

recipes.why: Forty-one rupees fifty a head. It is the one dish in this book that needs a cook standing at a kadai for an hour, and a Mizo wedding is the only day that hour is available.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmli leh pakhat leh sawmnga. Hei hi he lehkhabu-a chawmi pakhat darkar khat kadai bulah ding a ngaih chaw pakhat chu a ni a, chu darkar khat awm theih ni chu Mizo inneihna chauh a ni.

start.en: Cashew soaks an hour. Two and a half hours in all.
start.l: Kaju chu darkar khat tui-ah a awm. A zawng zawngin darkar hnih leh chanve.

vessel.en: A deep kadai, a 35 L gravy vessel and a grinder. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Kadai thuk, bai atan litre 35 bel leh denna. Chawmi pathum.

season.en: At a wedding and at Chapchar Kut.
season.l: Inneihna leh Chapchar Kut-ah.

recipes.name: Zawngtah Bai
recipes.sub: Stink bean boiled with soda and greens, no dairy
recipes.sub_l: Zawngtah leh an hnah bai, hnute tel lo

method.en: Split each zawngtah pod and take the beans out whole. Cut across, they go to pieces in the pot.
method.l: Zawngtah chu that la, a rah chu a pum in la chhuak rawh.

method.en: A bai is boiled with a pinch of chingal — soda — which is what keeps the greens green and softens the bean. Too much and it tastes of soap.
method.l: Bai hi chingal tlem tea thlawp a ni. A tam lutuk chuan a tui lo.

method.en: Put the pumpkin in first, then the beans, then the greens for the last four minutes.
method.l: Mai hmasa in dah la, zawngtah, tin a tawpah antam hnah dah rawh.

method.en: Add the oil raw at the end. There is nothing else in a bai — no milk, no ghee, and in this one no bekang either.
method.l: A tawpah hriak thleng dah rawh. Bai-ah engmah dang a awm lo.

recipes.why: Zawngtah is what a Champhai household waits for from February, and a bai made with it needs nothing else on the plate but rice. It is dairy-free the way every Mizo dish is dairy-free — by never having had any.
recipes.why_l: February atangin Champhai khuain zawngtah an nghah thin. Buh chauh nen a tawk tawh.

start.en: Shell the zawngtah an hour ahead. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Darkar khat hmain zawngtah chhuak rawh. Sem hma minute 50 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 50 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 50 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: February to May, while the zawngtah is in.
season.l: February atanga May thleng.

recipes.name: Behliang Bai
recipes.sub: Long beans and pumpkin leaf boiled together
recipes.sub_l: Behliang leh mai hnah bai

method.en: Snap the beans by hand into finger lengths rather than cutting them.
method.l: Behliang chu chem hmang lovin kut hmangin khoih rawh.

method.en: Take only the top four pumpkin leaves and strip the tough vein off each.
method.l: Mai hnah a tir lam pali chauh la, a hri chu hlip rawh.

method.en: Boil the beans in salted water with the soda and a handful of raw rice — the rice is what thickens a bai; there is no flour in it.
method.l: Behliang chu chingal leh buhchhang tlem nen thlawp rawh. Bai tibet tu chu buhchhang a ni.

method.en: Add the leaves for the last three minutes and the oil off the fire.
method.l: A tawp minute thum-ah hnah dah la, mei atanga la chhuah hnuah hriak dah rawh.

recipes.why: Behliang climbs the maize in every jhum field, and the pumpkin leaf is picked from the same plot on the way back. A vessel that feeds a hundred here costs less than a kilo of paneer would, and there is no dairy in it anywhere.
recipes.why_l: Behliang hi lo tinah a chhuak a, mai hnah pawh chutah chiah a awm. Bel khat chuan mi za a chhawp thei.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start forty-five minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Sem hma minute 45 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 50 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 50 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: June to October, through the jhum harvest.
season.l: June atanga October thleng.

recipes.name: Vaimim Bai
recipes.sub: Sweet corn and beans, boiled thick
recipes.sub_l: Vaimim leh be bai chal

method.en: Boil the rice beans first with the soda; they take four times as long as the corn.
method.l: Be chu chingal nen thlawp hmasa rawh, a rei zawk a ni.

method.en: Scrape half the corn off the cob and grate the other half — the grated half thickens the bai.
method.l: Vaimim a chanve chu at la, a chanve chu chhiat rawh. Chhiat chuan bai a tibet.

method.en: Add the pumpkin and boil until it falls.
method.l: Mai dah la, a ruah thleng thlawp rawh.

method.en: Finish with the chilli, salt and raw oil. Corn boiled with any dairy in the pot turns; there is none here and none wanted.
method.l: A tawpah hmarcha, chi leh hriak thleng dah rawh.

recipes.why: For three months after the jhum harvest there is more corn in Lunglei than anyone can eat, and this is where the surplus goes. It is the sweetest bai in the book and costs almost nothing in that season.
recipes.why_l: Lo neih hnu thla thum chhung Lunglei-ah vaimim a tam hle. Chumi hun chuan a man a tlawm ber.

start.en: Soak the rice beans overnight. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: Be chu zan khat tuiah dah rawh. Sem hma minute 80 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 50 L vessel and a grater. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bel 50 L leh chhiat na. Chaw suk pahnih.

season.en: August to October only, while the corn is fresh.
season.l: August atanga October thleng chauh.

recipes.name: Antam Chhawhchhi
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves cooked dry and turned through with roasted sesame
recipes.sub_l: Antam hnah chu ro-in chhum a, chhawhchhi kang nen a chhawm

method.en: No water at all. Twelve kilos of antam gives up two litres in the first four minutes and that is all the kadai needs.
method.l: Tui a awm hrim hrim lo. Antam kilo 12 chuan minute li hmasa berah litre hnih a pe a, chu chu kadai mamawh zawng zawng a ni.

method.en: Cut the stalk in and do not throw it. The stalk is a third of the weight and it goes in eight minutes before the leaf.
method.l: A kung chu at luh la, paih suh. A kung chu a rit a thum chhinga pakhat a ni a, a hnah hmain minute riat a lut.

method.en: Eight minutes on the leaf and no more. Antam cooked twenty minutes is the colour of a wet road and sixteen kilos of it comes back.
method.l: A hnah chungah minute riat chauh, chu aia rei lo. Minute sawmhnih chhung chhum antam chu kawng hnawng rawng a ni a, kilo 16 chu a rawn kir.

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi and crush it in at the end. It is the fat of this dish and there is no ghee and no curd anywhere in it.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu kang la, a tawpah dengin thlak rawh. Chu chu he chaw hriak a ni a, khawi hmunah mah ghee leh hnute a awm lo.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees fifty a head, no dairy and no ghee. In thlasik the antam is fifteen rupees a kilo at Bara Bazar and the sesame is the only other thing bought.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh sawmnga, hnute leh ghee tel lo. Thlasik lai-ah antam chu Bara Bazar-ah kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, chhawhchhi chauh chu lei belh a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, in two batches.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, vawi hnihin.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 kadai zau, khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, while the antam is in the market.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, antam bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Iskut Chhawhchhi
recipes.sub: Chayote and its leaf cooked dry with sesame and no dairy
recipes.sub_l: Iskut leh a hnah chu chhawhchhi nen ro-in chhum, hnute tel lo

method.en: The leaf goes in and it is not a garnish. Two kilos of iskut hnah is half the taste of this kadai and a kitchen that throws it is throwing the dish.
method.l: A hnah chu a lut a, chawhnawmna a ni lo. Iskut hnah kilo hnih chu he kadai tui a chanve a ni a, chu paih chawthleng chuan chaw ngei chu a paih a ni.

method.en: Peel it only if the skin is rough. A young iskut skin is thinner than a mai and peeling twelve kilos of it wastes an hour and a kilo.
method.l: A hnawng a chhia chauh chuan hlip rawh. Iskut naupang hnawng chu mai aiin a sek zawk a, kilo 12 hlip chuan darkar khat leh kilo khat a bo.

method.en: No water and no lid. Twelve kilos under a lid steams and a steamed iskut is a bowl of water with skins in it.
method.l: Tui leh khuhna a awm lo. Khuh chuan kilo 12 chu a chhum a, iskut chhum chuan hnawng nei tui kchu a lo ni.

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi and crush it in at the end. It is the fat of this vessel and there is no dairy anywhere in it.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu kang la, a tawpah dengin thlak rawh. Chu chu he bel hriak a ni a, khawi hmunah mah hnute a awm lo.

recipes.why: Nine rupees eighty a head, no dairy at all. An iskut vine on a Serchhip fence gives fruit and leaf for eight months and nobody plants it twice.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka kua leh sawmriat, hnute a awm hrim hrim lo. Serchhip huan kulh chunga iskut hrui chuan thla riat chhung rah leh hnah a pe a, tuman vawi hnih a chin lo.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, and the leaf is chopped while the iskut cooks.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmnga, tin iskut a chhum lai a hnah chu at a ni.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 kadai zau, khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Fur to thlasik, off the fence behind the kitchen.
season.l: Fur aṭanga thlasik thleng, chawthleng hnung lam kulh aṭangin.

recipes.name: Rawtuai Bekang
recipes.sub: Fresh bamboo shoot cooked dry and finished with fermented soybean
recipes.sub_l: Rawtuai thar chu ro-in chhum a, bekang nen a tihrem

method.en: Boil the rawtuai once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sharpness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: Rawtuai chu tui ngaihngai-ah vawi khat chhum la, chu tui chu paih rawh. Tui hmasa ber chuan lei tihrual thei khauhna chu a keng.

method.en: The bekang goes in with the fire off. Boiled twenty minutes it loses the smell it is bought for and becomes an ordinary bean.
method.l: Bekang chu mei mit hnuah a lut. Minute sawmhnih chhum chuan a lei chhan rim chu a hloh a, be ngaihngai a lo ni.

method.en: Cook it uncovered from the moment the bekang goes in. Under a lid a kilo and a half of it will empty a hall.
method.l: Bekang a luh atang chuan khuh lovin chhum rawh. Khuh chuan kilo khat leh chanve chuan in khat a tihruak thei.

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. A bekang is salted in the jar and a hundred and sixty grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: Mluh a luh hmain tem rawh. Bekang chu bel chhungah mluh thlak tawh a ni a, gram 160 chu bel engemaw zat tan a tam tawh.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees fifty a head, no dairy at all. In fur the shoot comes off the Champhai hill for the cutting and a kilo and a half of bekang carries ten kilos of it.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpathum leh sawmnga, hnute a awm hrim hrim lo. Fur lai-ah rawtuai chu Champhai tlang aṭangin at man chauhvin a lo chhuak a, bekang kilo khat leh chanve chuan kilo sawm a phur.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, most of it boiling the shoot.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmkua, a tam zawk chu rawtuai chhum a ni.

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chhum nan bel leh litre 30 kadai zau, khuh lo. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: Fur to favang, while the fresh shoot is on the hill.
season.l: Fur aṭanga favang thleng, rawtuai thar tlang-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Maian Chhum
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo squeezed dry and cooked with potato, no dairy
recipes.sub_l: Maian chhir ro chu alu nen a chhum, hnute tel lo

method.en: Squeeze the maian dry and keep two cups of the liquor back. The liquor is the whole sourness and the squeezing is what stops it being too much.
method.l: Maian chu ro-in chhir la, a tui kchu hnih chu vawng rawh. A tui chu thurna pumpui a ni a, chhir chuan a tam lutuk lo turin a vawn.

method.en: The maian goes in first and the alu after ten minutes. A potato in maian liquor from the start hardens and stays hard however long the kadai is on the fire.
method.l: Maian chu hmasain a lut a, alu chu minute sawm hnuah. Tir aṭanga maian tui-a alu chuan a khauh a, kadai chu mei chungah rei ang pawh ni se a khauh reng.

method.en: Cook it uncovered the first ten minutes. Under a lid the smell of four kilos of maian stays in it and comes out at the counter all at once.
method.l: Minute sawm hmasa berah khuh lovin chhum rawh. Khuh chuan maian kilo li rim chu a chhungah a awm a, sem hnaih velah vawi khatin a chhuak.

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. A maian from Champhai is salted in the jar and a hundred and seventy grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: Mluh a luh hmain tem rawh. Champhai maian chu bel chhungah mluh thlak tawh a ni a, gram 170 chu bel engemaw zat tan a tam tawh.

recipes.why: Ten rupees eighty a head, no dairy at all. Four kilos of maian out of a jar put down in fur is what gives an Aizawl kitchen a dish in thlasik when there is nothing green in the market.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmriat, hnute a awm hrim hrim lo. Fur lai-a dah bel aṭanga maian kilo li chuan bazar-ah thlai hring engmah awm loh thlasik lai-ah Aizawl chawthleng chu chaw a pe.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, and the maian is squeezed first.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmnga, tin hmasa berin maian chu chhir a ni.

vessel.en: A squeezing cloth and a wide 30 L kadai, uncovered at the start. One cook.
vessel.l: Chhirna puan leh litre 30 kadai zau, a tirah khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, out of the jar put down in fur.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, fur lai-a dah bel aṭangin.

recipes.name: Mai Chhawhchhi
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked down thin and finished with crushed sesame
recipes.sub_l: Mai chu sekin chhum a, chhawhchhi deng nen a tihrem

method.en: Roast the chhawhchhi until the seeds jump and crush it coarse. It is the whole fat of this vessel and there is no dairy anywhere in it.
method.l: Chhawhchhi chu a chi a chhuah thlengin kang la, sang zawkin dengin. Chu chu he bel hriak pumpui a ni a, khawi hmunah mah hnute a awm lo.

method.en: Half the sesame goes in at the start and half at the end. The first half thickens the vessel and the second is the smell that reaches the hall.
method.l: Chhawhchhi a chanve chu a tirah a lut a, a chanve chu a tawpah. A chanve hmasa chuan bel a tisang a, a pahnihna chu in a thleng rim a ni.

method.en: Keep the skin on if it is a jhum mai. The skin is what stops twelve kilos collapsing into a single orange mass.
method.l: Lo lam mai a nih chuan a hnawng chu dah rawh. Kilo 12 chu bal sen khat lo nih atangin a humhim chu a hnawng a ni.

method.en: Keep it thin. This is a vessel that is drunk off the plate at the end of the meal and a thick one is a mash.
method.l: Sekin dah rawh. Hei hi chaw tawpah thlengbel aṭanga in tur bel a ni a, a sang chuan bal a lo ni.

recipes.why: Eight rupees sixty a head, the cheapest vegan dish on this shelf. In favang a Mamit jhum gives twelve kilos for the carrying and the sesame is the only thing bought.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka riat leh sawmruk, he thlaite-a vegan chaw man tlawm ber. Favang lai-ah Mamit lo chuan phurhna man chauhvin kilo 12 a pe a, chhawhchhi chauh chu lei a ni.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Thu vawt aṭangin minute sawmli.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel with a lid and a dry pan for the sesame. One cook.
vessel.l: Khuhna nei litre 35 bel leh chhawhchhi atan bel ro. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thlasik, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thlasik thleng, lo aṭangin, chumi hnuah thil dahna aṭangin.

recipes.name: Jain Mai Bai
recipes.sub: Pumpkin bai with no bekang, no bamboo shoot and no tuber
recipes.sub_l: Bekang, rawtuai leh bal tel lo mai bai

method.en: A bai is normally seasoned with bekang. Nothing fermented goes into this one; asafoetida in the oil does the work instead.
method.l: Bai hi bekang nen an siam thin. Hetah bekang a awm lo, hing a ni.

method.en: Boil the soaked peas with the soda until they give.
method.l: Be sen chu chingal nen a nem thleng thlawp rawh.

method.en: Add the pumpkin and the handful of raw rice and boil until half the pumpkin has dissolved.
method.l: Mai leh buhchhang dah la, mai chanve a ruah thleng thlawp rawh.

method.en: Put the leaves in for the last three minutes and the oil with the asafoetida off the fire.
method.l: A tawp minute thum-ah hnah dah la, mei chhuah hnuah hing nen hriak dah rawh.

recipes.why: Every other bai in this book has bekang, rawtuai or a boiled tuber in it, and a Jain guest can take none of the three. Pumpkin, peas and a handful of rice make the same thick vessel, and the pumpkin grows on a vine.
recipes.why_l: Bai dang zawng zawngah bekang, rawtuai emaw bal a awm. Hetah chuan mai, be leh buhchhang chauh a ni.

start.en: Soak the peas overnight. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Be sen chu zan khat tuiah dah rawh. Sem hma minute 70 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 50 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 50 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year. Pumpkin keeps two months whole.
season.l: Kum tin. Mai chu thla hnih a awm thei.

recipes.name: Jain Iskut Chhum
recipes.sub: Chayote steamed with chilli, without ginger or ferment
recipes.sub_l: Sawhthing leh bekang tel lo iskut chhum

method.en: Peel the iskut under running water; the sap dries hard on the hands.
method.l: Iskut chu tui hnuaiah hlip rawh, a tui chu kutah a bet thin.

method.en: Steam the cubes with the shoots and salt in a covered vessel with almost no water.
method.l: Iskut leh a hnah chu tui tlemte nen khuh chungin chhum rawh.

method.en: A chhum is plain by design — nothing is fried and nothing is fermented. The asafoetida goes into the oil and the oil goes in raw at the end.
method.l: Chhum hi a mawl a ni. Hing chu hriak-ah dah la, a tawpah thleng rawh.

method.en: Crush the chillies in by hand with the pepper just before serving.
method.l: Sem hma chauhah hmarcha leh hmarcha dum kutin ti rawh.

recipes.why: A chhum is the plainest thing on a Mizo table and the version everyone knows is boiled tubers with chilli salt. Iskut grows on a vine over every porch in Serchhip and gives the same dish without anything from under the ground.
recipes.why_l: Chhum hi Mizo chaw mawl ber a ni. Bal ai chuan iskut a ni, leilung hnuai atanga chhuak a awm lo.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tuiah dah a ngai lo. Sem hma minute 40 in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel with a tight lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 30 L, a khuhna nen. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year. Cheapest from August to December.
season.l: Kum tin. August atanga December thleng a man a tlawm.

recipes.name: Jain Bepui Bai
recipes.sub: Kidney beans boiled thick, no ferment and no root
recipes.sub_l: Bekang leh bal tel lo bepui bai

method.en: Soak the beans twelve hours and boil them in the same water with the soda until the skins split.
method.l: Bepui chu darkar 12 tuiah dah la, chingal nen a chhun a khe thleng thlawp rawh.

method.en: Add the pumpkin and cook until it falls and thickens the pot. There is no flour and no tuber doing this.
method.l: Mai dah la, a ruah a bai a chal thleng thlawp rawh.

method.en: Put the greens in for the last three minutes.
method.l: A tawp minute thum-ah antam hnah dah rawh.

method.en: Fry the asafoetida in the oil and pour it in off the fire. Where a Mizo cook would put bekang, this puts hing.
method.l: Hriak-ah hing chhen la, mei chhuah hnuah thleng rawh.

recipes.why: Bepui bai is the most filling vessel in this book and the usual pot is seasoned with bekang, which a Jain guest will not take. Asafoetida gives the same savour, and everything else in the pot grew above the ground.
recipes.why_l: Bepui bai hi bel chak ber a ni. Bekang ai chuan hing a ni, a dang zawng zawng chu leilung chungah a chhuak.

start.en: Soak the beans twelve hours. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: Bepui chu darkar 12 tuiah dah rawh. Sem hma darkar hnih leh chanve in tan rawh.

vessel.en: A 60 L pressure vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bel 60 L. Chaw suk pakhat.

season.en: All year. The beans store dry for a year.
season.l: Kum tin. Bepui chu kum khat a awm thei.

recipes.name: Jain Rawtuai Chhum
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot cooked dry with dry ginger and asafoetida, no root
recipes.sub_l: Rawtuai chu sawhthing vut leh hing nen ro-in chhum, lei chhung thlai tel lo

method.en: Boil the rawtuai once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sharpness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: Rawtuai chu tui ngaihngai-ah vawi khat chhum la, chu tui chu paih rawh. Tui hmasa ber chuan lei tihrual thei khauhna chu a keng.

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, and it is a hundred grams and not three hundred. Dry ginger is four times the strength and a Jain plate is ruined by a heavy hand.
method.l: Sawhthing vut, sawhthing thar ni lo; tin gram 100 a ni a, gram 300 ni lo. Sawhthing vut chu vawi li a nghet a, kut rit chuan Jain thlengbel chu a tichhia.
