method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering and a pinch is enough. In a Jain kadai it is the only thing standing where an onion would.
method.l: Tihremna-ah hing, tin tlemte a tawk. Jain kadai-ah chuan purun awmna hmun ah ding chu chu chauh a ni.

method.en: No water and no lid after the boiling. Under a lid ten kilos steams and a steamed rawtuai is a wet thing nobody will eat.
method.l: Chhum hnuah tui leh khuhna a awm lo. Khuh chuan kilo sawm chu a chhum a, rawtuai chhum chuan tuman an ei duh loh thil hnawng a lo ni.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees ninety a head. In fur the shoot comes off the Champhai hill for the cutting, and there is no root anywhere in it, so a Jain guest eats the same tray as the hall.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh pakhat leh sawmkua. Fur lai-ah rawtuai chu Champhai tlang aṭangin at man chauhvin a lo chhuak a, a chhungah lei chhung thlai a awm lo; chuvangin Jain mikhual chuan in chhung nen tray khat an ei.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, most of it boiling the shoot.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmkua, a tam zawk chu rawtuai chhum a ni.

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a wide 30 L kadai. One cook.
vessel.l: Chhum nan bel leh litre 30 kadai zau. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Fur to favang, while the fresh shoot is on the hill.
season.l: Fur aṭanga favang thleng, rawtuai thar tlang-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Jain Antam Chhum
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves cooked dry with asafoetida and dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: Antam hnah chu hing leh sawhthing vut nen ro-in a chhum

method.en: No water at all. Twelve kilos of antam gives up two litres in the first four minutes and that is all the kadai needs.
method.l: Tui a awm hrim hrim lo. Antam kilo 12 chuan minute li hmasa berah litre hnih a pe a, chu chu kadai mamawh zawng zawng a ni.

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, and ninety grams is the measure. Any more and a Jain plate tastes of medicine.
method.l: Sawhthing vut, sawhthing thar ni lo; tin gram 90 chu teh nihna a ni. Chu aia tam chuan Jain thlengbel chu damdawi angin a tui.

method.en: Cut the stalk in and do not throw it. The stalk is a third of the weight and it goes in eight minutes before the leaf.
method.l: A kung chu at luh la, paih suh. A kung chu a rit a thum chhinga pakhat a ni a, a hnah hmain minute riat a lut.

method.en: Eight minutes on the leaf and no more. Antam cooked twenty minutes is the colour of a wet road and sixteen kilos of it comes back.
method.l: A hnah chungah minute riat chauh, chu aia rei lo. Minute sawmhnih chhung chhum antam chu kawng hnawng rawng a ni a, kilo 16 chu a rawn kir.

recipes.why: Ten rupees eighty a head. In thlasik the antam is fifteen rupees a kilo at Bara Bazar and there is no root and no fresh ginger anywhere in it.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawm leh sawmriat. Thlasik lai-ah antam chu Bara Bazar-ah kilo khat tangka sawmnga a ni a, a chhungah lei chhung thlai leh sawhthing thar a awm lo.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, in two batches.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, vawi hnihin.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 kadai zau, khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, while the antam is in the market.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, antam bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Jain Tomato Bai
recipes.sub: Tomato cooked thin with roasted rice flour and dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: Tomato chu buh chhang kang leh sawhthing vut nen sekin a chhum

method.en: Roast the tomato on the flame and peel it. The skin in a bai rolls up into strings and every devotee finds one.
method.l: Tomato chu mei chungah kang la, a hnawng hlip rawh. Bai chhunga hnawng chu a inkual a, mi tinin pakhat an hmu.

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, a hundred grams in twenty-six litres. It is four times the strength of the fresh root.
method.l: Sawhthing vut, sawhthing thar ni lo; litre 26-ah gram 100. Sawhthing thar aiin vawi li a nghet.

method.en: Mix the rice flour to a slurry in cold water before it goes in. Thrown in dry, four hundred grams becomes forty lumps.
method.l: A luh hmain buh chhang chu tui vawt-ah chhawm tifual rawh. Ro-in thlak chuan gram 400 chu bal sawmli a lo ni.

method.en: Keep it thin. A tomato bai is drunk off the plate at the end of the meal and a thick one is a chartawk in the wrong vessel.
method.l: Sekin dah rawh. Tomato bai chu chaw tawpah thlengbel aṭangin in a ni a, a sang chuan bel dik lo chhunga chartawk a ni.

recipes.why: Nine rupees eighty a head. Tomato is at Bara Bazar every month of the year and there is no root and no fresh ginger anywhere in it, so a Jain guest is not given a separate plate.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka kua leh sawmriat. Kum chhung thla tinah Bara Bazar-ah tomato a awm a, a chhungah lei chhung thlai leh sawhthing thar a awm lo; chuvangin Jain mikhual hnenah thlengbel hrang pek a ni lo.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, most of it roasting and peeling.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmnga, a tam zawk chu kang leh hlip a ni.

vessel.en: An open flame for the roasting and a 35 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Kang nan mei hawng leh litre 35 bel. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: All year, and cheapest in favang.
season.l: Kum tin, tin favang lai a man tlawm ber.

recipes.name: Jain Bandari Chhum
recipes.sub: Cabbage and peas cooked dry with asafoetida and no root
recipes.sub_l: Bandari leh matar chu hing nen ro-in chhum, lei chhung thlai tel lo

method.en: No water at any point. Twelve kilos of bandari gives up three litres in the first ten minutes and that is all it needs.
method.l: Khawi hun mahah tui a awm lo. Bandari kilo 12 chuan minute sawm hmasa berah litre thum a pe a, chu chu a mamawh zawng zawng a ni.

method.en: The peas go in with the fire off. Cooked twenty minutes they are grey and two kilos of grey peas is seen from the door.
method.l: Matar chu mei mit hnuah a lut. Minute sawmhnih chhum chuan a vardum a, matar vardum kilo hnih chu kawngkhar aṭangin a lang.

method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering, sixty grams in eighteen kilos. In a Jain kadai it is the only thing standing where an onion would.
method.l: Tihremna-ah hing, kilo 18-ah gram 60. Jain kadai-ah chuan purun awmna hmun ah ding chu chu chauh a ni.

method.en: Take it off while a shred still snaps. A cabbage cooked through is grey and eighteen kilos of grey cabbage comes back.
method.l: A at tlang a khauh reng lai la chhuak rawh. Bandari chhum famkim chu a vardum a, bandari vardum kilo 18 chu a rawn kir.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees fifty a head. Bandari keeps ten days in an Aizawl store room where a green leaf keeps two, and there is no root anywhere in it.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmpakhat leh sawmnga. Thlai hring chu ni hnih chauh a awm theih Aizawl thil dahnaah bandari chu ni sawm a awm thei a, a chhungah lei chhung thlai a awm lo.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, in two batches, uncovered.
start.l: Engmah tui chhungah dah a ngai lo. Minute sawmli, vawi hnihin, khuh lo.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Litre 30 kadai zau, khuh lo. Chawmi pakhat.

season.en: Favang to thal, while the bandari is in the market.
season.l: Favang aṭanga thal thleng, bandari bazar-a a awm chhung.

recipes.name: Jain Paneer Bai
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and cashew gravy with dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: Paneer chu tomato leh kaju bai-ah, sawhthing vut nen

method.en: Soak the cashew an hour and grind it with the tomato. In a Jain gravy the cashew does the work of both an onion and a garlic and there is no cheaper honest way.
method.l: Kaju chu darkar khat tui-ah dah la, tomato nen dengin. Jain bai-ah chuan kaju chuan purun leh purunsen hna a pahnihin a thawk a, hei aia man tlawm kawng dik a awm lo.

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the ghee goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and no sugar can be added to a Jain vessel to hide it.
method.l: Ghee a luh hmain tomato bal chu minute sawmhnih leh nga chhum rawh. Chhum tawk lo tomato chu a thur a, chu thupna atan Jain bel-ah sugar thlak theih a ni lo.

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, a hundred grams in twenty-six litres. It is four times the strength of the fresh root.
method.l: Sawhthing vut, sawhthing thar ni lo; litre 26-ah gram 100. Sawhthing thar aiin vawi li a nghet.

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Five kilos boiled in gravy is five kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: Sem hmain minute li chauhvin paneer chu a lut. Bai-a chhum kilo nga chu sem hnaih velah rabar kilo nga a ni.

recipes.why: Thirty-six rupees fifty a head. It is the dish that lets a Jain guest sit at a wedding plate and be given the same festival gravy as everybody else, with no root and no fresh ginger in it.
recipes.why_l: Mi khat tangka sawmthum leh ruk leh sawmnga. Hei hi lei chhung thlai leh sawhthing thar tel lovin, Jain mikhual chu inneihna thlengbelah ṭhu a, mi dang zawng zawng ang bawka kut bai dawng theihin a siam chaw a ni.

start.en: Cashew soaks an hour. Two hours in all.
start.l: Kaju chu darkar khat tui-ah a awm. A zawng zawngin darkar hnih.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, a grinder and a holding pot for the paneer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Litre 35 bel, denna leh paneer dahna bel. Chawmi pahnih.

season.en: At a wedding and at Chapchar Kut.
season.l: Inneihna leh Chapchar Kut-ah.
